nodes.name: The sum-product pairing for zeta is Vinogradov's method; the multiplicative side alone is rank one
nodes.statement: zeta pairs a multiplicative character n^(it) with an additive set (an interval). The estimate sum_{N<n<=2N} n^(it) << N^(1 - c/k^2), k = log t/log N, is a power saving at N = t^epsilon and gives the Vinogradov-Korobov region, a crossing of Re s = 1 by (log t)^(-2/3) up to log log factors. Its additive step holds for DH (periodic coefficients) and fails for sign twists and THIN; its multiplicative step (3-4-1) fails for DH. A bilinear form sum a_m b_n (mn)^(it) over a rectangle has rank one, so no Cauchy-Schwarz gain exists there (proved); for forms with the cut mn <= x this is argued. THIN (zero at b, signs changed on a prime set of relative density zero) passes every estimate whose relative slack exceeds x^(b-1).

nodes.name: Adjacent squared-gap ODE and integrating-factor certificate
nodes.statement: Before first loss of simple real zeros, y=(b-a)^2 obeys y'=8-4Sy, S=sum_{r!=a,b}1/((b-r)(a-r))>=0. If S>=L(t)>=0 along the continuation then y(T)>8 int_{t0}^T exp(-4 int_v^T L)dv excludes that pair's collision down to t0. Triple cluster slope is 6.

nodes.name: Closed forms in the 2/3 argument
nodes.statement: R(psi0) = 4/3; R(psi_MT) = 1/2 + cot(1/sqrt2)/sqrt2 = 1.32749929632, so 2 - R = 0.672500703679 (Lamzouri C0); R_lambda(psi0) = 1/lambda + lambda/3, H(lambda) = 2 - 1/lambda - lambda/3 increasing on (0,1]; Christoffel value Lambda_2(0) = 5/36, 1 - 2 Lambda_2(0) = 13/18.

nodes.name: HL*(k) hierarchy gives proportion 13/18 and 100%
nodes.statement: Statements of the Alpoge-Furman preprint (arithmetic reproduced only): under a Hardy-Littlewood-type hypothesis HL*(4) the proportion of zeros on the line is >= 13/18; HL*(k) for all k gives 100%. A proportion statement, not an every-window statement.

nodes.name: Lossless Alpoge-Furman inertia criterion (Lemma 1)
nodes.statement: If G = sum_S v v^T + sum_M m_j u u^T + sum_O mu_l 2 Re(w w^T) + E with ||E|| <= theta and the number of eigenvalues above theta is >= |S| + sum m_j + 2 sum mu_l, then M = O = empty: every zero in the window is simple and on the line.

nodes.name: Alpoge-Furman mechanism: rank-trace inequality and Sylvester inertia
nodes.statement: Proportion >= 2/3 comes from Montgomery's pair-correlation second moment, a rank-trace inequality (Lemma 3.2) and Sylvester inertia applied to a Gabor compression G of Weil's Hermitian form (phi(u) e^{i alpha_k u}, support L = log(T/2 pi)). Measured: tr G = N(T,2T) +- 1 for T = 1e3 to 2.9e5.

nodes.name: Fresnel-Airy envelope sign condition
nodes.statement: The local envelope K_k(t) = Ai(mu (t - c)) is nonnegative iff the support stays past the first pre-caustic zero: Ai(x) >= 0 iff x >= -a_1, a_1 = 2.338107410459767. The controlling alias is h = p - 1 at every witness window.

nodes.name: No cancellation in A_{k,h} at Fresnel width, on primes or zeros
nodes.statement: The width u/sqrt(v) lies below the RH short-interval barrier sqrt(u) log^2 u (ratio 100.5 at the floor alias), unconditionally and under GRH. On the zero side the needed bound is a zero-free half-strip sigma > 0.59045 at each height. Related obstruction map row Q13.

nodes.name: Localized barrier sum A_{k,h}: prime and zero sides closed
nodes.statement: The localized barrier sum is height/width-bound and GRH-inert on the prime side and Montgomery-pair-correlation-gated on the zero side (59% of the p = 97 majorant mass at alpha > 1).

nodes.name: Shifted alias denominators are (1/p)-separated with curvature floor 1/p
nodes.statement: The shifted denominators k - h/p form an exactly (1/p)-separated set and the phase curvature satisfies lambda(h) >= 1/p; packet disjointness improves toward the fold and overlap lives at the high-curvature end.

nodes.name: Theorem U: alias energy fraction inside the sieve algebra
nodes.statement: For an alias a | P of conductor q the fraction of alias energy lying in the sieve algebra is 1/phi(q); the complement leaks outside. Verified numerically across several aliases.

nodes.name: Paper alias coefficients are determined, with additive-character phases
nodes.statement: Each per-alias coefficient is a_h(n) = -(1/p) e(hn/p): modulus 1/p, phase a p-th root of unity. The sign pattern entering the seam certificate is therefore fixed arithmetic data, not a free parameter.

nodes.name: Alias-denominator to rate map and octave-Szasz weight
nodes.statement: The alias denominators form the punctured (1/p)-lattice; under the width law mu = d^(1/3)/c the octave-Szasz weight is W(p,D) = Theta((pD)^(2/3)). The weight is (p,D)-uniformly bounded iff the width-decay exponent exceeds 1; the paper exponent 1/3 does not.

nodes.name: Montgomery frequency of Fresnel-Airy packets
nodes.statement: alpha_{k,h}=1+log(1/(2 pi(k-h/p)))/log T at stationary point u_{k,h}=v/(k-h/p). alpha>1 iff k=1 and h>p(1-1/(2pi)); at p=97 this is h in {82..96}, 15 aliases with 59.26% of the named majorant mass, outside the range |alpha|<=1.

nodes.name: Fraction of weld majorant mass with pair-correlation parameter alpha > 1
nodes.statement: The alpha_{k,h} > 1 majorant-mass fraction is N-flat (fixed by h/p against 1/(2 pi)): 0 for p <= 5, 47.38 percent at p = 7, 59.26 percent at p = 97, 35-59 percent for p >= 7. Rigid under change of Fresnel width; the analytic-conductor scale log(pT/2 pi) is the warranted normalisation.

nodes.name: Alpoge-Furman: Gabor compression + rank-trace + Sylvester inertia
nodes.statement: Gabor compression of the Weil form (support [-L/2, L/2], dimension about N(T,2T)) + Montgomery second moment + rank-trace lemma + inertia gives certificate 0.5775 -> 2/3 like 1/L; R = 1.3274992963. Uses a prime-side second moment over a height-localised family with signature counting, outside the NS-RIGID span. Obstruction map P27.

nodes.name: Amplifier density 1/6 and residue degree k = 6 (rows Z14, Z15)
nodes.statement: The amplifier is the trivializing rows mu_6 (K^x)^6 of density 1/6; 11/12 = 1 - (1/2)(1/6) is exact. Galois parity gives k in {2,3,6}; p^6 amplification is optimal among arguments using only the mean square and invariance A_{u m^6} = A_u. Structural, not a theorem for all methods.

nodes.name: Local angular-spacing statistics of prime phases
nodes.statement: At fixed t, normalized gaps of theta=t log p mod 2 pi sorted on the circle, for true primes and two comparison populations, against the exponential e^{-s} (Poisson) reference.

nodes.name: Anti-Hermitian part bounds the strip: |Im x| <= eta, Lambda <= t + eta^2/2
nodes.statement: If a zero x is represented as a kernel vector v of an operator pencil with anti-Hermitian part K, then Im x * |v|^2 = Re<v, K v>, so |Im x| <= sup ||K||. With global representation (G) and de Bruijn strip contraction (S) as hypotheses, Lambda <= t + eta^2/2.

nodes.name: ARB-LEGE certified margins past ln 3
nodes.statement: Pole-free Weil positivity W(h) >= c ||h||^2 certified at 2a <= ln 4 (c = 8.55e-8), ln 5 (2.25e-12), ln 6 (6.25e-17); margins decay like 10^(-4.8 e^{2a}). The whole range lies below the verified-height crossover 2a = 7.764.

nodes.name: Explicit formula on the native span: closed forms of each term
nodes.statement: arch_ij = (1/2)[psi(s_i/2) + psi(s_j/2)] G_ij - ln(pi) G_ij; pole_ij = 1/(s_i(s_j-1)) + 1/(s_j(s_i-1)); prime_ij = (Z_i + Z_j) G_ij with Z_i = -zeta'/zeta(s_i), G_ij = 1/(nu_i + nu_j). Primes enter only through the n scalars zeta'/zeta(s_i), s_i > 1.

nodes.name: Residual sign law (-1)^omega(b) of the arithmetic first moment
nodes.statement: r(b)=F_arith(b)/(phi(b) b) - kappa_arith satisfies sign r(b) = (-1)^{omega(b)} for 2799 of 2801 b in [200,3000]; on general moduli r(b) b = 0.248 log b + 0.100, with faster convergence on smooth and primorial b.

nodes.name: Route B: Hellmann-Feynman force on a zero under a prime-field deformation
nodes.statement: F(s,tau) = xi(s) + tau Psi(s), Psi(s) = sum_p log p (p^(-s) + p^(-(1-s))); d rho/d tau = -Psi(rho)/xi'(rho). Re Psi(1/2 + delta + i gamma) = 2 sum_p log p p^(-1/2) cos(gamma ln p) cosh(delta ln p) is even in delta, so the line is a fixed locus of the sigma-drift; stability open.

nodes.name: Arithmetic remainder cancels all boundary dissipation
nodes.statement: Re L(it)=0 at regular points, while the gamma part has Re A(it)=sum_n t^2/(lambda_n(lambda_n^2+t^2))>0. Hence Re R(it)=-d_A(t)<0 for R=L-A: R is not positive-real and no bound Re R>=-eta Re A with eta<1 holds. Uses neither RH nor simplicity.

nodes.name: Mean-field limit for the attractive singular flow
nodes.statement: No propagation-of-chaos or empirical-measure convergence theorem (Sznitman, Rogers-Shi, Cepa-Lepingle, Serfaty modulated energy, Jabin-Wang) covers the attractive sign of dx_k/ds = -2 sum 1/(x_k - x_j). Needed: uniform-in-N curvature lower bound and perturbation control on a strip above the fold (H3, H4); the admissible strip is empty for N >= 1e3.

nodes.name: Bridge-mass moment expansion and degree-d miss factor
nodes.statement: With M_n = int tau^n A(tau) dtau: degree-d bridge mass B_d(a) = (a^d/d!) M_d + E, |E| <= (a^{d+2}/(d+2)!) M_{d+2} cosh(a T_A). Scaling B_d(a/k, kU) misses by exactly 1 - 1/k^{d+1}; degree-0 law B(a/k,kU) = k B(a,U).

nodes.name: Auxiliary kernels with theta-like concavity that fail Pick
nodes.statement: e^{-u^2}(2+cosh u) has the initial concavity and positive Green properties but fails a three-node Pick test; e^{-u^2}(3/2+cosh u) has ordinary and squared-variable log-concavity yet fails the next odd jet block and a four-node test. Generic scalar-concavity induction cannot suffice.

nodes.name: Euler-product twin B with pole at 1 and off-line zeros
nodes.statement: A genuine Euler product B with pole at 1, 0 <= b <= 1 and off-line zeros at 0.85 + 8i and 0.75 + 10i (N = 1e8). Phase rotation moves the zero (r_H(w_0) = 0.055, r_H(conj w_0) = 2.06); modulus debiasing removes it but creates a real double zero at beta = Re w_0.

nodes.name: Background field of an adjacent pair: B_p G^2 < 2
nodes.statement: No particle lies between an adjacent pair, so every summand of B_p is positive; with global minimal gap G the k-th flank particle is at distance >= kG and B_p G^2 <= 2(1 - 1/(K+1)) < 2. The sup over flow time reduces to one scalar c_0 = h_min(0)/g_min(0) (punctured-gap ratio), which is not known uniformly.

nodes.name: Backlund argument-principle rectangle counts zeros without locating them
nodes.statement: N_R=(1/2pi) change of arg zeta around a rectangle straddling the line (Backlund 1918, Trudgian 2014) gives counts; explicit S(T) bounds on sigma=1/2 give no independent constraint on Lambda and continuation off the line is RH-gated.

nodes.name: Displacement residual of the eps' certificate
nodes.statement: Bound, from t=0 table data, the instantaneous complex distances |x_l(t)-y(t)| between window zeros and omitted zeros over the whole backward-flow horizon (spectator real zeros may pair into complex). Realness and kernel structure are closed; this distance quantification is open.
nodes.underusedWhy: the one named open lemma left in the field-channel reroute

nodes.name: Escape law for zeros of H_{-tau}
nodes.statement: Measured: H_{-1} has 7 zeros with 1.42 <= y <= 2.39 for x in [5000,5050]; H_{-4} has 7 with 1.81 <= y <= 3.55 for x <= 200.5. Heuristic law: zeros of H_{-tau} at height x reach |Im z| about tau log(x/4 pi)/2 - 1. If true for all tau > 0, height-uniform strip statements are flow-critical at xi.

nodes.name: Backward heat family as realised in the repo winding ladder
nodes.statement: The repo 'Z-convolution ladder' is H_t at t=-4 tau_repo<0: real-even, conjugate-closed, with genuine pair mergers (10 zeros to 2 by t=-20 in the base window). Any property proved from evenness, realness or kernel positivity holds along it while zeros leave the line.

nodes.name: Backward de Bruijn flow: only logarithmic conditional stability
nodes.statement: Backward flow amplifies wavenumber k by exp(t k^2); log-convexity gives ||P_{<=K} u(t)|| <= e^{tK^2} ||P_{<=K} u(0)||, so the constant at zero-resolving cutoff is exp(T (log gamma_N)^2/(4 pi^2)), N-divergent. Forward DBM rigidity (Erdos-Schlein-Yau) does not transfer backward. Same wall as map F1.

nodes.name: Negative-time proxy cannot seed the positive-t barrier
nodes.statement: The repo Gaussian-convolution proxy is de Bruijn flow at t = -4 tau_repo. Backward heat is ill-posed; de Bruijn Theorem 13 preserves real zeros only forward, so the proxy has a tighter margin. Forward transport needs the same positivity |A + B| > |C|; cost equals the direct barrier.

nodes.name: Bagchi strong-recurrence criterion
nodes.statement: RH is equivalent to zeta being strongly recurrent in 1/2 < Re s < 1: zeta approximates its own vertical translates in the sense of Voronin universality.

nodes.name: Band-limited proxy amplitude misses C_C
nodes.statement: From R_2(x) = 1 - (sin(pi x)/(pi x))^2 restricted to |alpha| < 1 the band-mean amplitude is A_band = 1/2, ratio 1.3029 to C_C; partial band A_band(c) = c/2. The position-space curvature reading (pi^2/3)/C_C ~ 8.573 is a different object.

nodes.name: Bandlimited zeta packets refute the strong 4M tail gate
nodes.statement: The strong 4M cap and the aggregate target E_lambda=O(l) at T_0=pi X/l are false along X=2N for supported high-frequency packets built from r_n=n^{-1/2}. The local-negative-mass gate s<(1-delta_0)mu is not refuted. A signed route must keep the near-null head sector.

nodes.name: Lowered barrier floor moves no Lambda value
nodes.statement: The barrier floor is not an input of route P; under Polymath15 Thm 1.2 it enters only through containment (t0 <= 129/800, f^2 <= y0^2), which does not bind. 0.1787854 and 0.1758354 are unchanged at every floor from 0.1809 to 0.022.

nodes.name: Optimised barrier height set W4
nodes.statement: A 10-knot piecewise-linear multiplier of Raymond's PLAN heights added to the multi-height menu gives 0.145637425999752 alone (-5.67e-5), and exactly 0 once the route-3 kernels are present. Local, not global, optimum.

nodes.name: Fixed-height ceiling of the barrier mollifier
nodes.statement: Lambda_ceil(X) = min(1, gamma ||A/B||) as a function of verified height X = 4 pi N^2: the truncated-mollifier crossing gamma S_A(1e8) = 1 is bracketed at each height rung; lower targets (0.145, 0.14) need larger X. Related obstruction map rows F6, P26.

nodes.name: Barrier slabs certify at 2X, 5X, 10X
nodes.statement: Closed slabs [X', X'+1] x [y0, 1] x [0, 0.16125] certify at X' = 1.2e13, 3e13, 6e13 with margins about 0.50 (y0 = 0.17) and 0.08-0.10 (y0 = 0.03); mesh cost grows like X^0.45-0.57. No Lambda change without RH verified to X'/2.

nodes.name: Bender-Brody-Muller growth classes
nodes.statement: psi_s = -zeta(s, x+1), Delta psi_s = x^{-s}, psi_s(0) = -zeta(s): the boundary condition selects all zeros. An off-line zero with sigma > 1/2 gives growth x^{1-sigma}; reality of the point spectrum on a growth-cap domain of order >= x^{1/2} implies RH (one direction; Delta^{-1} ambiguous).

nodes.name: Surrogate crossover map g(N)=K log T0(N) is a Bernstein function
nodes.statement: g(x)=a+bx+int_0^inf(1-e^{-xt})dmu(t), a,b>=0, K=(C_C/E_trunc)^2 about 1.5727e8; g' completely monotone on the post-peak ramp. E(N)=E_trunc+E_flow+E_coll; sigma=E_coll/E_N is degree-0 homogeneous, forcing elasticity sum 0. Bookkeeping for the PT-anchored surrogate.

nodes.name: Regularised xp models reproduce only the smooth count
nodes.statement: Sierra-Rodriguez-Laguna: semiclassical count (E/2 pi)(ln(E/2 pi) - 1) + mu + 2 pi/E; fit constant 0.875007 +- 5.3e-5 (= 7/8). The gamma-phase spectrum theta(E_n) = pi(n - 3/2) misses the zeros by exactly S(T) (rms 0.3108 spacings, correlation 0.9999999994). Fluctuations need primes.

nodes.name: Berry-Keating xp Hamiltonian
nodes.statement: Conjecture: zero ordinates are eigenvalues of a self-adjoint quantization of H=xp. Numerics: H_sym=(xp+px)/2 in a truncated Hermite basis at N=50,100,200 against the first 30 ordinates; no identification.

nodes.name: Berry number-variance saturation scale set by the prime 2
nodes.statement: L_sat(T) = log(T/2pi)/(2 pi log 2): the box length at which the phase of the shortest periodic orbit (prime 2, period log 2) reaches order 1 and Sigma^2 leaves the GUE curve. Tested on three height cuts of Odlyzko zeros. The sign of |rho_emp+1/2|-|rho_GUE+1/2| changes at L in (60,61).

nodes.name: Three-factor near-front invariant beta * g_min * (x_2 - x_0) -> 1
nodes.statement: Along the backward Dyson flow the background-field sup beta, the min gap g_min and the neighbouring span x_2 - x_0 satisfy beta * g_min * (x_2 - x_0) -> 1 at the front, linearly in the min-gap fraction; holds for unit spacing, real zeta ordinates (N = 50..200) and GUE-simulated ordinates.
nodes.underusedWhy: ensemble-blind three-factor invariant at the collision front; not attacked in the campaign

nodes.name: Background-field sup is N-uniform on unit spacing, not on real ordinates
nodes.statement: At matched front progress beta(N) = sup |B_p(s)| has spread below 1.5 percent across N = 50..200 for unit spacing, but on the first N real zeta ordinates it grows 1.10 -> 1.71 -> 2.69 (spread 121 to 143 percent).

nodes.name: Small-a intercept of I(a,b)=(a/2)log b+d_a
nodes.statement: Measured over a=1..47: d_a=(a/2)(2C+1-log a) in closed form, not a V(b,a)-residue arithmetic function; sub-leading Vasyunin cotangent coefficient -pi/36 confirmed by digamma/Hurwitz check.

nodes.name: Bettin-Conrey reciprocity is not smooth on coprime pairs
nodes.statement: The resummation separating smooth and arithmetic O(x^2) endpoint contributions of the Vasyunin bulk-profile curvature fails: the reciprocal combination has quantum-modular behaviour on integer coprime pairs (continued-fraction probe). The reciprocity is the Estermann functional equation.

nodes.name: Beurling-Nyman density criterion: strict equivalence, no quantitative lever
nodes.statement: Nyman 1950, Beurling 1955, Bercovici-Foias, BBLS-05 are RH equivalences; the Baez-Duarte constant is a zero-side moment. Reweighting d_N by any multiplier class (polynomial, sparse, lacunary, compact Mellin support) leaves admissible band s<1/2 disjoint from the sensitive band s~1.

nodes.name: Binding high-side row bin of the 7/8 system
nodes.statement: min(-E*) = 35 sqrt(16354)/12696 - 1491/4232 = 2.2815e-4, attained at x = 1/2, delta* = 0.3866376: row zeros of sextic Hecke L-functions at Re s about 0.6933. Re-optimised paper system gives 0.874957; certified re-tuned boundary 7/8 - 1/25000 (endgame only).

nodes.name: Binet positive-kernel representation of Stirling tails over divisors
nodes.statement: R(b) = Integral g(t) S_b(t) dt with g > 0 and S_b a Moebius divisor sum of exponentials; with 1/(12n) - 1/(360 n^3) < J(n) < 1/(12n) it gives O(1) tails on two of three omega-classes; no uniform pointwise bound on S_b(t) exists.

nodes.name: GUE departure of pair correlation = Bogomolny-Keating term at amplitude 1
nodes.statement: Data - GUE = a (BK - GUE) with a = 1.0000 +- 0.0008 over 8 windows (T = 5.5e4-8.7e5; 1.0086 +- 0.0088 at 1e10-1e13). Spikes at log n resolved for n = 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13. Gap variance amplitude 0.784 +- 0.019 where BBLM predicts 1.

nodes.name: Diagonal term of the pair correlation as a prime sum
nodes.statement: G1(r) = (zeta'/zeta)'(1 + ir) - B(ir) = sum_{n = p^k} log^2 p n^{-1-ir}; A'(0) = 0, so the Bogomolny-Keating series in L has no 1/L term. The oscillating part (Hardy-Littlewood factor A) has no proof.

nodes.name: Krein-Langer negative-index identity (section 17.4)
nodes.statement: ind_-(K_{R_a}) = kappa(a) = #{lambda : X(lambda) = 0, Re lambda > a}, with multiplicity, for the shifted scattering ratio R_a. kappa(a) = 0 for all a > 0 iff R_a is Schur iff E_a Hermite-Biehler iff RH. Obstruction map Q6 gives the same inertia theorem in bridge language.

nodes.name: Inverse Blaschke ghosts: one negative square per off-line zero
nodes.statement: R_a(w)=X(w-a)/X(w+a), |R_a(it)|=1. Each uncancelled right-half-plane pole alpha contributes K_S(z,w)=-k_alpha(z) conj(k_alpha(w)), k_alpha(z)=sqrt(2 Re alpha)/(z-alpha). Negative index = number of ghosts, given a coprime generalized-Schur factorization (not automatic). Map row Q6.

nodes.name: Pair-correlation departure from GUE = Bogomolny-Keating at amplitude 1
nodes.statement: Data - GUE = a (BK - GUE) with a = 1.0000 +- 0.0008 over 8 windows (T = 5.5e4 to 1e13); diagonal 0.9999 +- 0.0008, oscillating 1.0023 +- 0.0031, Hardy-Littlewood factor 1.0032 +- 0.0067; per-prime amplitudes n = 2..13 detected above 20 sigma. Lambda_B = 1.5731511.

nodes.name: Bohr-lift / multiplicative Szego gives only the ceiling log(2pi) - gamma
nodes.statement: The Bohr-lift of G_N reproduces the logarithmic shape of lam_max and the ceiling c<=log(2 pi)-gamma but not the measured 0.3526: the lifted symbol carries the zeta pole. No Szego/Grenander limiting distribution or Helson multiplicative-Toeplitz result fixes the edge.

nodes.name: Certifying inf over the Bohr torus of |B|-gamma|A| on the Lambda=0.145 line
nodes.statement: A scan over 55,874 prime phases reports sign information only; the two verdict signs need opposite certificates (a found negative point is one-sided; a positive infimum needs a cover of T^inf). No certified torus obstruction yet.

nodes.name: Theorem S: capacity-form bootstrap stops at its self-consistent point (row Z16)
nodes.statement: A bootstrap ZF(theta) => ZF(theta - delta(theta)) whose input enters through one monotone scalar stops at its fixed point. Xu-Sang system: stopping point in (0.874886646840, 0.874886649040), contraction 0.00302 per step; binding rows have zeros at real part 0.69-0.76, which no half-plane input reaches.

nodes.name: Bounded-type lemma for xi'/xi(1/2 + w)
nodes.statement: 'A complete discrete (Muntz-complete) node set forces the interpolant G = xi'/xi(1/2 + w), hence RH' is conditional on a bounded-type lemma for xi'/xi(1/2 + w) in Re w > 0; the written argument uses the identity theorem on the whole interval (1, infinity).

nodes.name: Box vector: Psi(W) = -1/2 P(B_W)^2 with defect exponent Theta - 1/2
nodes.statement: For the box class B_W (B_W.H = B_W.V = 4 sinh(W/4)), Psi(W) = -1/2 P(B_W)^2 = aW + T - D(W), where D(W) is the V7 discrepancy; the box defect grows with exponent Theta - 1/2. Suzuki's criterion is D(W) <= C(1+W)^m.

nodes.name: Step-4 bridge needs |t_c(N)| absolutely in two places
nodes.statement: The bridge |Lambda - (-t_c(N))| <= E(N) uses t_c(N) in the identification term and in the E_flow exponent exp(C_G |t_c|); a per-N deviation rate must be converted to an absolute bound through an anchor value.

nodes.name: Component model E(N)=E_trunc+E_flow+E_coll and share sigma(N)
nodes.statement: E_trunc=3.06e-5 (fixed strip sigma=3/4 above T_PT), E_coll=C_C sqrt(log T0/N) (GUE-conditional), E_flow=C_F(L/T0)G=G L(L0^2-1)/(4pi^2 N) about (log N)^3/N via T0=2pi N/(L0-1). sigma(N)=E_coll/E. A surrogate, not a rigorous asymptotic.

nodes.name: Unitary bridge multiplier C_0 = N/D
nodes.statement: D=F+alpha F', N=F-alpha F', (C_0 f)^(t)=[N(it)/D(it)]f^(t); C_0 is unconditionally unitary, common boundary zeros removable. With h_pm(u)=(1 pm alpha u/2)kappa(u), A=h_+*, A*=h_-*: A g=A* f for g=C_0 f.
nodes.closedBy: G6 (H_c>=0 iff S causal iff RH)

nodes.name: Bridge as scattering matrix on the modular surface
nodes.statement: phi(s) = Lambda(2s-1)/Lambda(2s) = c_inf(s) chi(2s-1) zeta(2-2s)/zeta(2s); resonances rho/2 sit in zeta(2s). Unitarity, phi(s)phi(1-s) = 1, residue 3/pi and the inner property survive moving resonances off Re s = 1/4: the Lax-Phillips axioms at phi level are RH-blind.

nodes.name: Shear Gram sign pattern forced by Phi >= 0
nodes.statement: For Phi >= 0 on [0,U], sign Gshear(u,v) = sign(v - u) on all off-diagonal mass (measured 100 percent, zero mismatch, and structurally guaranteed). The near-diagonal bridge sign uses only positivity of Phi, not its arithmetic.

nodes.name: Winding of the bridge chi(1/2+it) equals N(T)
nodes.statement: The winding number of the bridge function along the critical line from 0 to T equals the zero count N(T) (Riemann-von Mangoldt); the phase around one zero is +-2pi; under s->1-s on-line zeros are self-partnered, off-line zeros are swapped in pairs (Z/2 invariant). Checked at T=10..1000.

nodes.name: One line + one interior value (Balazard-Saias-Yor extension)
nodes.statement: J(a) = log|F(a)| deficit = sum_{beta > 1/2} -log|B_rho(a)| >= 0, equal to 0 iff no zeros right of the line; at a = 1 it is exactly Balazard-Saias-Yor. Decides RH but cannot locate zeros: an off-line quadruple contributes about 2 delta/gamma^2.

nodes.name: E(N) component budget at the verified height 3e12
nodes.statement: At T0 = 3e12 (N ~ 1.236e13) E_trunc carries share 0.981 of E(N); the GUE-conditional share sigma is below 2 percent; E_flow never dominates at any height.

nodes.name: Minimum-gap site is not uniformly confined to the bulk
nodes.statement: Uniform-in-N bulk confinement of the minimal-gap index k*_N is refuted by a record-time lemma plus a 1e6-zero witness; only a density-form restatement survives. On N in (1e4, 1e6] the record gap H_raw drops only 9 times.

nodes.name: de Bruijn flow as viscous Burgers fluid with critical point Lambda
nodes.statement: Cole-Hopf with heat potential H_t (nu=1/4 in ordinates, 1/N Dyson); a complex zero pair is a viscous shock with Delta*b=4nu exactly; order parameter phi with RH iff phi(0)=0; equation of state phi=Psi_beta(|t|/tau_*(T)) with exponent (beta+1)/2.

nodes.name: Burgers identity for M = -P'/P under polynomial heat flow
nodes.statement: For a polynomial heat flow P(s, z) (global in s), M = -P'/P satisfies a viscous Burgers-type equation; with a Taylor representation P_s = heatOp(-s) P_0. Kernel-verified; the Lean hypothesis demands the heat equation for all s.

nodes.name: lim sup |t_c(N)| = 0 (Burgers uniformity)
nodes.statement: GUE-free, pair-correlation-free lim-sup statement from Riemann-von Mangoldt plus Selberg/Trudgian |S(T)| via Koksma-Hlawka; closed modulo finite-N validity of the collision formula. Does not bound Lambda.

nodes.name: Low-conductor oscillation in the Burnol ratio
nodes.statement: The residual of ratio(N) carries a genuine oscillation at frequency w about 4.08 in log N, attributed to a low-conductor band (q=4, 5) of the cotangent table (single-tone R^2 0.685 at q=5, 0.619 at q=4). A gamma_1 alias is ruled out: a gamma_1 tone at w=14.14 is resolved by the grid.

nodes.name: Burnol-normalised Nyman-Beurling ratio stays below 1 on N<=10000
nodes.statement: ratio(N) = d_N^2 log N / C_Burnol sits at 0.964..0.988 for N in 2600..10000 and does not climb toward the RH asymptote 1 (0.977 at N=1e4). A fluctuating remainder about a plateau near 0.985 fits best; deciding plateau against ratio->1 needs about 1.2 more decades of N.

nodes.name: Global asymmetric isolation constant c_glob
nodes.statement: First rigorous lower bound c_glob>=0.8656641635 against ceiling c_half=0.89802; later closed: c_glob=c_half=0.8980208880762339, root of 4+4r-4/r-4/(r+1)-2[psi(1+2/r)-psi(1+1/r)].

nodes.name: Twin-ladder kernel as resolvent of a canonical system; explicit Hamiltonian for finite surrogate
nodes.statement: Under RH the Weyl m-function is Nevanlinna, so a unique trace-normed H(x) exists (de Branges). For the finite point-measure surrogate: Jacobi system with a_k=0 (Lanczos), equivalently a chain of 11 indivisible rank-one intervals (tr H=1, det H=0), reproducing m to 1e-15. Off-line finite-kappa structure open.

nodes.name: Linear-shear capture norm = peak slope of the Phi power spectrum
nodes.statement: As a -> 0 the shear numerator is skew-Toeplitz Ttilde(u,v) = a (v-u) R(|v-u|), R the Phi autocorrelation, and ||Ttilde|| = a sup_xi |d/dxi |Phihat(xi)|^2|. Maximiser xi* = 12.0667 (grid-converged), U-independent, unique; capture constant C_inf = 0.17514.
nodes.underusedWhy: linear-shear norm = a sup|d/dxi |Phihat|^2|, maximiser xi* = 12.0667; kernel-only

nodes.name: Prime LC cascade transmission S21 = zeta(2s)/zeta(s)
nodes.statement: For sections T_p=[[1,a],[a,1]], a=p^{-s}: S11=0 identically, S21=S12=2/Sigma_+ with prod_p(1+p^{-s})=zeta(s)/zeta(2s) for Re s>1; by continuation S21 is proportional to zeta(2s)/zeta(s). Zeta zeros are poles of S21, not zeros of any S-parameter; det S vanishes where zeta(2s)=0.

nodes.name: Catalan signed ladder
nodes.statement: Signed flip = chi_4: G=beta(2)=L(2,chi_4)=sum chi_4(n)/n^2 (rung deletion at p=2). Period-dimension obstruction: zeta column 5 zeta(2)-8 (dim 2) versus Catalan G-pi+2 ln 2+pi^2/12 (dim 5). Irrationality of G open; zero location gives no lever.

nodes.name: OU realization of the Cauchy-phase covariance
nodes.statement: K_T(l,m)=(1/2)cos(T(l-m))[e^{-x|l-m|}-e^{-x(l+m)}] is realized by a zero-start two-quadrature Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process (mean and covariance only, not the law). Gives a linear-time variance recurrence and triangular/sinc-squared filtering correspondence.

nodes.name: Cayley-Schur transform of the canonical-system m-function
nodes.statement: Theta_a(z)=E_a^#(z)/E_a(z), E_a(z)=X(a-iz); Cayley(m)=(m-i)/(m+i) maps the Weyl m-function to the unit-disk Schur class (Krein, de Branges). Theta_a is Schur on C_+ exactly when E_a is Hermite-Biehler.

nodes.name: CDB-Exist: Phi-built de Branges canonical system
nodes.statement: For every a > 0 there is a de Branges canonical system built from Phi whose Cayley transform is Theta_a = E_a^#/E_a. Unifies Conjectures 16.4, 16.6, 18.1. RH-equivalent.

nodes.name: Direct construction of H(E_a) from Phi splits into a formal layer and an RH-equivalent positivity layer
nodes.statement: Aronszajn RKHS factorisation plus Arov-Nudelman passive realisation build the space unconditionally and independently of zero location; the remaining layer is E_a Hermite-Biehler, equivalent to RH.

nodes.name: CDB-Exist: Phi-built canonical system
nodes.statement: For every a > 0 construct from Phi alone (not from the zeros of X) a Hamiltonian dm_a on R_+ whose Krein-Weyl Cayley transform is Theta_a = E_a^#/E_a, E_a = A_a - i B_a, A_a = int Phi cosh(au) cos(zu) du, B_a = int Phi sinh(au) sin(zu) du. Direct construction reduces to Hermite-Biehler positivity (RH-equivalent).

nodes.name: Carrier contract |C_E,17| <= Q sqrt(Sbar) on the open window
nodes.statement: Sub-0.14 row: for 690988 <= N <= 54799999 (T in [3.0e12, 1.89e16]) the contract |C_E,17| + r_num < R_ex = 0.27968819555 closes iff Q_sup < R_ex/sqrt(Sbar) = 1.4327, with sqrt(Sbar) = 0.19522 at p = 97. The anchor cell forces Q >= 1.09683; required uniform saving is the factor 1.306.

nodes.name: Limit of symbol-floor certificates
nodes.statement: For a certificate W >= c ||h||^2 built from a compact Galerkin part with cutoff T: c <= inf_{|t|>=T} sigma(t). A point sigma(t0) < 0 with t0 >= T rules out every such certificate with cutoff T <= t0. Individual characters reach only 2a about 1.95-2.40 by this method.

nodes.name: GUE level repulsion regularises the near-anchor flip-reach divergence
nodes.statement: The flip contribution reach(alpha) ~ K/(1 - alpha) diverges at the anchor against a flat Riemann-von Mangoldt weight; the pair-correlation factor g(x) ~ (pi^2/3) x^2 cancels the divergence. Heuristic, not rigorous.

nodes.name: First-collision time modulus is exactly Holder-1/2
nodes.statement: The collision-time map has Holder exponent exactly 1/2, from the inverse-square-root cusp density of the limiting shock measure; no finite Lipschitz constant exists, which is the analytic source of the C_Lip divergence.

nodes.name: C_H shock-Lipschitz modulus is not N-uniform by Gronwall
nodes.statement: C_H = C_shock C_Lip / 4: C_shock(N) = sqrt(2/(3 log gamma_N)) is explicit and bounded (< 1/3 for N >= 2458), but C_Lip from the flow-Jacobian Gronwall route diverges (collision integral diverges; C_Theta grows ~ N^0.92). Every finite-height Lambda < 0.2 claim through E_coll is conditional on it.

nodes.name: C_H=C_shock*C_Lip/4: the Lipschitz factor is not N-uniform in the W_1 channel
nodes.statement: C_shock(N)=sqrt(2/(3 log gamma_N))<1/3 is closed form; the W_1 Lipschitz modulus C_Theta grows about linearly in N and blows up off-basin like 1/g0. The finite-N Lambda estimate is gated on this constant.

nodes.name: C_H Holder-1/2 shock modulus is RH-hard
nodes.statement: N-uniform C_H = C_shock C_Lip/4 is equivalent to a uniform all-height minimal-gap lower bound; g_min is exactly Holder-1/2 in W_1 and C_Lip grows linearly in N. Averaged, positive-proportion, zero-free-region and zero-density inputs are of the wrong type (C2, C3, C5).

nodes.name: cond-polymath15-G6a equals cond-CH
nodes.statement: The asymptotic Polymath15 bridge modulo G6a and the finite-N E_coll conditional are the same object: the Holder-1/2 shock modulus C_H. Every Lambda statement from the Route B flow result passes through this one conditional.

nodes.name: Route L: off-line detector reach is the Christoffel function saturation
nodes.statement: For the atomic measure nu_a, the CMV/Verblunsky Christoffel function lambda_N(theta_k)=1/K_N saturates at the atom mass exactly when the Route L detector first fires; this is the analytic reach law for detection order versus height.

nodes.name: Claim M (monotone transport of the exterior field S) is false
nodes.statement: With the actual H_t on [0.21, 0.30] (all zeros real), pair 6703-6704 has S rising from 0.5521 to 0.5624 and 15 of 70 inner pairs rise. A fixed relative loss eta certifies only depth (1/4S) log(q/eta); the certificate needs zero positions to relative precision exp(-4 int S) at every height.

nodes.name: Gronwall integral int 2/g^2 diverges at collision
nodes.statement: The collision-stopped surrogate I_eps(g0) = (1/2) log(g0/eps) is finite for eps > 0 and diverges as eps -> 0; the cusp rate g_min ~ C_shock W_1^{1/2} cannot rescue the window [t_c - delta, t_c]. C_Lip in the W_1 channel is not boundable.

nodes.name: C_Lip field-channel reroute
nodes.statement: A finite N-uniform deterministic collision-time transfer modulus in the vector-field-error channel, certified on every H_raw plateau of N in [1e4, 1e6] without W_1, Gronwall or pair correlation; K_paper <= 2.424e-6 uniformly (F_mb plateau lemma).

nodes.name: Closed reserve: signed credits minus summable debts
nodes.statement: R_{n+1}-R_n=c_q-d_q, c_q=Lambda(q)q^{-1/2}log(q/(H(q-)/2)^2), H(q-)=sum_{p^k<q}(log p)p^{-k/2}-b, -3<b<-2; d_q>=0 with sum d_q<inf unconditionally. Hence boundedness below of the accumulated signed credits G_N is an exact RH-equivalent target.

nodes.name: Single-Gaussian extremal minorant existence (cited step of SEP-OPT)
nodes.statement: The Carneiro-Littmann-Vaaler Gaussian-subordination input splits into in-repo hypotheses (p(t) > 0, mass 1), a portable reduction, and one cited step: existence of the type-delta extremal minorant of a single Gaussian. No lighter substitute found.

nodes.name: Calogero-Moser energy growth at the backward collision threshold
nodes.statement: In the Calogero-Moser realisation of the zero flow the only boundary is the backward-flow collision threshold; H_CM is not conserved there and increases with dH_CM/dtau about 80/gap^4 (imp-862). The monotone real-zero count re-derives Lambda>=0. Obstruction map row P31.

nodes.name: Theorem B: CM eta-heights equal A - lambda_1(zeta_K)/2
nodes.statement: CM eta-heights equal A - (1/2) lambda_1(zeta_K) with A = gamma/2 - (log 2)/2 + (1 - log 2 pi)/2 = -0.4769042910 = lambda_1(zeta) - 1/2, lambda_1(zeta) = 0.0230957090 (first Li coefficient). Checked to 3.4e-21.

nodes.name: Theta-trap for the Calogero-Moser collision time
nodes.statement: Corollary A1: t_c<=g_min(0)^2/6 (2.369e-4 at N=1e4, Theta(0)=0.0017); sharp threshold Theta_b=(sqrt73-5)/8=0.443; regime separation rho*=2/3; lattice cap Theta_K=K/(K+1) attained by the uniform lattice.

nodes.name: Calogero-Moser Hessian excludes an edge-scale rigidity escape
nodes.statement: Route A monotonicity closes with bulk rigidity N^{-1} and stays open at edge rigidity N^{-2/3}. An edge escape needs coupling ratio rho <= N^{-1/3}; the many-body CM Hessian gives rho_CM(N) >= 1, growing like N^{0.40}. The needed local law is not delivered by any unconditional input.

nodes.name: ESY local-law rigidity does not port deterministically to zeta zeros
nodes.statement: C_mb<=1 follows from GUE local law only in probability; derandomisation obstacle O3; edge window slope -0.067 versus bulk -0.106, neither near the ESY -1; any closure needs Montgomery pair correlation at step D3 and a 3-point input at D5.

nodes.name: Christoffel function of the zero measure nu_a on the circle
nodes.statement: Atoms z_rho = (i gamma - a)/(i gamma + a) with mass 4a^2/(a^2+gamma^2), a=20; moments are the Herglotz base sequence and need no zero input. The CMV/Verblunsky Christoffel function lambda_N(theta_k)=1/K_N gives reach N_C = 0.396870 gamma^1.248736; the detector exponent exceeds it by 0.023.

nodes.name: Route L: CMV matrix from Taylor data of xi reproduces low zeros
nodes.statement: A 400x400 unitary CMV matrix built from Taylor data of xi at s = 1/2 + 20 (no zero input) has eigen-angles theta = pi - 2 atan(gamma/20) matching the first 12 checked zeros to 4.82e-13, weights 4a^2/(a^2 + gamma^2). A finite detector; reach limited by a.

nodes.name: COAL-N: N-fold coalescence majorant in Laguerre form
nodes.statement: For N rates in a block of ratio R: sqrt(Lambda) <= e^(-x)[L_(N-1)(-2Rx) + 2 L^1_(N-2)(-2Rx)], uniform in the intra-block configuration, via a Blaschke-Newton interpolant and NP-CERT. Slack against the exact confluent value is measured, not zero.

nodes.name: Cofinal Legendre dual b* feasible at every x
nodes.statement: Proposal: build one b* >= 0 on [1, infinity) feasible at every x as a limit of rescaled optimal duals so RIG applies, then use Landau positivity with the pole subtracted. Decisive first test not run: convergence of rescaled optima (v log x / x drifted from 4.08 to 2.86 over 1e4-1e7).

nodes.name: cofinal mobius sum equals x m
nodes.statement: For density-0 b >= 0 with log discrepancy, sum_k mu(k) r_b(x/k) form F_b = -c x m(x) + psi_b, 0 <= psi_b = O(log^2 x).

nodes.name: Pointwise bound for the Moebius sum of one fixed cofinal sawtooth remainder
nodes.statement: Pointwise polylog bound for sum_k mu(k) r_b(x/k) for one fixed cofinal r_b. Uses the integers and all primes jointly; fails for DH, Liouville and theta^3 at Lambda_a >= 0; not separated from E_a at the level of exponents (returns 1/2 + a); only a mean-square bound is argued (MV-CAP).

nodes.name: Coherent sparse-span theorem for separated carriers
nodes.statement: For t,s in [T,2T]: |<N_t u,S_h N_s v>|<=C_K[(1+|t-s|)^{-K}+T^{-K}]|u||v|; for an L=e^b separated set, (1/4)S<=|Psi_b|^2<=S and H_l[J_b Psi_b]>=(1/16)log T S. Nearby, exceptional and low-frequency directions are not covered.

nodes.name: Backward de Bruijn flow = viscous Burgers
nodes.statement: Cole-Hopf of H_t gives viscous Burgers with nu = 1/4 in ordinate units; inviscid Dyson-Burgers is the nu = 1/N limit; a conjugate pair is a viscous shock with strength x width = 4 nu exactly. Lambda = shock-dissolution time.

nodes.name: Collective gap interaction R_j at the first zeros
nodes.statement: R_j=g_j^2 S_j/2 with (g_j^2)'=8(1-R_j). Actual theta heat family, z=2 gamma: at t=0 pair 1 gap 13.7746 has R_eff=1.6039 (closing), pair 2 gap 7.9776 has R_eff=0.6626 (opening); at t=0.02: 1.6030 and 0.663.

nodes.name: Collective-zero slab certificate for Lambda
nodes.statement: For the highest zero z=x+iy, U=y^2: U'<=-2-4yA(z), A=-Im sum_j S_j(z). If zeros lie in |Im z|<=Delta at tau_0 and A>=kappa y on eta<=y<=Delta, then Lambda<=tau_0+(1/4kappa)log((1+2kappa Delta^2)/(1+2kappa eta^2))+eta^2/2. Count-and-box: kappa=sum_j m_j/D_j.
nodes.closedBy: F5 (floor-only cap 0.0962), F3 (no converse to zeros)

nodes.name: Collision constant C_C = (1/8) sqrt(3 pi)
nodes.statement: E_coll(N) = C_C sqrt(log T0/N) with Holder constant C_H = 1/8, read as E[min gap] over M(N) spacings with GUE small-gap density p(s) ~ (pi^2/3) s^2. No effective derivation; five analytic inputs listed.

nodes.name: Measured backward-Dyson collision-time ladder to N = 1e6
nodes.statement: Interval-RK4 collision times t_c(N) for N up to 1e6 (25k-100k rungs closed with one-ULP interval arithmetic), cross-checked by DOP853 at N = 1e4, 1e5 and by the exact pair collapse. Units conversion between the CM-flow time and de Bruijn-Newman time is pinned.

nodes.name: Local collision index for backward heat solutions
nodes.statement: For real analytic h with h_t=-h_xx and a spatial zero of exact multiplicity m>=2, the zero of (h,h_x) is isolated with Brouwer degree -floor(m/2). Boundary winding on a Jordan region equals the sum of indices; zero winding excludes collisions. Nonvanishing alone is not zero winding.

device.evidence: rows P40, S12; c4-fe-stage-rouche-crossing; c4-stage-collision-law; c2-euler-cone-fe-rigidity

nodes.name: RK4-DP5 gap is blind to shared integrator bias
nodes.statement: On the desingularized small-N Dyson backward flow RK4 and DP5 share a common-mode absolute bias which the two-method gap |t_c_RK4 - t_c_DP5| cancels; blindness is largest in the smooth interior. The gap across N is quantization-dominated and non-monotone.

nodes.name: Terminal objects of the 15 direct attempts
nodes.statement: Each lands on: (1) the one-sided Landau bound at square-root precision (V7 at p = 0); (2) a pointwise Euler-product bound at a single height (MV-CAP wall, RES-T); (3) verified height; (4) RH as Weil positivity or an object absent over Q. No identity couples the Euler product to the functional equation at the height of a zero.

nodes.name: Section-25 commutator diagonal/off-diagonal split
nodes.statement: C_a(w,z;u,v) with cosh(au) sinh(av) structure: the strict diagonal reduces to (1/2) sinh(2au) sin((wb - z)u) with sign-definite (>= 0) energy-diagonal channel; C_a is exactly antisymmetric under the joint swap, so the off-diagonal shear carries the sign question.

nodes.name: Complex Burgers characteristics and fold for the backward Dyson field
nodes.statement: Stieltjes transform m:C_+->C_+ of the zero density obeys characteristics dz/dt=m(z,t); fold at 1+t m'(z_0*)=0 with z_0*=x*+i eps, eps->0+ as t->t_c; t_shock(z_0)=tau_c+(1/2)alpha(z_0-z_0*)^2+..., tau_c=-1/m'(z_0*).

nodes.name: Fisher bound on Re F'/F via the tilted characteristic function
nodes.statement: F(x+iy)=F(x)phi_x(y), phi_x(y)=E_x e^{iyU}; |d_x phi_x|^2<=I_x(1-|phi_x|^2), hence Re Z(x+iy)>=mu_x-sqrt(I_x)sqrt(1-|phi_x|^2)/|phi_x|. Ineffective where |phi_x| is small; positive Fisher information does not fix the sign of the complex covariance.

nodes.name: Surrogate-ladder diagnostics carry no zero information
nodes.statement: The several hundred modules on widening slopes, hump argmax, poles of eflow_attr/resid_exp (zero near k*=21.28), Taylor tails and roundoff floors analyse the closed-form surrogate E(N) itself. They change no bound and depend on GUE-conditional C_mb; no statement about zeta zeros follows.

nodes.name: CONF-LB: confluent floor in Laguerre differences
nodes.statement: Lambda_conf >= e^(-2x) sum_{k<N} (L_k(2x) - L_(k-1)(2x))^2 (Laguerre translation identity plus Parseval). With COAL-N it brackets the window supremum within a factor tending to R^(N-1).

nodes.name: Confluent Laguerre floor for the coalescent signed constant
nodes.statement: Lambda_conf >= e^{-2x} sum_{k<N}(L_k(2x)-L_{k-1}(2x))^2, the exact Rayleigh value of the top Laguerre mode L_{N-1}(2 nu t)e^{-nu t} (Parseval plus a Laguerre translation identity); two-sided leading order proved.

nodes.name: Verified height gives a conformal Schur window
nodes.statement: With Y=H-1/2=3000175332799.5, c=pi/(2Y): |X(w-a)/X(w+a)|<1 on Re w>0, |Im w|<Y; the Pick kernel with sinh(cw) denominators is PSD on the strip. The original linear-denominator kernel is not established (negative real 2x2 minor).

nodes.name: Conjecture 22.1 and the frozen-ladder obstruction
nodes.statement: A frozen-ladder approximation with smaller certified remainder than a baseline at equal runtime. Fourier closure + Polya-Szego zero bound + sign transfer give D >= M + 1: a Gaussian-mixture frozen ladder tracking sign changes to 3e12 needs >= 1.2363e13 coefficients. Obstruction map P30.

nodes.name: Conjecture 22.1: frozen-ladder coefficient-dimension obstruction
nodes.statement: A frozen-ladder proxy e^{-alpha u^2} x even polynomial with D_t coefficients has at most 2D_t-2 real zeros, so matching the zero count at the Platt-Trudgian height forces D>=6.18e12. A cost statement; strong global reading falsified.

nodes.name: Field term of an off-line conjugate pair is real
nodes.statement: For real x and omitted pair y=sigma+i tau, conj y: -2[1/(x-y)+1/(x-conj y)] = -4(x-sigma)/((x-sigma)^2+tau^2). The omitted-zero field error e_k(t) in the Dyson ODE is real at every t whether or not any zero is on the line.

nodes.name: Connes adelic trace, truncated at five primes
nodes.statement: Prime side of the Weil-Connes trace over {2,3,5,7,11}, k<=5, at heat time t=0.02 is positive; every term is positive in the a_p(k)=1 normalization, so the check is a coefficient tripwire only. No adelic port.

nodes.name: Connes-Consani scaling site: positivity on the square remains RH-equivalent
nodes.statement: The 2016-2019 arithmetic/scaling site and its Riemann-Roch advance the geometric layer (curve analogue) but the Hodge-type positivity on the square is equivalent to RH; no 2-point bound at support >1.

nodes.name: Twin-ladder route D = prime side of the Connes/Weil trace formula
nodes.statement: The twin-ladder quadratic form is the prime side of the Weil explicit formula on C_Q in log-prime delay coordinates; Path C (Weil positivity) and route D coincide; Approach III (Pontryagin index) equals the inverse-Blaschke-ghost count. Scaling-site / arithmetic-site geometry leaves positivity RH-equivalent.

nodes.name: Conditional one-piece Conrey kappa(theta) table
nodes.statement: Conditional on the twisted second moment at length theta: kappa passes 5/12 at theta = 0.58508, 1/2 at 0.75515, 2/3 at 1.31084, equals 0.5884 at theta = 1; d kappa/d theta = 0.5707 at 4/7. Finite-T recipe main term matches direct averages to theta = 2 within 0.52% (55 configurations).

nodes.name: T(M) = 2 Sum_{b<=M} Q(b)/b^2
nodes.statement: With Q(b) = Sum_{a=2,(a,b)=1}^{b-1} I(a,b)^2/a^2, the coprime-core second moment regroups exactly as T(M)=2 Sum_{b<=M} Q(b)/b^2 (checkpoint T(250)=11.757622). An upper asymptotic Int(N)<=s* log N reduces to the uniform lemma Q(b)<=s0* b+O(1).

nodes.name: Low-moment corner reduction of D_S<=L_S preserves hardness
nodes.statement: For the semilocal pencil D_S<=L_S (S={inf,2}, 2a<=ln3) the global Rayleigh minimiser lies in the k-dimensional low-moment corner, so the corner minimum equals the global margin m(0)=2.8e-3. The finite-constraint reduction does not reduce the problem.

nodes.name: corr23 continuity reduced to one spectral sum for A_S23
nodes.statement: Continuity of the {inf,2,3} correction is reduced to the rho-independent criterion Sum_n |lam_n(A_S23)|^3 / sqrt(1 - lam_n^2) < infinity for the semilocal prolate operator A_S23 = P_1 F_S23 P_1: a spectral gap sup|lam_n|<1 plus a cubic-summable tail.

nodes.name: Mixed 2^a 3^b prolate ladder: rho-free spectral gap
nodes.statement: The cubic tail sum |lambda|^3 = 1.769529 of the mixed {inf,2,3} ladder has a rho-free geometric majorant; termwise-uniform continuity fails by S-unit density. corr23 continuity is conditional on sup |lambda_n| < 1 (a spectral gap not depending on zeros).

nodes.name: Costin-Lebowitz / Soshnikov variance bound for zero linear statistics
nodes.statement: A rigorous partial upper bound on the variance of microscopic-scale linear statistics of zeros ported from the CUE fluctuation argument; cross-validated against Wieand CUE bulk statistics and the Conrey-Snaith arithmetic correction (corrected slope -0.997).

nodes.name: Bettin-Conrey reciprocity for c_0(h/k) yields a period function
nodes.statement: c_0(h/k) + (k/h) c_0(k/h) is not elementary: it is the Bettin-Conrey / Lewis-Zagier period function (i/2)psi (at (2,5) the value is 0.080325). An Euclidean-descent evaluator of V(a,b) costs O(log q) per pair; the asymptotic R series has a resurgence floor exp(-2 pi/x), cap about 3.3e-6.

nodes.name: Weighted cotangent second moment Q(b) <= s0* b + O(1)
nodes.statement: Open: Q(b) = Sum_{a=2,(a,b)=1}^{b-1} I(a,b)^2/a^2 <= s0* b + O(1) with an absolute s0*. Reduced to the pointwise envelope |I(a,b)| <= K a (1 + log(b/a)) on coprime 2<=a<b via Int_0^1 (1-log x)^2 dx = 5, giving Q(b)<=5K^2 b. Measured slope band s* in 5.66..5.80.

nodes.name: Random-prime null model violates Weil positivity in 53-66% of trials
nodes.statement: Cramer random primes reproduce the mean of the Lambda-weighted prime sum (z-score 0.005-0.236) but W=C-P>=0 fails in 53-66% of 30000 trials, while true primes give W>=0. The bound depends on exact cancellation, not prime density.

nodes.name: Credit variation bound and block freezing
nodes.statement: For renormalized prime credits c_n and X=e^L, L>=512: sum_{p_n>=X}|c_{n+1}-c_n|<=(23L+34)/sqrt X. Credits can be frozen on prime-index blocks of up to sqrt p/(log p)^3 events at finite total error (tail <=6/L^2+17/(2L)). Both Jordan sums of credits still diverge.

nodes.name: Renormalised fold-reading amplitude stays in a finite band
nodes.statement: C_ren=(y_N)^{3/2}|m'| measured on the model cusp across the reading-strip ladder 1e3..1e7 lies in [2.2215,2.2510] (spread 2.95e-2), all above C_PS=2.2214. Model cusp only; the real fold modulus is not controlled by it.

nodes.name: Boundary-shock crossing-time field is monotone
nodes.statement: The crossing-time field tau*(y) = y/(2 Im m_0) is strictly increasing in y by Poisson-kernel monotonicity, so interior quadratic tangency is vacuous for the degenerate boundary shock; replaces one of two weak links in the G6a port.

nodes.name: Closed-form crossover of collision and truncation terms
nodes.statement: E_coll = E_trunc at N_cross = (C_C/E_trunc)^2 log T0(N_cross), about 3.28e9 (T0 ~ 1.14e9); sigma = E_coll/E halves at N_half ~ 3.267e9 < N_cross; interior sigma peak 0.949 at N ~ 9.22e5. Height enters only through log T0, so height-map changes are damped about 18x.

nodes.name: E_coll = E_trunc crossover as a contraction fixed point
nodes.statement: N_cross=K log T0(N_cross), K=(C_C/E_trunc)^2, N_cross about 3.280294e9. g(N)=K log T0(N) is a contraction with constant g'(1e9) about 0.1485 on [1e9,1e10]; g(N)<N for all N>N_cross. Derivatives: g^(n)=(-1)^{n+1}2^n pi^n K P_n(u)/(T^n u^{2n-1}).

nodes.name: Crossover map g(N) = K log T0(N) is a Bernstein function
nodes.statement: (-1)^(n+1) g^(n) >= 0 for n >= 1 with numerator polynomials P_n all positive via a_k^(n+1) = n a_(k-1) + (2n-1-k) a_k; so g has a Levy-Khintchine form a + bx + int (1 - e^(-xt)) dmu(t). K = (C_C/E_trunc)^2 ~ 1.5727e8; killing term a = K log(2 pi e).
nodes.underusedWhy: exact positivity structure (Bernstein function with Levy-Khintchine form)

nodes.name: Csordas-Smith-Varga Lehmer-pair criterion
nodes.statement: With D = gamma_{k+1} - gamma_k and G = sum over other +-gamma_j of [(gamma_k - gamma_j)^{-2} + (gamma_{k+1} - gamma_j)^{-2}]: if D^2 G < 4/5 then Lambda >= ((1 - (5/4) D^2 G)^{4/5} - 1)/(2G). Best found over 1.55e6 zeros to 1e13: Lambda >= -4.2577e-6; superseded by Rodgers-Tao.

nodes.name: Beurling zeta
nodes.statement: Has: Euler product, Lambda >= 0, pole at 1. Lacks: functional equation, integers. Kills: prime positivity + pole without the functional equation.
nodes.lacks: functional equation, integers

nodes.name: BLS: scattering-level Blaschke control. M_B(z) = [xi(z)/xi(z+1)] * prod_j (z - a_j)(z - conj a_j)/((z + a_j)(z + conj a_j)), Re a_j > 0, Im a_j != 0. Equivalently f(z)/f(z+1) with f = xi(z) prod_j Gamma(z + a_j)Gamma(z + conj a_j)/(Gamma(z - a_j)Gamma(z - conj a_j)).
nodes.statement: Has: every p-adic local factor of zeta; M(z)M(-z) = 1; unimodular on Re z = 0; holomorphic in Re z > 0 off z = 1; Maass-Selberg positivity for every T >= 1 (proved, Theorem C of the lane); a zero at each prescribed a_j, anywhere in the open right half-plane. Lacks: a vector at the archimedean place of a group representation; the relation f(z) = f(1 - z) for f itself; a single real Blaschke factor is not covered by the proof (the Moebius step does not preserve the half-plane); the sign is not free (phi = -M fails); on the two-variable affine kernel BLS is not a group object (its passing there is argued). Kills: kills any argument on an Eisenstein/scattering carrier that uses only the cocycle relation, unitarity, holomorphy in the positive chamber and positivity of truncated norms. T-NR with c > 2 and arccosh(c/2)/log q < 1/2 is a case: the factor D(z)/D(z+1), D(z) = q^(z-1/2) + q^(1/2-z) + c, is a convergent Blaschke product over non-real pairs. Pre-filter question Q-B: does the inequality survive multiplication of the scattering coefficient by a Blaschke product over non-real conjugate pairs.
nodes.lacks: a vector at the archimedean place of a group representation; the relation f(z) = f(1 - z) for f itself; a single real Blaschke factor is not covered by the proof (the Moebius step does not preserve the half-plane); the sign is not free (phi = -M fails); on the two-variable affine kernel BLS is not a group object (its passing there is argued)

nodes.name: DEL: thin prime deletion, F = prod over p not in S of (1 - p^-s)^-1 = zeta(s)(s - b)W(s), S a greedy set of primes of density t^(b-1)/log t, 1/2 < b < 1
nodes.statement: Has: Euler product, Lambda >= 0, abs(Lambda(n)) <= log n, prime-power support, ordinary Dirichlet series with coefficients 0 or 1 (completely multiplicative), one simple pole at 1, continuation to Re s > max(b - eta, b/2); simple real zero at s = b; right of b its zeros are those of zeta. Lacks: the functional equation; periodicity of the coefficients modulo any q; unimodular local parameter at the primes of S (it is 0); zeros at non-zero height off the zero set of zeta. Kills: any argument for a zero-free half-plane that uses the target only through prime positivity, size, support, the Euler product, the pole and the integers, without the functional equation or periodicity.
nodes.lacks: the functional equation; periodicity of the coefficients modulo any q; unimodular local parameter at the primes of S (it is 0); zeros at non-zero height off the zero set of zeta

nodes.name: Davenport-Heilbronn function
nodes.statement: Has: functional equation, positive even theta kernel. Lacks: Euler product (first defect at n = 6), Lambda >= 0. Kills: anything using only the functional equation and kernel-side positivity.
nodes.lacks: Euler product (first defect at n = 6), Lambda >= 0

nodes.name: E_a(s) = zeta(s+a) zeta(s-a)
nodes.statement: Has: Euler product, Lambda >= 0, functional equation. Lacks: size normalisation (local parameters p^{+-a}). Kills: anything from explicit formula + positivity + FE without size.
nodes.lacks: size normalisation (local parameters p^{+-a})

nodes.name: EIS-w: Eisenstein series E(z, w') of PSL_2(Z) off resonance (phi(w') != 0), Re w' in (1/2, 1)
nodes.statement: Has: the group, the functional equation, the Euler product, the Hecke algebra: Gamma-invariance, the joint eigen-relation for all T_p with eigenvalue p^(w'-1/2) + p^(1/2-w'), the Laplace equation, moderate growth, an explicit truncated mass (Maass-Selberg). Lacks: phi(w') = 0: the constant term carries both powers y^w' and y^(1-w'); it is not attached to a zero of zeta. Kills: any argument on the modular surface whose inputs are invariance, the joint Hecke eigen-relation, the growth exponent and the truncated mass (it exists for every Re w', so such inputs locate no abscissa).
nodes.lacks: phi(w') = 0: the constant term carries both powers y^w' and y^(1-w'); it is not attached to a zero of zeta

nodes.name: finite modification: finitely many Euler factors changed, e.g. zeta(s)(1 - q^(b-s)) (zeros on Re s = b) or the T-NR twin
nodes.statement: Has: every Euler factor at p > P_0, every tail property of the prime sequence, multiplicative coefficients. Lacks: zeta's local factor at finitely many primes (and, except for T-NR, the functional equation). Kills: any argument whose hypotheses do not change when finitely many local factors change (tail properties, limits in P).
nodes.lacks: zeta's local factor at finitely many primes (and, except for T-NR, the functional equation)

nodes.name: backward heat family e^{tau u^2/16} kappa, tau < 0
nodes.statement: Has: evenness, order one, every kernel-side positivity input. Lacks: any fixed-gamma ordinary Dirichlet series. Kills: every flow-stable hypothesis.
nodes.lacks: any fixed-gamma ordinary Dirichlet series

nodes.name: HQ2: pole-clause twin zeta(s)(1 + eps u^2/(1 - u)^4), u = q^(1/2 - s), q prime, eps > 0
nodes.status: proved (re-derived by two referees for the construction, one for the round-19 addendum); ball enclosures of eight off-line zeros
nodes.statement: Has: zeta's functional equation exactly; ordinary Dirichlet series with integer frequencies; multiplicative coefficients a(n) >= 1 (equal to 1 unless q^2 divides n); Euler product; finite order; the pole of zeta at 1; on-line zeros exactly zeta's. Lacks: the pole clause (pole of order 4 at s = 1/2 and at each 1/2 + 2 pi i k/log q where zeta does not vanish); log-level positivity (nu(q^k) is signed for every eps > 0; first negative k = 13, 22, 38, 67, 212, 669 at q = 2 for eps = 1e-1 to 1e-8); geometric local factor at q; complete multiplicativity at q^2; Ramanujan size at q. Four zeros near each pole at distance (2/log q) Re asinh((eps^(1/4)/2) e^(i pi/4)) from the line. Kills: kills steps that read the functional equation, integer frequencies, multiplicativity and coefficient positivity together without reading analyticity on the critical line or the local Euler shape at every prime.
nodes.lacks: the pole clause (pole of order 4 at s = 1/2 and at each 1/2 + 2 pi i k/log q where zeta does not vanish); log-level positivity (nu(q^k) is signed for every eps > 0; first negative k = 13, 22, 38, 67, 212, 669 at q = 2 for eps = 1e-1 to 1e-8); geometric local factor at q; complete multiplicativity at q^2; Ramanujan size at q. Four zeros near each pole at distance (2/log q) Re asinh((eps^(1/4)/2) e^(i pi/4)) from the line

nodes.name: HQ3: log-positive pole-clause twin zeta(s)(1 - alpha u + u^2)/(1 - beta u + u^2), u = q^(1/2 - s), alpha = q^a + q^-a, beta = q^b + q^-b, 0 < a < b < 1/2
nodes.status: proved (elementary; re-derived by one referee; checked to 1e-60 on the member (5; 0.07, 0.31))
nodes.statement: Has: zeta's functional equation exactly; ordinary Dirichlet series with integer frequencies; Euler product; nu >= Lambda >= 0 on prime powers; a(n) >= 1; zeros of the factor at 1/2 +- a + 2 pi i k/log q. Lacks: the pole clause (simple poles at 1/2 +- b + 2 pi i k/log q; the one with k = 0 is real, in (1/2, 1)); geometric local factor at q. Kills: kills steps that read the functional equation, integer frequencies, multiplicativity and log-level positivity (nu >= 0 or nu >= Lambda) without the pole clause or the local shape at every prime.
nodes.lacks: the pole clause (simple poles at 1/2 +- b + 2 pi i k/log q; the one with k = 0 is real, in (1/2, 1)); geometric local factor at q

nodes.name: HQ4: totally positive pole-clause twin zeta(s)(1 + alpha u + u^2)/(1 - beta u + u^2), same parameters as HQ3
nodes.status: proved (elementary; re-derived by one referee; Edrei's theorem classical, not opened; 24309 minors of order <= 4 non-negative on the member (5; 0.07, 0.31))
nodes.statement: Has: as HQ3 (functional equation, integer frequencies, Euler product, nu >= Lambda >= 0, a(n) >= 1); zeros of the factor at 1/2 +- a + (2k + 1) pi i/log q; local coefficient sequence at q totally positive (Edrei-Thoma form: negative real zeros, positive real poles). Lacks: the pole clause (simple poles at 1/2 +- b + 2 pi i k/log q); geometric local factor at q. Kills: as HQ3, and in addition kills local total positivity of the Euler factor as a separator.
nodes.lacks: the pole clause (simple poles at 1/2 +- b + 2 pi i k/log q); geometric local factor at q

nodes.name: T-NR twin xi(s)(2 cosh((s-1/2) log q) + c), |c| > 2
nodes.statement: Has: multiplicative coefficients, gamma factor, functional equation. Lacks: temperedness at the single prime q. Kills: anything invariant under a local test-vector change at one prime.
nodes.lacks: temperedness at the single prime q

nodes.name: NR-q: T-NR at a base with no rational power, zeta(s)(q^(s-1/2) + c + q^(1/2-s)), q = 1 + sqrt 2, 2 < abs c < q^(1/2) + q^(-1/2)
nodes.status: proved (re-derived by one independent referee); measured at c = 2.1
nodes.statement: Has: zeta's own functional equation exactly; discrete frequencies; integer-frequency part equal to c zeta; Hecke relation at every rational prime on each coset q^j N. Lacks: INT; GEOM, SIZE, POS at the one added generalised prime q; zeros on Re s = 1/2 +- arccosh(abs c/2)/log q. Kills: kills steps that read the coefficients at integers only, or covariance at rational primes only, together with the functional equation.
nodes.lacks: INT; GEOM, SIZE, POS at the one added generalised prime q; zeros on Re s = 1/2 +- arccosh(abs c/2)/log q

nodes.name: NR-vec: local-vector control on the double cover of SL_2. For F a weight-1/2 Hecke eigenfunction of level 4 with coefficients b(m) and q an odd prime: f_q = (F_0 - F x chi_q)/2, F_0 = F - (1/q) sum_{j mod q} F(z + j/q); coefficients b(m) 1[(m/q) = -1]
nodes.status: coefficient statement elementary (re-derived by one independent referee); level relative to Shimura 1973 Lemma 3.6 (not opened)
nodes.statement: Has: the automorphic representation of F; the T_(p^2) eigenvalues of F for p not dividing 2q; vanishing of every square-index coefficient at the cusp infinity, at every parameter; zero constant term at infinity. Lacks: level 4 (it has level 4q^2); the Hecke relation at q. Kills: kills a device that reads theta-orthogonality as vanishing of the square-index coefficients of one vector at one cusp (it holds at every parameter, with no zero of zeta).
nodes.lacks: level 4 (it has level 4q^2); the Hecke relation at q

nodes.name: phase-rotated transfer operator (M -> e^{i phi} M, M -> -M)
nodes.statement: Has: the same spaces, factorisations, norms and Krein form. Lacks: the arithmetic normalisation of the operator. Kills: any property invariant under rotating the transfer operator.
nodes.lacks: the arithmetic normalisation of the operator

nodes.name: block-permuted non-multiplicative Nyman-Beurling family
nodes.statement: Has: the same span dimension and coefficient sizes. Lacks: multiplicativity. Kills: distance or ratio statistics of Nyman-Beurling spans chosen by an arithmetic family.
nodes.lacks: multiplicativity

nodes.name: twisted Selberg zeta Z_{Gamma(2)}(s, chi_{a,b}) (measured, not interval-certified)
nodes.statement: Has: Euler product over primitive geodesics, functional equation s <-> 1-s, real exceptional zeros off the line. Lacks: the integers (additive structure), order one, finite degree, zeta's sign of the zero side. Kills: anything using only an Euler product, a functional equation and a self-adjoint operator.
nodes.lacks: the integers (additive structure), order one, finite degree, zeta's sign of the zero side

nodes.name: SG: real-zero twin zeta(s)(t^2 + b^2)/(t^2 - g1^2), t^2 = s(1-s) - 1/4; zeros 1/2 +- i g1 of zeta replaced by the real pair 1/2 +- b
nodes.status: proved (re-derived by one independent referee); measured at b = 0.3
nodes.statement: Has: zeta's own functional equation exactly; exact prime-power atoms; Lambda_SG <= Lambda (density -2 x^(-1/2)(cosh(b log x) - cos(g1 log x)) <= 0). Lacks: INT, SUPP, POS; real zero at 1/2 + b. Kills: kills steps that use an upper bound for Lambda, or positivity of the atoms only, together with the functional equation.
nodes.lacks: INT, SUPP, POS; real zero at 1/2 + b

nodes.name: thin sign twist: eps completely multiplicative, -1 on a set S of primes with pi_S(x) = (1/2) int_2^x t^(b-1) dt/log t + O(x^(b-eta)), +1 elsewhere; F = zeta(s)(s - b)W(s), 1/2 < b < 1
nodes.statement: Has: complete multiplicativity, unimodular local parameters at every prime, ordinary Dirichlet series, continuation past b, one simple pole at 1, eps(p) = 1 on primes of relative density one; simple zero at s = b (PROVED relative to a short-interval counting theorem: Huxley; ray-class variant relative to Coleman 1990 as quoted; numerics to 1e9, b = 0.9); partial sums c x + O(x^(b+eps)) proved, measured exponent near b/2. Lacks: periodicity of the coefficients modulo any ideal (hence the functional equation of every twist); Lambda >= 0. Kills: any argument for a zero-free half-plane that uses the target only through multiplicativity, local size, continuation and the pole; first unavailable step of the 7/8 proof: periodicity of the target weight (Prop. 5.1 / Lemma 5.8), argued from hypotheses, not replayed.
nodes.lacks: periodicity of the coefficients modulo any ideal (hence the functional equation of every twist); Lambda >= 0

nodes.name: theta^w family (Lagarias-Rains) through zeta at w = 1
nodes.statement: Has: functional equation, pole, positive kernel. Lacks: on-line zeros for w outside a window shrinking with height. Kills: any condition open in the kernel at w = 1.
nodes.lacks: on-line zeros for w outside a window shrinking with height

nodes.name: sign twist Lambda(n) -> eps_n Lambda(n), 0 <= eps_n <= 1
nodes.statement: Has: Lambda >= 0, size, support, Euler product. Lacks: functional equation. Kills: arguments using positivity, size or support of Lambda.
nodes.lacks: functional equation

nodes.name: signed twist Lambda(n) -> eps_n Lambda(n), |eps_n| <= 1
nodes.statement: Has: size, support, Euler product. Lacks: functional equation, Lambda >= 0. Kills: arguments using only |Lambda(n)| <= log n or mean values.
nodes.lacks: functional equation, Lambda >= 0

nodes.name: unimodular twist sum chi(n) n^{-s}, chi completely multiplicative, |chi| = 1
nodes.statement: Has: complete multiplicativity, unimodular local parameters. Lacks: functional equation. Kills: arguments using multiplicativity with unimodular parameters but not the functional equation.
nodes.lacks: functional equation

nodes.name: UNIV: joint universality filter. For pairwise non-equivalent Dirichlet characters chi_1..chi_m (zeta included) and a compact K with connected complement in 1/2 < Re s < 1, the translates (L(s + i tau, chi_j))_j approximate every m-tuple of non-vanishing analytic functions on K for a set of tau of positive lower density
nodes.statement: Has: every property of the L-functions that is a closed condition (sup norm) on a fixed compact window in 1/2 < Re s < 1 with constants independent of height and that holds at all heights (or outside a set of upper density zero); the same jointly with finitely many prime phases p^(-i tau) (hybrid form); continuous inequalities in finitely many values and derivatives at finitely many fixed offsets that hold at all heights hold for every jet (no content); linear combinations of two or more of the L-functions with non-vanishing Dirichlet-polynomial coefficients have at least CT zeros in every sub-strip. Lacks: Re s <= 1/2 and Re s > 1 (right of 1 the corresponding control is U, Kronecker-Weyl); statements non-local in height (t with 2t, positive-definiteness in t, mean values, sums over zeros); families with m growing with T and the conductor aspect; inequalities using s and 1 - conj s together or the completed function (height-dependent through the gamma factor); height-dependent constants or regions; conditions not closed on a compact window; existence statements in short intervals; companions that are not Dirichlet L-functions; effectivity (the heights are not located; a sample up to height 8000 shows 58 of 256 sign patterns). Kills: any step of an argument that is a height-uniform local inequality on values of finitely many Dirichlet L-functions in the open right half of the strip and is claimed to carry arithmetic: it is of class T (true for every analytic tuple), class N (true for every non-vanishing tuple; automatic on zero-free windows, can fail only on a window containing a zero) or class F (false on a set of heights of positive lower density).
nodes.lacks: Re s <= 1/2 and Re s > 1 (right of 1 the corresponding control is U, Kronecker-Weyl); statements non-local in height (t with 2t, positive-definiteness in t, mean values, sums over zeros); families with m growing with T and the conductor aspect; inequalities using s and 1 - conj s together or the completed function (height-dependent through the gamma factor); height-dependent constants or regions; conditions not closed on a compact window; existence statements in short intervals; companions that are not Dirichlet L-functions; effectivity (the heights are not located; a sample up to height 8000 shows 58 of 256 sign patterns)

nodes.name: window translate zeta(s + i alpha_k), alpha_k = 2 pi k/log(T/2 pi); also L(s + i alpha, chi_5) at height T/5
nodes.statement: Has: Euler product with unimodular local parameters, zeta's functional equation in one window. Lacks: the functional equation at all heights (it holds only inside one window, defect about (|alpha| H + alpha^2)/(2T)). Kills: any argument whose functional-equation input is local to one window.
nodes.lacks: the functional equation at all heights (it holds only inside one window, defect about (|alpha| H + alpha^2)/(2T))

nodes.name: ZQ: zero-quartet multiplier twin zeta(s) m(s), m rational in s(1-s) of degree 0; two on-line zero pairs at +-g1, +-g2 exchanged for the quartet 1/2 +- eta +- i (g1+g2)/2
nodes.status: construction and defect bound proved (re-derived by one independent referee); instances measured; second referee owed
nodes.statement: Has: zeta's own functional equation exactly, at all heights; the simple pole at 1; order 1; N(T) for T > g2; every prime-power atom of log zeta (Euler product, GEOM, SIZE read on the atoms). Lacks: INT and SUPP (absolutely continuous signed density D with sup abs D <= 8 e^-2 (eta^2 + d^2)/(1/2 - eta)^2); POS (forced with the pole clause: Lemma L). Kills: kills a device that reads zeta's functional equation with multiplicative structure on the prime-power atoms and not the absence of coefficient mass off log N; if GEOM and SIZE are read on ordinary coefficients the read set is an identification class and ZQ does not apply.
nodes.lacks: INT and SUPP (absolutely continuous signed density D with sup abs D <= 8 e^-2 (eta^2 + d^2)/(1/2 - eta)^2); POS (forced with the pole clause: Lemma L)

nodes.name: ctrl fake genprime unimodular fe
nodes.statement: (1-5T+5T^2)/((1-T)(1-5T)), T = 5^-s: Euler product over generalised primes, unimodular parameters, exact functional equation, zero offset 0.29899. Shows the integers cannot be dropped from any local-defect statement.

nodes.name: Interpolation twin: zeta(s) + c L(s, chi_-4) L(s, chi_5)
nodes.statement: L(s, chi_-4) vanishes at s = -1, -3, ... and L(s, chi_5) at s = 0, -2, ..., so C_c(s) = zeta(s) + c L(s, chi_-4) L(s, chi_5) equals zeta at every non-positive integer for every c. C_c is an ordinary Dirichlet series (integer coefficients for c = 1), has the pole of zeta at 1, finite order and polynomial growth on vertical lines. c = -zeta(s0)/(L L)(s0) puts a zero at any s0 where the product does not vanish. For c = 1 zeros were located at 0.8640996 + 29.9504128i and 0.7552582 + 15.6183212i (mpmath, 30 digits, not interval-certified). It lacks the Euler product and the functional equation.

nodes.name: Control RZ_b: 1/zeta(s + 1 - b), 7/8 < b < 1
nodes.statement: RZ_b(s) = 1/zeta(s + 1 - b) = prod_p (1 - p^(b-1) p^-s) = sum mu(n) n^(b-1) n^-s. Log-derivative coefficients -n^(b-1) Lambda(n): a signed twist of Lambda with |eps_n| <= 1 (control TW-). Meromorphic on C, real zero at s = b (the pole of zeta), functional equation about Re s = b - 1/2 instead of 1/2. Has: Euler product, size, support, continuation. Lacks: Lambda >= 0, the integers (coefficients mu(n) n^(b-1)), symmetry line 1/2. Elementary; stated by the engine in batch 2, not refereed. Answers the open item of lane c1-missing-controls (a twist with a zero in 7/8 < Re s < 1); it needs infinitely many primes, as that lane noted.

nodes.name: Cubic lever: R2 reflection conductor exponent a = 4
nodes.statement: The Poisson dual B_y(D) = sum_n mu(n) nu(n) gamma_2(n) conj(chi_n(y))^2 W(Nn/D) of the cubic Mobius family is the stripped alpha-twisted 6-fold Kubota series at index class y^4. Two derivations and a referee give a = 4, which closes the cubic lever in both frameworks.

nodes.name: Finite-height small-gap deficit matches CUE_Neff
nodes.statement: Pooled gaps s < 0.2 over 1.55e6 zeros near 1e10-1e13: 12834 observed against 13186 GUE (0.9733 +- 0.0088) and 12782 CUE_Neff (1.004 +- 0.009). Replicates Bogomolny-Bohigas-Leboeuf-Monastra. 6.2-6.6% of pairs satisfy D^2 G < 4/5; lambda tail exponent 1.38-1.62.

nodes.name: Arithmetic charge D(r) and measure nu
nodes.statement: d nu=sum_{n>=2}Lambda(n)n^{-1/2}delta_{log n}-e^{r/2}dr; D(r)=sum Lambda(n)n^{-1/2}(r-log n)_+ -4(e^{r/2}-1-r/2), D''=nu. q_W[f]=(1/2pi)int a(t)|f^|^2-2Re int_[0,W) R_f d nu, a(t)=Re psi(5/4+it/2)-log pi.

nodes.name: Curvature cylinder encodes nu but gives no bound
nodes.statement: Metric g=e^{-2D(r)}(dr^2+d theta^2) has K_g dA_g=d nu d theta distributionally. On a lifted triangle total curvature equals D(W), cancelled by boundary curvature: Gauss-Bonnet gives no upper bound. Periodic model D_b has zero total curvature and unbounded weighted charge.

nodes.name: Log-cusp out-fraction f_out(rho) -> 1 - 1/rho at S-units
nodes.statement: At p=2 the out-fraction of the log cusp at rho=2,4,8 extrapolates (Aitken) to 0.5, 0.75, 0.875 with error below 1.1e-7. For S={inf,2,3} the log^2-cusp fractions approach 1-1/rho from below at every S-unit but do not extrapolate rigorously (mean error 5.9e-2).

nodes.name: Exact cutoff energy identity and kernel H_c
nodes.statement: |Q_c A*a|^2-|Q_c A a|^2=-<a,H_c a>, H_c(u,v)=2alpha int_{|c-(u+v)/2|}^inf t kappa(t-(u-v)/2)kappa(t+(u-v)/2)dt, pointwise positive. H_c=B_c*B_c-Delta_c with (B_c a)(s)=sqrt(alpha)int kappa(sqrt(s+(u-c)^2))a(u)du.

nodes.name: S7: Darlington losslessness of the infinite twin ladder
nodes.statement: Prove the infinite twin ladder satisfies Darlington losslessness; H_p(s) = 1/(1 - p^{-s}) is a lossless LC resonator per prime. Related obstruction map row G10 (passive cascade valid only for Re s > 1).

nodes.name: Fail-closed review protocol with mutation tests
nodes.statement: Dependency blueprint with obligation IDs, clean-room transcription of cited theorems by two reviewers, boundary/quantifier attack matrix, independent recomputation, required mutations that must make verifiers reject (e.g. removed conjugation, missing time cell, forged margin), parameter perturbation and calibration against configurations that must fail.

nodes.name: Closed barrier certificate by argument principle
nodes.statement: H_t(z) != 0 for z in [X,X+1] + i[1809/10000, 1], 0 <= t <= 129/800, X = 6000000185827: 883 consecutive closed time prisms with byte-identical seams, boundary mesh with derivative majorants D_z, D_t, aggregate winding interval [-8.95, 8.95]e-13. Uses Polymath Thm 1.3 with error e_A + e_B + e_{C,0}.

nodes.name: de Bruijn contraction law for the zero strip
nodes.statement: If all zeros of H_T lie in |Im z| <= y_0 then Lambda <= T + y_0^2/2; along the flow u = Y^2 obeys u' <= -2, so tau + u/2 is non-increasing. The law carries information from a zero-free strip to Lambda with no converse (map row F3).

nodes.name: Finite final-time lane: row count and binding margin
nodes.statement: 3,149,013 Riemann-Siegel windows N = 690988..3840000 at t_0 = 129/800: T_min = 0.000000791366 (at N = 690988), E_max <= 0.000000233494905, margin >= 5.5787e-7. Families by N-range: P11 (2,3,5,7,11) first, then P7 and smaller prime sets.

nodes.name: Remaining coverage for Lambda <= 0.14

Second-derivative bound C about 2381 fixes the cell width; a phase-aware interval propagation or sharp two-channel functional is needed.

nodes.name: Computer-assisted Lambda <= 0.1787854 (not peer reviewed)

Internal referee: hypotheses (ii), (iii) established modulo cited theorems; heavy lanes rebuilt from source. Companion weaker row 0.1858207.

nodes.name: Freezing part of the heat solution breaks the equation
nodes.statement: If H_tau = A_tau + B_tau then (d_tau + d_z^2)(A_{tau*} + B_tau) = d_z^2 A_{tau*}, non-zero unless A is affine. A fixed zero factor likewise stops dividing the evolved function. Frozen rungs are valid only as a Rouche/Duhamel comparator with an explicit residual bound.

nodes.name: Lower-time candidate Lambda <= 0.1782354
nodes.statement: t_0 = 1607/10000, same X and y_0^2: Lambda <= 891177/5000000. 3,359,013 rows; P13 (2,3,5,7,11,13) on 690988..728999 with minimum 0.000670513304; five-leg Dini height transfer, worst ratio 0.9999999980092249 < 1; barrier inherited as a subset of the 883-prism slab. Local assembly pass, unreviewed.

nodes.name: Collapse time under a real-zero maximum-gap hypothesis
nodes.statement: If every relevant real x has a real zero of H_tau within distance R, then P >= Y/(R^2+Y^2), u' <= -2 - 4u/(R^2+u), and collapse time S_R = u_0/6 + (R^2/9) log(1 + 3u_0/R^2) < u_0/2, giving Lambda <= T + S_R conditionally. Compare the floor-only bound in map row F5.

nodes.name: Cost of a moving barrier collar
nodes.statement: Collar Phi(t,r,s) = a(t) + W r s + i sqrt(y_0^2 + 2(t_0 - t) + W^2 r^2), Phi_t = a'(t) - i/y. A moving-prism gate pays about D_z(|a'| + 1/y_min) Delta t; a lateral wall also needs Re(H_t''/H_t') > a'(t) at boundary zeros. Skipping the first weak window needs average speed above 7.4e7.

nodes.name: Conditional real-rung velocity lemma
nodes.statement: If zeros of H_tau lie in |Im z| <= Y(tau), the boundary zero is simple, the zero-dynamics tail is justified, and real zeros satisfy P_tau(x,Y) = sum_r m_r Y/((x-r)^2+Y^2) >= p(tau,Y): then Y' <= -1/Y - 2p, and d/dtau (tau + Y^2/2) <= -2 Y p. A positive uniform rung contribution strictly improves the de Bruijn law.

nodes.name: Euler-mollified triangle floor bounds |f_t| from below
nodes.statement: f_t = A + gamma C_kappa with A = sum_{m<=N} b_t(m) m^{-s*}, C_kappa = sum m^y b_t(m) m^{-conj s* - kappa}. For the real Euler mollifier E(s*) = prod_{p in P}(1 - b_t(p) p^{-s*}) = sum_{d|D} lambda_d d^{-s*}, exact Dirichlet convolution makes each positive stored triangle value a lower bound for |E f_t| / normaliser.

nodes.name: Mollified approximant stays near 1 below the triangle wall
nodes.statement: Float64 samples of the P13 Euler-mollified f_t at t = 0.130, 0.125, 0.120 (objectives 0.1475354, 0.1425354, 0.1375354), windows N = 690988..4050000: minimum modulus 0.91523, 0.91534, 0.91466, real part within 1e-4 of it. The UNCERT wall below t_0 = 0.1607 is a failure of the triangle majorant, not a collapse of the complex sum.

nodes.name: Polymath Theorem 1.2 barrier criterion
nodes.statement: Lambda <= t_0 + y_0^2/2 follows from: (i) verified zeta height X/2; (ii) H_{t_0}(x+iy) != 0 for x >= X + sqrt(1-y_0^2), y_0 <= y <= sqrt(1-2t_0) (finite windows plus tail); (iii) H_t != 0 on the barrier [X,X+1] x [y_0,1], 0 <= t <= t_0. Output is bounded by verified height.

nodes.name: Dirichlet phases as a Laurent system on the prime torus
nodes.statement: e^{iq log n} = prod_p (e^{iq log p})^{v_p(n)}: the Riemann-Siegel sum is the restriction of a Laurent polynomial in prime-phase coordinates to the one-parameter orbit q -> (q log p)_p. Minimising over the full torus is a conservative closure of the physical orbit; the absolute-value (triangle) majorant discards this structure.
