nodes.statement: At N = 691008 the certified triangle floor is linear in t with dT/dt_0 = 19.05 +- 0.02 and reaches zero 4.8e-7 below t_0 = 129/800; every lower t tried is UNCERT. dE_max/dt_0 is about -1.1e-5. The absolute-value certificate at fixed mollifier cannot lower t_0 materially.

nodes.statement: For N >= N* = 3840000, t in [129/800, 0.161250001]: fixed P1113 mollifier, 153,814 exact convolution coefficients, reduction of all N to one cutoff by monotonicity in log N; Arb at 256 and 512 bits gives D < 0.999721 < 1 and post-error margin > 0.0001735209. Average Riemann-von Mangoldt density is insufficient.

nodes.statement: x_N = 4 pi (N^2 - t_0/16), W_N = [x_N, x_{N+1}). On the target domain the majorants are monotone (d_x G = -(y/2x) G < 0, d_x K < 0), so bounds at window endpoints cover the window; x_690988 < X + sqrt(1 - y_0^2) < x_690989 by exact rational enclosures.

nodes.name: de Branges Hamiltonian / Krein string of Xi + i Xi'
nodes.statement: HB <=> RH for E = Xi + i Xi'. Krein string of length xi''(1/2)/xi(1/2) = 0.0462099862. An off-line quadruple gives exactly 2 negative coefficients (1 mass, 1 length), pinned at the chain end for delta <= 1e-4. a -> 0 gauge limit of the T3 rungs. Obstruction map P7.

nodes.name: de Branges Hamiltonian of Xi + i Xi' restates RH
nodes.statement: Lagarias E = A - iB, A = Xi, B = -Xi' is Hermite-Biehler iff RH. Finite-N chain is the reversed counting-measure Jacobi chain (weights 1/A'(x)^2); H = diag(h, 1-h). E_a(z) = Xi(z + ia) ~ Xi + ia Xi' as a -> 0: H_a positive for every a > 0 is the zero-free-strip ladder T3.

nodes.name: de Branges positivity condition for Euler products with the gamma factor, in a family (RS-3)
nodes.statement: Device under test in lane c11-rs3-debranges-positivity-family (campaign round 11). Lane report of 2026-11-19, author check only: stage A stops; each variant examined is a restatement of a closed row or is false for zeta at a named step (phase balance at every zero; measured). Not yet refereed; node status unchanged until the learn step. Read set RS-3 of STRATEGY v3 section 4.0: positivity that uses the gamma side of zeta together with the Euler product in one step. The device is the positivity condition of de Branges for Euler products with the gamma factor, reported to fail for zeta (Conrey-Li 2000; relative to that source, not on file), and the variants not covered by that failure (a twin-ladder shift, a conductor family). It is an inequality and not the Weil form. First controls: Davenport-Heilbronn, E_a with real a, backward heat. Stage A as for the other round-11 explore lanes. No statement about zeros of zeta.

nodes.name: de Bruijn bound sharp in y_max; count above a height not monotone
nodes.statement: Lambda <= t0 + y_max(t0)^2/2 is sharp as a function of y_max alone (isolated pair z^2 + Y^2 becomes real at t = Y^2/2). The count of zeros above a fixed height is not monotone: {+-0.9i, 0.001 +- 1.3i} goes from 1 to 2 zeros above height 1 by t = 0.02.

nodes.name: de Bruijn family H_t and Dyson zero ODE
nodes.statement: H_t(x)=int_0^inf e^{t u^2} Phi(u) cos(xu) du, H_0(x)=xi(1/2+ix/2)/8 (doubled coordinates, zeros at 2*gamma). dH/dt=-H_xx (backward heat); real zeros obey dx_k/dt=2 sum_{m!=k} 1/(x_k-x_m), repulsive for increasing t.

nodes.name: Local jet lemma: real zeros split real under increasing t
nodes.statement: At a real zero of multiplicity 2m, dH/dt=-H_xx gives the jet e^{-s d^2}x^{2m}, a scaled Hermite polynomial with 2m simple real roots for s>0 and none for s<0 (m=2: x^4-12 s x^2+12 s^2). Conjugate pairs land; real zeros never leave as t increases.

nodes.name: de Bruijn Theorem 13 landing rate
nodes.statement: Zeros of H_{t0} in |Im z|<=Delta lie in |Im z|<=sqrt(max(Delta^2-2(t-t0),0)) at time t; all real by t0+Delta^2/2. With a certified zero-free strip this gives Lambda<=t0+Delta^2/2, the architecture of Polymath15 0.22 and Platt-Trudgian 0.2.

nodes.name: t>0 de Bruijn flow gives no uniform mirror-count lower bound
nodes.statement: The well-posed convolution direction is t<0 (multiplier e^{-tau u^2}); the binding direction t>0 has multiplier e^{+t u^2}, unbounded. The flow spreads spacing, the mirror count M decreases in spacing, so M(t)<=M(0)=2.5288<p_req on [0,t0]. Matches obstruction map F1/F2 (flow-blindness).

nodes.name: DEFL-ORTH-N: collar-free block deflation
nodes.statement: E_{V1 u ... u Vm} = orthogonal sum of B_{U_k} E_{V_k} (U_k later blocks; inner multiplication a Gram isometry); max_k LambdaPerp_k <= Lambda <= sum_k LambdaPerp_k, each LambdaPerp_k <= 1. Every-octave onsets 1.70/3.44/3.56 at m=2/6/16. Collared multi-block reduction is vacuous for N >= 3.

nodes.name: Degree-0 relative operator R = Gpass^{-1/2} Gshear Gpass^{-1/2}
nodes.statement: Scale-invariant reshaping of the Section-26 object, invariant under Phi -> c Phi (tested c = 1..1000 on a 6-profile Gram). In this degree-0 measure the raw diagonal fails to dominate on about 64% of the tau range (deficit profile at U = 6, N = 200).

nodes.name: Two routes to a certified sup|H_t'|
nodes.statement: Route I: differentiated additive cap E_A' + E_B' + E_C0', amplified by about log N = w - (1/2) log 2 over the undifferentiated cap. Route II: Cauchy cap M(r)/r, optimal radius r* = 1/g under M(r) <= M(0) e^(gr). Route I is tighter; panel counts differ by a few percent.

nodes.name: DH-BLIND: Weil-form Euler-blindness radius (conductor 5)
nodes.statement: The Davenport-Heilbronn twin has Weil form >= 0.2080723937 ||h||^2 at 2a <= ln 3 and positive definite through 2a <= ln 11 (6.93e-9), finite-basis positive to a about 1.70, certified negative at a = 1.72 via the zero 0.8085 + 85.699i. Shared object: the gamma factor. Control DH.

nodes.name: Davenport-Heilbronn with zero-free exp-completion
nodes.statement: Every Dirichlet series has a zero-free completion exp(sum_{n<X} ...); for DH the operator identities hold to 3.7e-13 and Rayleigh quotients fall from -3.09 to -52.95 for 2a = 6 to 12, matching the off-line pair term -2(sinh(2 delta a)/(2 delta) - a)^2. Steps before the anchor carry no RH content.

nodes.name: Davenport-Heilbronn = partial Euler product times G
nodes.statement: a(n mod 5) = (0, 1, kappa, -kappa, -1), kappa = 0.2840790438; a(nm) = a(n) a(m) for m = +-1 mod 5, so F_DH = [Euler product over p = +-1 mod 5] x G(s), G supported on integers built from primes = +-2 mod 5. Log-derivative coefficients c(n) vanish on 1031 non-prime-powers <= 3000, 906 nonzero.

nodes.name: Route C: signed superpositions of L(s,chi) mod 5 have off-line zeros
nodes.statement: F=sum eps_k L(s,chi_k), q=5: the FE-pinned sign vector reconstructs Davenport-Heilbronn, with 8 off-line zeros (4 mirrored pairs) in [0.05,1.3]x[0.5,200]; the union of arms has 0. No sign design gives an off-line lower bound.

nodes.name: 440 Dirichlet DH-type twins, conductors 5-49
nodes.statement: For each conjugate pair of primitive characters mod q: F_theta = sum Re(e^{i theta} chi(n)) n^{-s}, e^{2i theta} = omega conj(eps(chi)), omega = +-1; same gamma factor and functional equation, no Euler product. q = 5, T+ is Davenport-Heilbronn. 387 certified Weil-negative at a in [0.36, 3.40]; 53 blind to a = 3.6.

nodes.name: Star discrepancy of zeros from S(T)
nodes.statement: The 1-D Koksma-Hlawka step uses the Kolmogorov-Smirnov discrepancy, which Riemann-von Mangoldt gives as sup|S(T)|/N-type with Trudgian's explicit S(T) coefficient (C_Selberg 2.622 vs placeholder 3.0). A genuine Erdos-Turan bridge fed only by S(T) gives coefficient ~9.98, 26 times the headroom.

nodes.name: Floor exponent p gives half-plane (1+p)/2
nodes.statement: If eps_0(lambda)>=-C(1+log lambda)^m lambda^p with p<1 then zeta has no zeros in Re s>(1+p)/2; p=3/4 gives 7/8, p=0 gives RH. Improved global floors are unproved.

nodes.name: Discrete P_3 pencil is identical to three-place Weil positivity
nodes.statement: The pencil D_S + P_3 <= L_S for S={inf,2} is logically identical to W_{inf,2,3}>=0 on pole-free h, because L_S = Arch - P_2 + D_S and D_S cancels. Adding the next prime to the one-prime Sonine inequality gives no unconditional gain past support ln 3.

nodes.name: Backward Dyson flow is gradient descent of -log Disc
nodes.statement: For dx_k/ds = -2 sum_{j != k} 1/(x_k - x_j): d/ds log Disc = -sum_k xdot_k^2 = -8 sum_{i<j} (x_i - x_j)^{-2} < 0. Disc decreases strictly to 0 and t_c(N) is its smallest positive root; the heat-evolved polynomial gives t_c = H_min^2/8 for the dominant pair.

nodes.name: Heat-discriminant exact-t_c ladder
nodes.statement: A rigorous non-dynamical ladder (discriminant of the heat-evolved polynomial, Dyson interval ladder) gives two-sided brackets on t_c(N) at finite N; redirected at E_coll it sharpens constants and does not cross the C_Lip/C_H wall. OLS projections of t_c (|t_c_proj| ~ 0.0071 at N = 1e4) are not bounds.

nodes.name: Displacement leg of the C_Lip to D_rest field-channel discharge
nodes.statement: The premise |e_{l+1}(t) - e_l(t)| <= eps' g_l(t) reduces by exact telescoping to K_l(t) = 2 sum_{y omitted} 1/(|x_l - y||x_{l+1} - y|) <= eps', bounded by a max-principle confinement bound, gap floor g(t)^2 >= g(0)^2 - 8.05 t, and K_max(t) <= K_max(0)/(1 - eta)^2. No Gronwall or pair-correlation input.

nodes.name: Interval-arithmetic port of the analytic legs of the D_S<=L_S certificate
nodes.statement: The certificate W(h)=Arch(h)-P_2(h)>=9.04e-4 ||h||^2 on pole-free h in L^2(-a,a), 2a<=ln3, was established in double precision. Two analytic legs are ported to mpmath.iv at precision 200, including the floor constant M_2 in [3.3468106480569850, 3.3468106480569851]. The Galerkin eigenvalue leg remains.

nodes.name: D_S <= L_S pencil and the 1.1316 crossing
nodes.statement: Weil positivity on g-support < ln 3 is equivalent to D_S <= L_S (two RH-free functionals). Pencil D_S c = mu L_S c: mu_max < 1 on 2a <= ln 3 (margin 2.84e-3), crosses 1 at 2a* = ln 3 + 0.033 = 1.1316 through an odd vector; negativity sits in the first p = 2 resonance window (8.145, 9.875).

nodes.name: Signed near-frequency pair sum
nodes.statement: Far-frequency interactions are paid by positive block energies; the remaining variance target is one explicit triangular signed near-frequency pair sum plus a signed mean, uniform in height.

nodes.name: Order-5 time derivative of the backward Dyson field scales as gap^-9
nodes.statement: For f_k = -sum_{j!=k} 1/(x_k - x_j), the order-5 total time derivative grows like delta^-9 as the minimum gap delta shrinks toward the collision front; the measured exponent confirms the predicted truncation-error law for interval RK4.

nodes.name: Gap ODE and Gronwall lower branch for the backward Dyson flow
nodes.statement: Squared min gap u obeys du/ds = -8 + 4 B(s) u. With |B| <= beta: u(s) >= m(s) = (g^2 + 2/beta) e^{-4 beta s} - 2/beta, positive up to a horizon T_-(g,beta) ~ g^2/8.

nodes.name: Backward Dyson ODE collision time versus N
nodes.statement: Measured first-collision time |t_c(N)| for N up to 1e6 Odlyzko zeros fits a+b/N (early fit 0.011+5.49/N); pair-ODE t_c=d_min^2/8 (1.776e-4 at N=1e4) agrees with the full flow. Upper bounds on t_c point the wrong way for Lambda<=-t_c+E(N).

nodes.name: Zeros miss the Dyson loop identity by an arithmetic term
nodes.statement: For CUE_N, E[g D] = -1 exactly (beta = 2 Ward identity). Zeta zeros at T about 1e6: Q = -0.9414 +- 0.003-0.004; Q + 1 = c 12 Lambda_B/L^2 with c = 0.434 +- 0.008 over L in [7,12], Lambda_B = 1.57314; equivalent beta_eff about 2.13. Finite-tau runs unfinished.

nodes.name: Height threshold log T0 >= 200 is set by the leading 1/log T0 rate
nodes.statement: A rate O(1/(log T0)^a) needs log T0 >= 200^(1/a): a = 2 gives 14.14, between the peak (13.23) and crossover (20.86) log-heights and below the verified height (28.73). A power rate T0^(-delta) needs log T0 >= 5.2983/delta. No subleading rate is proved for zeta zeros.

nodes.name: Windowed edge statistic of zeros versus Tracy-Widom
nodes.statement: Sliding-window largest-eigenvalue statistic built from zeta zeros shows a systematic deviation above 0.10 from Tracy-Widom beta = 2; follow-ups (Airy-kernel quadrature, Painleve-II F_2) show the comparison is discretisation-limited, not resolved.

nodes.name: E_flow form constant and Gronwall bound are not rigorous
nodes.statement: C_F=(log(T0/2pi)+1)/(2pi)=1.330578 is pinned, but the E_flow form uses an unbounded sum-to-integral step and (T-gamma)(T-gamma') about T^2. Gronwall C_G<=4/B(0)^2=L^2/pi^2=8.57 exceeds the OLS fallback threshold 6.78, so certification depends on input A1 (Theta-persistence, measured 9/9).

nodes.name: E_flow = alpha*E_trunc onset as a fixed point in height
nodes.statement: T0*=A(alpha)(log(T0*/2pi)+1) log T0*, A proportional to the Gronwall constant over alpha*E_trunc; landmarks alpha=1 at N about 1.598e6, 0.01 at 4.623e8, 0.001 at 6.933e9. Joint with the E_coll crossover through the Riemann-von Mangoldt height law.

nodes.name: Knee/inflection crossing depends on the product g = m*s only
nodes.statement: E_flow strength s and ramp-depth multiplier m enter through phi=-ln(1+m s r), so the gap is univariate in g=m s; the crossing fixes g*=0.77765 and s*=g*/m. Against the many-body constant: s*(C_mb)=K C_mb^p, p=1.5493 +/- 8.9e-4, not a simple rational.

nodes.name: Closed form for the E_flow local decay exponent
nodes.statement: With N = (T0/2 pi)(v - 1), v = ln(T0/2 pi): d ln T0/d ln N = 1 - 1/v and q_eff(v) = (1 - 1/v)(1 - 1/(v + ln 2 pi) - 1/(v + 1)), increasing to 1; far-tail E_flow exponent -1 + 3/log N at leading order.

nodes.name: (E-H): cancellation over the non-principal rows below the floor-class high bound
nodes.statement: Device under test in campaign round 8 (lane c8-eh-nonprincipal-row-cancellation; not reported when this node was written). Hypothesis named by c7-probe-format-h-cap: the sum over the non-principal rows u of the high side of the Proposition 2.1 probe is below the floor-class bound H0 (trivial count over u). In the three-input model (square-root level, K-branch, H0) removing H0 gives 1 - 2/r at one row (0, 0, 1); with the source ledger kept the values are 4/5 (G = 0) and 13/15 (polar term kept), that is no gain over the present low floor (first referee, E1). First test of the lane: whether the cancellation is a zero-free statement about the target family (circular, as the K + D input was) or an independent input. Manuscript-level ceiling for sextic rows: abscissa 2/3 (normaliser, map row Z24). No statement about zeros of zeta.

nodes.name: Theorem 4.5: zeta is confined to H^0 + H^2 of every X_0(N)
nodes.statement: On NS(X_0(N)^2), P(x).P(y) = -Tr(gamma_x gamma_y^dagger | H^1) and H^1 is cuspidal; the Eisenstein character (Dirichlet series zeta(s) zeta(s-1)) enters intersection numbers only through degrees d_1, d_2, a form of rank <= 2, which Hodge index does not constrain. Checked with Brandt matrices for 52 primes.

nodes.name: (E-K): vector-specific mean square of reflected marked cubic-theta rows beyond the dual range
nodes.statement: Device under test in campaign round 8 (lanes c8-ek-ff-reflected-rows-exact, c8-ek-theta-second-moment-formula; not reported when this node was written). Hypothesis named by c7-probe-format-h-cap: for the completed marked rows B_m of the Proposition 2.1 probe, Sum over m ~ Q of abs(B_m)^2 << Q^(1+eps) Z^(max(0, k_J, k_P)) when Q P > Z (dual length above the number of rows), for the coefficient vector of the probe itself; in the form with all range losses removed it is restricted to lx >= l (first referee, E3: the unrestricted form contradicts Lemma C for long marks). It is not an l2-l2 operator bound: the Hilbert-Schmidt lower bound max(Q, D) of the reflected row matrix equals the K-branch m + l - 1 of Liu II Lemma 2.4 and holds for every blockwise operator-norm estimate. With the polar term kept, removing the K-loss alone gives the model value 31/36 and no vertex with h > 1. Recalled risk (not opened): sharpness examples of the cubic large sieve use theta-type vectors. No statement about zeros of zeta.

nodes.name: Robin / Nicolas margins are Mertens-governed
nodes.statement: Robin margin e^gamma - sigma(N)/(N log log N) along colossally abundant numbers and the Nicolas primorial margin grow at rates fixed by Mertens-type arithmetic; neither converts to a de Bruijn-Newman or zero-location quantity. Li coefficients lambda_n computed to n = 300 positive (map P16).

nodes.name: Step-4 bridge |Lambda - (-t_c(N))| <= E(N)
nodes.statement: E(N) = E_coll + E_trunc + E_flow bounds the gap between Lambda and the N-particle backward-flow first-collision time; Lambda <= -t_c + E(N), so the bridge needs a lower bound on t_c. Open at the Holder-1/2 shock modulus C_H; E(N) -> 0 is not supplied.

nodes.name: E(N) = E_coll + E_trunc + E_flow bridge surrogate
nodes.statement: E_coll = C_C sqrt(log T0/N) with C_C = (1/8) sqrt(3 pi) (GUE-conditional, C_H = 1/8 ansatz); E_trunc = 3.06e-5 (constant, C_T = 1 idealisation); E_flow unconditional modulo constants. T0 = effective height for zero index N via Riemann-von Mangoldt.

nodes.name: Three-axis elasticity additivity E_CC + E_ET + E_CF = 0
nodes.statement: sigma = E_coll/E_N is degree-0 homogeneous in the amplitudes (C_C, E_trunc, C_F), so the crossing elasticities sum to zero exactly; pair ratio E_CF/E_ET = E_flow/E_trunc; the Gronwall exponent axis obeys E_GEXP = TC_A1_TRAP * E_CF and breaks four-axis additivity.

nodes.name: Explicit E_flow at N* = 1e4
nodes.statement: E_flow = (C_F L/T0) exp(C_G |t_c|) = 1.239487e-3 with Gronwall constant C_G = 2/y_*^2 = 2 (y_* >= 1) away from collision, exponent <= 4.74e-4.

nodes.name: E_trunc tail exponent with Guth-Maynard zero density
nodes.statement: At sigma = 3/4 the Guth-Maynard exponent (30/13)(1 - s) = 15/26 improves on Ingham for the truncation tail; the prefactor is not pinned. E_trunc_pt = 3.06e-5 above T = 3e12 (Ingham), about 6500x below the 0.2 budget, so the improvement does not change Lambda <= 0.2.

nodes.name: Far-tail sigma exponent equals the Riemann-von Mangoldt slope
nodes.statement: Diagnostic (1/2 - p) * 2 log T0 = (1 - sigma)(1 - 1/log(T0/2 pi)) + sigma log T0 deep in the tail: the residual to exponent 1/2 is the log-derivative of the zero-counting density at effective height T0(N).

nodes.name: E(N) floors at the N-independent E_trunc
nodes.statement: In the three-way split E = E_trunc + E_flow + E_coll, E_flow passes under E_trunc = 3.06e-5 at N ~ 1.60e6 and E_coll at N ~ 3.28e9; post-peak decay of sigma(N) = E_coll/E(N) is equivalent to E(N) flooring at E_trunc. Far-tail deficit (1/2 - p) ln N tends to 1/2.

nodes.name: Square-root fold at the sigma peak
nodes.statement: Near the peak sigma = sigma_max - A dx^2, so C_C-elasticity diverges with amplitude K = sqrt(sigma_max(1 - sigma_max)/(2 phi_xx)) = 0.423330; kernel |1/(N sigma_N)| grows by sqrt(10) per decade; the fold disappears in a saddle-node at floor factor 56.9184 (N* ~ 456).

nodes.name: Bridge total E(N) is monotone with floor E_trunc
nodes.statement: E(N) decreases from about 0.5407 at N=2 toward the constant E_trunc with no interior minimum. At the crossover N about 3.28e9 the GUE-conditional headline is E about 6.1258e-5; ratio L_pt/E(N)=1975.2 there and 3558.7 at the sigma<0.1 knee (N about 3.21e11).

nodes.name: sigma(N) peak-then-decay moves no unconditional bound
nodes.statement: The collision term carries the many-body constant C_mb <= 1, known only under GUE universality; the search for an unconditional bound (Selberg, Huxley, GGM approaches) failed. A tighter C_mb lowers the peak and does not move N_max. No handle on E(N) -> 0 follows.

nodes.name: Conditional share sigma(N) = E_coll/E(N) landmark ladder
nodes.statement: In the component model sigma has an interior maximum 0.949429 at N ~ 9.22e5, falls below 0.9 at N ~ 2.57e7, halves near the closed-form N_cross = (C_C/E_trunc)^2-type crossover, and decays with local exponent rising to 1/2. E_coll is the largest term for all N <= 1.6e6.

nodes.name: Surrogate E(N) floors at E_trunc and gives no rate to zero
nodes.statement: E(N) -> E_trunc = 3.06e-5 > 0: E_coll and E_flow vanish but the constant truncation term remains; E_trunc is the only non-negligible term beyond N* ~ 4.72e13. The surrogate cannot supply the Step-4 rate E(N) -> 0.

nodes.name: Shear mass lives at separated endpoints
nodes.statement: For nu_{a,Phi} = pushforward of Phi(u) Phi(v) sinh(a(v-u)) 1_{u<=tau<=v}: ~45% of mass at endpoint gap >= 0.1 for a <= 1, ~54% at a = 10; the diagonal-window fraction is O(eps^2). A diagonal measure sees zero shear mass; a past-future endpoint bridge is necessary.

nodes.name: Endpoint-positivity knife edge at N = 2000, pair 1495
nodes.statement: The first within-step crossing at N = 2000 (pair 1495) is sign-sensitive: one DP45 dt/2 cell has min endpoint gap +1.775e-3 while RK4, BS3 and dense-output interpolants at dt, dt/2, dt/4, dt/8 report a crossing. Collision detection by endpoint sampling is integrator-dependent.

nodes.name: Full Laguerre-Polya heat-majorized approximation is false
nodes.statement: For every t > 0 the statement 'every Laguerre-Polya function has real-rooted polynomial approximants whose heat series is uniformly majorized' is false: for the scaled Gaussian the terms of the heat series at 0 have norm >= 1 and are not summable. Kernel-verified; the Lean probe target was retired as false.

nodes.name: Sharp entropy rate of the split damping model
nodes.statement: For dY=(J-D_sigma)Y dt+sqrt(2D_sigma)dB, D_sigma=diag(sigma I,(1-sigma)I): KL(nu_t|mu)<=e^{-Rt}KL(nu_0|mu), R=2min(sigma,1-sigma), prefactor one, sharp. Balance sigma=1/2 optimizes the rate (Arnold-Erb specialization). No zero-location content.

nodes.name: Contribution bound for hypothetical off-line zeros above verified height
nodes.statement: With T_ver=3.0001753328e12 (Platt-Trudgian), zeros off the line lie at horizontal distance > 2.9994e12 from any window gap and contribute epsOffline <= 2(log(T_ver/2pi)+1)/(pi T_ver)=5.9185e-12 to every eps'(l); 4.1e6 times below the smallest realised record-pair eps 2.43e-5.

nodes.name: Backward-flow persistence window of finite Pick positivity
nodes.statement: eps_0(S) >= mu_S(0)/||G^(-1/2)(dP_S/d eps)(0) G^(-1/2)||_2; on tested node sets W(S) exceeds 1.15e-11 by 5 to 8 orders (nu = {1,2,4}: 2.75e-3). W(S) decays with node count, per-step exponent ~ 12.1 * s_new^(-0.71) in the newest node's log-position.

nodes.name: Epstein twins: Euler-blindness radius
nodes.statement: 27 Epstein zeta functions (12 discriminants, h = 2-4): certified negative witnesses; principal forms a* about log(|D|/4) - 0.13 (1.28-2.60); (2,2,3) has a* <= 0.417 < (ln 3)/2; the lowest off-line zero carries the negativity; D = -23 fails first in the odd sector.

nodes.name: Theorem E: positive modular theta kernel with a positive-time collision
nodes.statement: The Epstein theta kernel of 2m^2 + 2mn + 3n^2 has a real positive-time collision at (t, x) = (0.00592457504282, 191.95462253944); its zeros with beta = 2.0794, 1.0152, 1.6246 give Lambda_E > 1/2. Theta structure without an Euler product admits collisions (floating point).

nodes.name: Epstein zeta twins, class number 2-4
nodes.statement: 27 Epstein zeta functions of binary quadratic forms (same gamma factor and conductor as zeta_K, no Euler product for non-trivial classes) are Arb-certified Weil-negative at support a* <= A; principal forms fail near log(|D|/4) - 0.13 (even sector, measured).

nodes.name: Escape law for the backward flow
nodes.statement: Route 43 left open whether zeros of H_{-tau} leave every strip for every tau > 0 (measured: H_{-1} zero at 5040.39 + 1.41i; heuristic reach tau log(x/4 pi)/2 - 1). The 2026-11 campaign proved it (internal): every horizontal-strip statement true for xi is flow-critical; holds for DH.

nodes.name: Local semicircle law for a deterministic zeta-zero seed
nodes.statement: Layer I of the ESY input taxonomy: a local law for the Calogero-Moser empirical spectral measure resolved to the mean-spacing scale, for the deterministic seed given by zeta zeros. Sub-inputs enumerated; none established.

nodes.name: ESY layer II rigidity ratio is order-unity
nodes.statement: The rigidity ratio consumed by the Dyson-Brownian coupling is order-unity and grows like sqrt(log log T) over the certified window (r drifts 0.3324 to 0.3578). The DBM literature gives this scale unconditionally only for random or regular initial data, not for the arithmetic seed.

nodes.name: Local-law inputs needed to discharge the C_mb conditional
nodes.statement: The many-body Calogero-Moser correction C_mb (imp-486) would need an Erdos-Schlein-Yau type local law for the Calogero-Moser empirical measure, split into three input categories; none is established for zeta ordinates.

nodes.name: ESY rigidity quantity psi_N on unfolded zeros
nodes.statement: psi_N measured for N in {100,...,10000} at microscopic (eta=c/N) and macroscopic (eta=c) scales, bulk and edge (near gamma_1), against the ESY slope -1. Macroscopic scale is the well-posed local-law regime.

nodes.name: ESY rigidity port needs two independent inputs
nodes.statement: Obstacles O1, O3 (derandomisation, equidistribution) lie on an arithmetic axis; O2 (backward flow) on a PDE well-posedness axis. Both inputs are unavailable and their residuals are disjoint, so no single input closes the port. Determinantal CLT is not a weaker citable substitute.

nodes.name: Band-limited variance gap closes as exp(-4 pi W)
nodes.statement: With unconditional Rudnick-Sarnak support the ESY variance residual is N-independent (2.153e-3 at band 2/n). Widening the test bandwidth W reduces it as exp(-4 pi W): factor 4351 per extra band of width 2/3; zero residual only at W = infinity.

nodes.name: E_trunc count integral is not a realness certificate
nodes.statement: The 2/gamma count integral behind E_trunc (3.06e-5 clean, 5.106e-5 corrected) misprices a single admissible deep off-line zero; the operative content is an unported barrier lemma. Explicit density bounds (Chourasiya-Simonic 2025) give about 3.34 at sigma = 3/4, about 1.1e5 times worse.

nodes.name: Truncation floor of the Lambda bridge is frozen by verified height
nodes.statement: E_trunc = 3.0 T^{-0.4} (kappa*=0.4): about 3.06e-5 at T=3e12. Inverse: H_required(E)=(3.0/E)^{2.5}; floors 1e-5, 1e-6, 1e-7 need H about 4.93e13, 1.56e16, 4.93e18. E(N) decays as N^{-0.47} to N about 3.28e9, then plateaus at E_trunc.

nodes.name: E_trunc residual is a realness barrier above verified height, not a zero-density constant
nodes.statement: Explicit zero-density constants are 16.7 times short at sigma=3/4 of what E_trunc<0.2 needs; the E(N) bracket at ledger scale is conditional on barrier-type realness control above T_PT (an RH-flavoured deep-zero lemma). The route returns to verified height. Obstruction map rows S7, F3.

nodes.name: kappa_T locked at 2/5 at the Platt-Trudgian anchor
nodes.statement: With the density tail integrated from T_PT=3e12 at the fixed strip sigma=3/4, the truncation exponent at N*=1e4 is exactly kappa_T=2/5; the tail-integral prefactor is 5, not 3 (E_trunc_pt 5.1e-5 corrected). Ranking: E_flow 1.24e-3 > E_trunc_pt > E_field 5.17e-7.

nodes.name: Euler-anchored heat-time certificate
nodes.statement: Proposal: an anchor with height-independent precision exponent x^{-c} so Prop L certifies depth 2 pi^2 c / L against required T* about C/L. The Euler product enters the anchor (|zeta(s)| >= zeta(2 sigma)/zeta(sigma) allows kappa toward 2; Epstein zeros force kappa >~ 6.3). Test 2 pi^2 c > C not run.

nodes.name: Euler-product bound at t=0 does not transport along the de Bruijn flow
nodes.statement: H_t for t>0 has no Euler product; a lower bound anchored at t=0 does not extend by flow continuity to the continuum t in (0,t0] (NS-RIGID wall). Same content as the coefficient cocycle 2t log m log n being identical for zeta and DH.

nodes.name: Euler product at t=0 plus flow continuity does not reach t>0
nodes.statement: The Euler product exists only at t=0, where the flow-decreasing mirror count is maximal; the uniform bound binds at t=t0 where H_t has no Euler product. Pair-correlation repulsion and gap fluctuations lower M(0). Continuity transports values and derivatives, not multiplicativity.

nodes.name: Euler-aware Weil radius over unitary rung data
nodes.statement: Proposed SDP: Weil positivity over the formal unitary degree-1 rung class, against the archimedean radius 0.9385 and DH's 1.72. The 2026-11 campaign measured class-uniform positivity over tempered local data only to support 0.7228 at conductor 1 (worst case alpha_2 = -1).

nodes.name: Euler-completed Weil multiplier M_X with symbol sigma_X
nodes.statement: For lambda^2 = X, q_lambda[f] = (1/2 pi) int sigma_X(t) |f^(t)|^2 dt: the Weil operator H_lambda is the compression of the Fourier multiplier M_X. sigma_X(t) = Z_X(t) - T_X(t) + tau_X(t), Z_X = 2 Re sum_rho X^{rho - 1/2 - it}/(rho - 1/2 - it), |tau_X| <= X^{-5/2}. Checked on 2,001,052 zeros to 5.2e-5.

nodes.name: Rung data are read from the on-line zeros
nodes.statement: From DH's zeros below 130 (71 on-line, 2 off-line pairs): c(2) = 0.1969085883 recovered at support 1.093 (error 3.2e-12), c(4) = -1.4422324 at 1.606; both off-line pairs together contribute 7e-7 / 1.7e-4. At small support Euler detection and off-line-zero detection decouple.

nodes.name: Euler-detection depth of 440 DH-type twins
nodes.statement: Twins F_theta = sum Re(e^{i theta} chi(n)) n^{-s}, q = 5..49: 387 certified onsets a* in 0.36..3.40; Euler arms never negative. Fit a* about -0.748 + 0.387 log gamma - 0.278 log(beta - 1/2) + 0.278 log q (rms 0.139): onset follows the first off-line zero and root-number phase.

nodes.name: An identity coupling the Euler product to the functional equation at the height of a zero
nodes.statement: Stated need: exactly symmetric structure (Hecke-equivariant dictionaries, torus-valid phase arguments) sees only poles; DH (functional equation, no Euler product) and the MT twin (Euler product, no functional equation) each pass. A valid step must use both at height gamma_0, pointwise.

nodes.name: Euler-product mollifiers do not reach the Mobius reference
nodes.statement: At equal length T^{1/2} no tested Euler-product replacement (range-truncated, Radziwill-Soundararajan blocks, truncated-exp, primorial, GHK hybrid) reaches the Conrey/Levinson reference 0.4876 / 0.4530 / 0.4178 / 0.3972 at T = 1e4 / 1e6 / 1e10 / 1e16 (main-term proxy). Obstruction map P26.

nodes.name: Euler product exists only at t=0 of the flow
nodes.statement: Mirror count M(t) decreases under the forward flow (spacing spreads), so M(0)=2.5288 is the maximum and already 1.73x short of p_req=4.3743. The Euler-product rate covers the measure-zero slice t=0 and one topmost zero; transport to (0,t0=0.1314] fails.

nodes.name: Direct Euler-product evaluation distinguishes zeta from zeta_W
nodes.statement: Premises that resolve a single window exclude zeta_W: RH to the window height has slack 0, and Euler-product evaluation at s = 3 + ic gives |log(zeta_W/zeta)| = 0.33 to 3.6 (measured). The only input class not excluded by the kappa = 1 counter-model is the Euler product evaluated pointwise at the window height.

nodes.name: Lemma E: the Euler product at one height is a torus parametrisation
nodes.statement: With Phi_N(H) = (H log p mod 2 pi)_{p<=N}, n^{-iH} = e^{-i<v(n), Phi_N(H)>}; every Dirichlet polynomial D(H) equals D~(Phi_N(H)); D(kH) = D~(k Phi_N(H)); D(H + tau) = D~(Phi_N(H) + tau (log p)_p). Any consequence of the Euler product at one height alone is torus-valid.

nodes.name: Euler transport flow of -zeta'/zeta
nodes.statement: v(s)=-zeta'/zeta(s)=sum_p log p/(p^s-1) for Re s>1, read as a vector field on (sigma,t). Zeros are simple poles with residue +m: sources of +v, sinks of -v; the pole at s=1 is a source of -v. Inside the strip the prime sum is a numerical proxy only.

nodes.name: l2-to-pointwise constant equals the diagonal reproducing kernel
nodes.statement: On a finite band W of length-L Fourier modes the sharp constant in |f(x)| <= C ||f||_2 is sqrt(K_W(x,x)), an inverse Christoffel function, equal to sqrt(|W|/L) in the DFT picture; it is attained, so no generic duality step improves it.

nodes.name: Tail PSD is already global PSD
nodes.statement: K_a restricted to [L,inf) PSD for some L iff A_a>=0 globally (real analyticity propagates). For each n there is L_{a,n} with all n-point minors positive beyond it, but the threshold depends on n and far-separated cross minors are negative.

nodes.name: Exact de Bruijn integral evaluator and its precision ceiling
nodes.statement: Double precision caps the exact evaluator at x below about 104 because |H_0(x)| ~ exp(-pi x/8); resolving the signal needs about (pi/(8 ln 10)) x working digits, measured with 520-digit BigInt arithmetic.

nodes.name: Theorem 4.13: exactly Hecke-equivariant dictionaries see only pole functionals
nodes.statement: A continuous linear map Theta from test functions to a finite-dimensional space, exactly equivariant for three distinct primes through operators with algebraic eigenvalues, factors through finitely many Tate moments int F x^k e^{lambda x} (Schwartz spectral synthesis + six exponentials). In the modular tower only d(F), d'(F) survive.

nodes.name: Exact H_t collision times in the window x in [20,104]
nodes.statement: Real-zero count of H_t: 10 for t>=-1.75, 8 at t=-2, 6 at -4, 4 at -6, 2 at -20 (pair mergers only). First collision (gamma_9,gamma_10) at t_c=-1.8837 versus two-body -(2 dgamma)^2/8=-1.5641; d(g^2)/dt about 5.78 versus 8; retardation factors 1.20 and 1.26.

nodes.name: Closed device type (round 18, one referee): exact-relation rigidity
nodes.statement: Proposed, untested device type. Question: is there an exact relation that zeta satisfies at defect 0, on a class that excludes the symmetric-factor twins by the support clause and the non-rational local factor by integrality, whose failure set is open in a topology in which the zero set moves continuously, and which a named control fails for a multiplicative reason. Background (round 17, one referee each): positivity of a state is invariant under conjugation by an invertible element, so twins of the form b xi are rejected only by an exact relation; a quantitative identification is target-level; stability reads the functional equation and integrality. Carriers named by the planner: Klein seam identity, spinor square root S causal, Bost-Connes twin ladder. No relation is on file. Not a statement about zeros. Outcome, round 18 (map row X1; one referee): closed. Ordinary multiplicativity replaces no clause of the identifications on file: control HQ2 = zeta(s)(1 + eps u^2/(1 - u)^4), u = q^(1/2 - s), has the exact functional equation, integer frequencies, multiplicative coefficients >= 1 and zeros off the line, with a pole of order 4 at 1/2; TN1 = zeta(s)(1 + q^(3/4 - s)) lacks only the functional equation. State set to closed as a crossing device by the strategy review after round 10 (STRATEGY v3, section 3.1 item 23): c9-mv6-ff-window-exact (exact, pre-registered: the diagonal-level row bound fails in active classes at N = 2 above dual length 3N), c10-ff-completed-rows-692 (run (6, 9, 2), q = 7: completed energy 1.69 to 5.9 times the diagonal; the completed-row law fails with exact inputs; one configuration, no exponent), c10-ff-slot-cross-decomposition (the excess is a cross term over pairs of marked primes and is not target-specific: random multiplicative signs are not separated, 50 of 51), c10-ff-signal-intersection-square (the squared signal is an intersection square for an algebraic reason in genus 1 and holds for fakes with off-line zeros). One referee each. Kept as a bounded model question with no requirement flag: whether the non-principal half of the cube term is bounded once the principal signal is removed; genus >= 2 targets. Reopen as a device only with a low input that does not contain the squared signal

nodes.name: Passivity, prime-delay domination and Weil index coincide over F_q
nodes.statement: For curves, R_a is a finite Blaschke product of degree 2g; the Pick kernel K_a has inertia (2g - nu_a, nu_a) with nu_a = #{zeros with Re lambda > a}; Q_TL is a Toeplitz form of rank 2g. All three approaches are the Caratheodory-Toeplitz theorem for S_n = q^{-n/2} sum alpha_i^n.

nodes.name: Collision-time transfer modulus in the vector-field-error channel
nodes.statement: For flows dx/dt = F_Dyson + e with |e_{l+1} - e_l| <= eps' g_l from the same zero data: |Delta t_c| <= W(eps') = tHi - tLo, dW/deps' ~ 3 H^4/64, N-uniform, no Gronwall or W_1 distance. Bridge re-architecture gives E_field <= 5.17e-7; residual is certifying eps' for the true flow.
nodes.underusedWhy: N-uniform collision-time transfer bound with no Gronwall step; tool for flow comparisons

nodes.name: Two-sided field-Lipschitz lemma of the field-channel reroute
nodes.statement: Zero-gap comparison under the backward Dyson flow needs only |e_{l+1}-e_l| <= eps' g_l for the omitted-zero field error, in both comparison branches; no sign or repulsion of the perturbation enters. Realness plus magnitude suffice (imp-3933 lemma class).

nodes.name: Four walls of the fifty-routes campaign
nodes.statement: 22 of 50 routes reduce to one of four walls: pointwise (averaged or modulus-only inputs carry no every-window information), verified height, flow-blindness (SL2-class soft hypotheses), RH-equivalence (object restates RH, GRH or the explicit formula). Other classes: method-cap, Euler-blind, consumes-zeros, measurement.

nodes.name: Fifty-routes synthesis: wall census
nodes.statement: Of 50 routes, 22 reduce to a known wall (verified height 9, RH-equivalence 8, pointwise 6, flow-blindness 3), others to Euler-blindness or method caps; 18 produced new objects. Lambda ledger: 0.145276368594868 without the half-plane, 0.116091488672439 with 7/8 (both conditional).

nodes.name: Curvature lower bound c(N) for the finite-N shock-Lipschitz surrogate
nodes.statement: A certified c(N) <= |u_0''(z_0*; y_N)| at the shock point of the mollified Riemann-von Mangoldt density would make C_H(N) = sqrt(2/c(N)) effective. Derived in form and cross-checked by off-axis Cauchy quadrature; no certified bound.

nodes.name: Finite-height stand-in for the Holder-1/2 shock modulus
nodes.statement: At strip floor y_N = sqrt(2 pi/N) the Burgers shock footer stays off the real axis and C_H(N) = sqrt(2/|u_0''(z0*; y_N)|) is finite; needs a certified curvature lower bound, simple-shock non-degeneracy and a finite-strip fold inversion. Valid only up to T*(N); the limit y_N -> 0 reinstates the divergence.

nodes.name: Finite-N remainder for the collision term
nodes.statement: E_coll_true = C_C sqrt(log T0/N)(1 + err(N)) with bounded err needs: effective C_H provenance, explicit-rate local law, restricted-to-full Fourier support, height threshold, assembly. At full support the second is Montgomery's conjecture with a rate. Literature has asymptotic rigorous results or heuristic finite-T terms only.

nodes.name: Real Pick positivity at three to six nodes
nodes.statement: [P_L(x_i,x_j)] is positive definite for distinct positive nodes at sizes 3 (PR 48), 4 (PR 50), 5 (PR 53), 6 (PR 55). Bounded-range parts use zero verification to 3e12; x>=100 uses digamma and prime-series bounds. No inductive step; arbitrary order open.

nodes.name: Rigidity of prime weights under positivity
nodes.statement: Psi_eps(r)=Psi(r)-sum_j eps_j(|r|-l_j)_+ at finitely many positive delays: unless all eps_j vanish some dyadic-cell matrix has a negative direction. Prime-2 increase at k=4,m=256, support 16 log 2: 0.000010685379<eps_*<0.000010685380. Zero-delay compensation is excluded from the hypotheses.

nodes.name: Route 30: finite-support rung Euler detector
nodes.statement: A ladder-native quantity separating zeta from Davenport-Heilbronn at support below 3.44, with sharp onsets and certified witnesses; it detects the Euler product only as a multiplicativity test. Route 44: the Weil form's own detection depth follows the twin's root-number phase and first off-line zero (fitted, heuristic).

nodes.name: Residual R_A between first-collision time and its Stieltjes proxy
nodes.statement: R_A(N) = |t_c(N) - 1/(2 M_inf(N))|; transfer of limsup = 0 to the true t_c holds conditionally on R_A(N) <= C_HO/(L N^(3/2)). Not the binding obstruction: closing it moves no bound.

nodes.name: First radix layer carries the full criterion
nodes.statement: RH iff sum_{p<=N}[C_p(N)-(N-p)]log p>=0 eventually. Radical Mellin kernel K(s)=((s-1)zeta(s)-1)/(s(s+1)), K(1)=0, K(rho)=-1/(rho(rho+1)); higher-radix tail H_N>=0, H_N ~ -zeta(1/2)N^{3/2}/3.

nodes.name: First reduced theta kernels n_a, b_a
nodes.statement: n_a+a b_a=J, a n_a+4b_a''=p(a)kappa, J(t)=(1/4)int_{|t|}^inf v kappa(v)dv, p(a)=F'(a)/F(a). p>0, p'(a)=Var_a(v/2)>0, p(a)/a strictly decreasing. For t>=3 with x=pi e^t, u=-kappa'/kappa: x-3<u<x, Q=u/t>19, Q'>0.

nodes.name: sigma=1/2 as a phase boundary only in complex temperature
nodes.statement: zeta is smooth through sigma=1/2 on the real axis (zeta(1/2)=-1.4603545), so no real-beta transition exists there. The Fisher zeros of the primon partition function are the nontrivial zeros; 'condensation on Re beta=1/2' is RH restated and gives no lever.

nodes.name: Five-shell identity for E_97 over the 25 primes <= 97
nodes.statement: Unconditionally, E_97(N, A, c) = (1 - A) L_N(Y_4) - A sum_{g=1..4} L_N(Z_g), with primes <= 97 in decreasing order cut at (0,5,10,17,25) and shells of disjoint Fourier support (Z_g orthogonal to each other and to Y_4).

nodes.name: Five-shell P97 identity on a finite Fourier model
nodes.statement: The 25 primes p <= 97 are cut into blocks of sizes 5,5,7,8; the sieve projections Pi_p are commuting self-adjoint diagonal projections; the sieved vector telescopes as v = Y_4 + sum_g Z_g over five Fourier-disjoint, hence orthogonal, shells.

nodes.name: No N-decaying truncation tail at fixed verified height
nodes.statement: The truncation height H has two parameterisations: fixed H=T_PT gives a floor with no N-dependence; coupling H to N requires zero information above verified height. Neither gives an N-decaying tail, so E(N)->0 is not available unconditionally.

nodes.name: Fixed-strip decaying tail = growing verified height
nodes.statement: A fixed positive decay exponent kappa* for the truncation tail is only valid under a Platt-Trudgian-strength all-zeros-in-strip certificate to that height; E(N) -> 0 requires verified height to grow with N.

nodes.name: Fixed-support completed Weil symbol V_L
nodes.statement: V_L(t)=Re psi(1/4+it/2)-log pi-2 sum_{n<=e^{2L}}Lambda(n)n^{-1/2}cos(t log n)+[2 sinh L cos(2Lt)+4t cosh L sin(2Lt)]/(t^2+1/4); Q_L[f]=int V_L|f^|^2 for f supported in [-L,L]. Pole completion appears once.

nodes.name: Flat-window diagonal = height-modulated V7 discrepancy (Lemma 4')
nodes.statement: With D_alpha(L) = sum_{n<e^L} Lambda(n) n^{-1/2}(L - log n) cos(alpha log n) - int_0^L e^{r/2} cos(alpha r)(L - r) dr and Z_alpha(L) = sum_rho m_rho (2 sin((gamma_rho - alpha)L/2)/(gamma_rho - alpha))^2, the window Gram diagonal is expressed through D_alpha; alpha = 0 is the atlas discrepancy. Measured to 1.3e-6.

nodes.name: Flow-blindness no-go (Lemma SL2)
nodes.statement: Phi_eps(u)=exp(-eps u^2)Phi(u) stays even, positive, log-concave, doubly-exponentially decaying, yet H_{-eps} has a non-real zero for every eps>0 (Rodgers-Tao). No hypothesis stable under small backward heat flow proves RH. Lean-checked with Lambda>=0 as hypothesis. Matches the HEAT control.

nodes.name: Flow-criticality degree kappa(P) = sup Lambda
nodes.statement: Grades a hypothesis P by the largest Lambda it allows. Witness Lambda((z^2 + Y^2) cos(cz)) = (sqrt(1 + 4c^2 Y^2) - 1)/(4c^2); kappa(strip) = 1/2, kappa(QRH_theta) = (2 theta - 1)^2/2 (7/8: 9/32); proportion and density inputs add nothing; W_T >= 0 gives T^2 kappa_low -> 0.349.

nodes.name: Graded flow-criticality kappa(P) = sup Lambda
nodes.statement: kappa(P) = sup{Lambda(F) : F in P} over the de Bruijn class. kappa(Strip_Y) = Y^2/2 without Phi > 0: critical strip 1/2, QRH 7/8 gives 9/32, QRH 11/12 gives 25/72. Proportion, zero-density and 'all but finitely many on the line' add no kappa beyond their strip.

nodes.name: Flow-criticality degree kappa(P) = sup Lambda(F) over F in P
nodes.statement: For a property P in the de Bruijn class, kappa(P) is the largest de Bruijn-Newman constant compatible with P. Theorem G1 (Lean, abstract): if F and F_{-tau} are in P then Lambda(F) + tau <= kappa(P). kappa = 0 means P implies RH class-uniformly; soft classes have kappa = infinity.

nodes.name: Fold curvature diverges as eps^{-5/2} at the real axis
nodes.statement: For the Hölder-1/2 (RvM cusp) density, |m''(z_0*)| about K eps^{-5/2}: measured log-log slope -2.5000, eps^{5/2}|m''|->3.3322. The curvature floor required by H3 is not uniform before renormalisation.

nodes.name: Fold law |t_c(N)| >= g_min(N)^2/8
nodes.statement: d(g^2)/ds >= -8 for every adjacent pair gives a first-collision lower bound; any exponent improvement over the 1/log^2 density surrogate is a small-gaps theorem g_min/y_N -> 0. Min-gap sandwich: under beta g^2 < 2, T_- <= t_c <= T_+; Theta <= 1/4 is forward-invariant, t_c <= g^2/6.

nodes.name: N-growth exponents of the open Stieltjes boundary tower
nodes.statement: At the reading strip eps=y_N=sqrt(2pi/N) the k-th derivative row carries weight w_k(N)=(N/2pi)^{1/4+k/2}: selection (k=0) 1/4, H4 (k=1) 3/4, H3 (k=2) 5/4. H3 is the largest at every N in 1e3..1e9.

nodes.name: The every-height requirement cannot be weakened to most heights
nodes.statement: The barrier contract is a supremum at a single anchor cell, so a pair-correlation statement valid for most T does not meet it.

nodes.name: ESY variance gap closes only with full form-factor support
nodes.statement: N-independent residual 2.153e-3 in the variance: widening the Fourier band W leaves residual ~exp(-4 pi W) (4.38e-5 at W=1); strict closure needs full support (Bogomolny-Keating); 4-point input reduces it by zero. All live ESY routes need Montgomery pair correlation.

nodes.name: Four equivalent closure routes for Delta=0 (Section 16)
nodes.statement: Equivalent for all a>0: (A) |xi(s-a)|<|xi(s+a)| for Re s>1/2; (B) shifted bridge kernel K_a PSD on C_+; and two further forms (C), (D). Each is RH-equivalent; they share one bottleneck.

nodes.name: Theorem 16.1: closure routes A/B/C/D are one problem
nodes.statement: Schur contractivity |X(w-a)/X(w+a)| < 1, de Branges positivity K_a PSD, hidden-square factorization and the Weil / twin-ladder norm square Q_TL >= 0 are equivalent (Delta = 0). Route A is circular without a zero-free region. Obstruction map P1, G2.

nodes.name: Fourth Pick stage as two Schwarzian signs
nodes.statement: With h(u)=L(sqrt u)/sqrt u and j(u)=u h(u): under strict three-node hypotheses, four-node positivity for all node positions is equivalent to 2h'h'''-3(h'')^2>=0 and 2j'j'''-3(j'')^2>=0 on u>0. Both hold strictly for xi. Kernel recurrence alternates R=zU/V and R=U/(zV).

nodes.name: Arithmetic freeze-flow H_{t,tau}: Lemma M
nodes.statement: Multiplicative prime couplings give zero force or a rigid translation; the additive FE-preserving freeze force is a Riemann-Siegel partial sum with no universal confining sign; pencil confinement is interlacing (Hermite-Kakeya-Obreschkoff), RH-strength. Obstruction map F2.

nodes.name: Schur-complement freezing preserves negative index (Prop 23.2)
nodes.statement: Freezing as Schur-complement (Feshbach) reduction of the bridge Gram keeps the inertia: ghosts move, they do not vanish. Endpoint bridges repair only finite-window positivity (Lemma 23.3).

nodes.name: Freezing as inertia-preserving reduction (section 23)
nodes.statement: Freezing a finite window of the ladder preserves inertia and gives finite-window certificates; it is not a proof step. The actual target is passive frozen-bridge closure (Conj 23.5) surviving U -> inf, W -> C_+, a -> 0.

nodes.name: Baker bounds and finite Turan power-sum bounds depend on the frequencies log n only
nodes.statement: A lower bound for a linear form in logarithms of primes, and Turan's first and second main theorems applied to sum a_n n^{-s}, use the exponents log n and the number of terms, not the coefficients a_n. Each holds with the same constants for DH, every sign twist, THIN, U and WT. For integers m != n the bound abs(log m - log n) >= 1/max(m,n) is the Montgomery-Vaughan spacing input (mean values). For S-units with k primes Baker gives a gap >= (log n)^(-C_k); measured exponent for S = {2,3,5,7} up to log n = 80 is between 2.9 and 3.4 (pigeonhole value k - 1 = 3).

nodes.name: Port of the Fresnel-Airy packet envelope into the seam pencil family
nodes.statement: The RZ-PEN / DR-M machinery uses the Cauchy-Gram structure of exponential systems; the Airy envelope has a non-L2 algebraic tail on one side and breaks it. Split verdict: phase half scoped, LEG B envelope domination open; fixed-window deciders exhibit an indefinite straddle of DELTA_A.

nodes.name: Theta derivative-energy operator: no symmetry, no sectorial bound
nodes.statement: The natural unbounded operator behind the theta derivative energy fails symmetry and every finite-angle sectorial estimate unconditionally; hypothetical off-axis zeros give explicit graph defects in the adjoint domain. Heat smoothing changes each pole's Gaussian multiplier but removes no pole at finite time.

nodes.name: gcd factorisation of the Vasyunin Gram Frobenius norm
nodes.statement: ||G_N||_F^2 = Sum_{gcd(a,b)=1} I(a,b)^2/(a^2 b^2) Sum_{g<=N/max(a,b)} 1/g^2, so T(N) <= ||G_N||_F^2(interior) <= zeta(2) T(N) with T(N) the coprime-core second moment. Diagonal part I(1,1)^2 zeta(2) = 2.614. Measured R(N)=||G||_F^2/T(N) tends to zeta(2) at rate 1/log N.

nodes.name: Conjecture 22.1 frozen-ladder obstruction (map row P30)
nodes.statement: For Phi_fr = sum_j e^{-alpha_j u^2} P_j(u^2) with coefficient dimension D, the Fourier transform has at most 2D - 2 real zeros, so matching sign changes of Xi up to Platt-Trudgian height needs D of the order of the zero count. Modulated variants: Nyquist floor U ~ (1/2) log(T0/2 pi) - 1/2.

nodes.name: Frozen-rung <=> Platt-Trudgian
nodes.statement: Freezing twin-ladder rungs is the verified-height certificate in operator form: by Sylvester inertia frozen-rung certificates cannot beat verified height, and PT is the winding form of the frozen-rung index certificate. Converse conditional on (ZR).

nodes.name: Frozen rungs = Platt-Trudgian; inertia cannot beat verified height
nodes.statement: ind_-(K_{R_a}) = number of xi-zeros with Re lambda>a (Krein-Langer). Schur-complement freezing preserves negative index (Sylvester), so a frozen-rung certificate on a finite mesh never exceeds verified height. Full equivalence with PT is conjectural (lemmas L1 tail leakage, L2 mesh resolution). Map rows Q6, S7.

nodes.name: Frozen-rung winding count identity and inertia gate
nodes.statement: Counting identity relating numerator, denominator, central, ghost and band counts (winding_count_identity); critical-line iff no uncancelled ghosts; negative index of a shifted-bridge Gram matrix bounds the number of negative squares (gram_gate_sound); Blaschke/Schur-kernel leakage bounds. Frozen rung is equivalent to the Platt-Trudgian verified height.

nodes.name: Function-field twin-ladder Weil form = minus intersection form
nodes.statement: For C/F_q of genus g, Gamma_j the graph of Frobenius^j on C x C and P_j = Gamma_j - H - q^j V: G_jk := q^j + q^k - Gamma_j.Gamma_k = -P_j.P_k = q^{(j+k)/2} S_{k-j}. Q_TL >= 0 is the Hodge index theorem; B(c) = sum c_j q^{-j/2} P_j gives Q_TL[h] = ||Bh||^2.

nodes.name: Raymond chain G0 unrefereed
nodes.statement: AF Part I/II, Lemmas 2-3, Theorem 4/4', G0-c and G0-d (OP) have internal review only. G0 is the binding premise of both sub-0.2 values (0.1452..., 0.1160...). G0-c and G0-d are not formalised; Lemma R is Lean-checked conditional on AF (4.6) and Phi' = Re beta_t.

nodes.name: G6a shock-Lipschitz: Hölder-1/2 blow-up modulus, hypotheses H1-H5
nodes.statement: H1 smoothness (analyticity of m on C_+, discharged); H2 non-degenerate fold (pointwise via Privalov-Sokhotski); H3 uniform curvature (open); H4 strip-height uniformity as y_N=sqrt(2pi/N)->0 (open); H5 Riemann-Hilbert transcription: pointwise dischargeable, open uniformly in N.

nodes.name: G6a shock-Lipschitz modulus: two surviving routes
nodes.statement: W_1-channel C_Lip diverges (imp-2640). Route M: mesoscopic modulus, residual y2-adapted flow depth plus pair-separation extension. Route F: field-channel transfer modulus certified on N in [1e4,1e6]; residual is an N-uniform Lipschitz certificate for the true xi heat-flow field error.

nodes.name: Shear-invariance orbit classification is complete for the K_a softening levers
nodes.statement: For the exponential-shear scalar-multiplier metric pair (imp-3066) the remainder norm ||R|| depends on one variable s = a*U; the coefficient c and decoupled rate b span the transverse plane and are inadmissible. Truncation degree raises ||R||; Legendre/Chebyshev bases and non-exponential multipliers give no softening. K_a >= 0 stays open (RH-equivalent).

nodes.name: Signed network gain G_L(eps)<=1
nodes.statement: Exact decomposition Q_L=B_L-C_L with B_L,C_L>=0: G_L(eps)=sup_f C_L[f]/(B_L[f]+eps|f|^2), and G_L(eps)<=1 iff Q_L>=-eps I. Required for all supports and arbitrarily small eps>0.
nodes.closedBy: P10 (bound with slack is the target)

nodes.name: Positive bulk realization of the gamma symbol
nodes.statement: With a_0=a(0), b_m=2m+5/2: G[f]=A[f]-a_0|f|^2=inf_{(u_m)}sum_m (2/b_m)(|f-u_m|^2+b_m^{-2}|u_m'|^2), u_m=b_m^2(b_m^2-d_x^2)^{-1}f. Realizes the gamma part exactly; the signed arithmetic boundary defect remains. Off-diagonal prime deltas obstruct a local scalar Dirichlet-to-Neumann model.

nodes.name: Gap-domination bootstrap: two-sided t_c enclosure on N in [1e4, 1e6]
nodes.statement: On each H_raw plateau with horizon T = H^2/(8 thetaBar), thetaBar = 0.99: d(g^2)/dt <= -8 theta, so H^2/8 <= t_c <= H^2/(8 theta) and 0 <= F_mb <= (H^2/8)(1/theta - 1). Deterministic, RH-free, certified on all 10 plateaus given the zero table.

nodes.name: Gap ODE y' = 8 - 4 S y and exact reserve
nodes.statement: For adjacent real zeros a < b under the flow, y = (b-a)^2 satisfies y' = 8 - 4 S y, S = sum_{r != a,b} 1/((b-r)(a-r)) >= 0; the lattice s Z is the equilibrium (S = 2/s^2). Reserve R(a0,T) = e^{-4 int S} y(a0) is the whole margin of a no-collision certificate.

nodes.name: Two-point gap structure function S_2(r)
nodes.statement: S_2(r) = mean_k (g_{k+r} - g_k)^2 on the first 1e6 zero gaps is a smooth function of separation r; proposed as a two-point x-difference modulus object for the shock front. Diagnostic only.

nodes.name: Gaussian convolution of H_0 is the exact flow at negative time
nodes.statement: Convolving H_0 with a Gaussian of width sqrt(2 tau) equals H_{-tau} (Fourier multiplier e^{-tau u^2}); in the repo ordinate gamma=x/2 this is t=-4 tau_repo. Checked against the exact integral: relative deviation 2e-9 (tau=0.5), 6e-9 (tau=2).

nodes.name: Gauss-Plancherel lemma for additive-character aliases
nodes.statement: For p prime and S_chi = sum Lambda(n) chi(n) K(n): A_h = (1/(p-1))[-S_chi0 + sum_{chi != chi0} chi(h) tau(chibar) S_chi], and sum_{h=1}^{p-1} |A_h|^2 = (1/(p-1))[|S_chi0|^2 + p sum_{chi != chi0} |S_chi|^2]. Verified to 1e-12 at p = 7, 13, 97.

nodes.name: Gaussian subordination H_t(z) = E[H_s(z + i sqrt(2(t-s)) G)]
nodes.statement: For 0 <= s <= t and G standard normal, H_t(z) = E[H_s(z + i sqrt(2(t - s)) G)] (order-1 functions), with Euler tilts of each Dirichlet term.

nodes.name: Impulse systems with balanced charge but drifting displacement
nodes.statement: Constant curvature with one unit downward slope jump per block at relative time r: D_j(1)=0 but E_j(1)=1/2-r (drift -1/4 at r=1/4, +1/4 at r=3/4). A refinement with a(t)=e^{t/2} and ceil(e^{2j}) jumps keeps finite diagonal loss. Equal charge does not determine displacement.

nodes.name: Genuine field nonvanishing box through time zero
nodes.statement: G(t,x)=H_t(x)+iH_x(t,x) is nonzero on [0,1/2]x[200,220] with exact zero boundary winding (194 derivatives, 24 boundary segments, 90 interior cells, 384/512-bit). Excludes simultaneous H,H_x zeros there only.

nodes.name: Zero ghost count above 3e12 is an assumption
nodes.statement: The earlier asymptotic Lambda <= 7.98e-4 candidate implicitly assumed ind_-(K_{R_a}) = 0 above the verified height; the composition breaks there. The later 3.06e-5 chain is conditional on the Polymath15 shock-Lipschitz step (G6a).

nodes.name: Common-zero cancellation at one fixed shift
nodes.statement: At a fixed shift a, R_a=X(w-a)/X(w+a) has pole order [m(rho)-m(rho-2a)]_+ at rho: common zeros cancel. Critical-line unimodularity holds without RH; a zero row is compatible with PSD. One fixed width is not RH-equivalent without the multiplicity condition.

nodes.name: Ghost-zero witness
nodes.statement: A zero 1/2 + delta + i gamma with delta > 0 gives, for every 0 < a < delta, an interior zero of E_a at -gamma + i(delta - a), certifying failure of bridge positivity. One inverse Blaschke ghost = one rank-one negative square of the bridge kernel (Krein-Langer / Pontryagin index). Obstruction map G6/Q6.

nodes.name: Normalized Gibbs data cannot fix an absolute spectral floor
nodes.statement: Normalized Gibbs data are invariant under H -> H-cI, while an absolute spectral floor shifts by -c. Positive covariance or critical susceptibility therefore cannot determine the absolute Weil lower bound.

nodes.name: Worst case over the Ramanujan box is a vertex
nodes.statement: lambda_min of the Weil form is concave in the rung amplitudes, so over |lambda_f(p)| <= 2 the worst case is a vertex (lambda(p) = +2). If c0(k,N) = log N - 2 log 2 pi + 2 psi(k/2) > sum_{n<e^{2a}} 4 Lambda(n)/sqrt n then W >= 0; holds for every weight >= 36 at 2a <= log 3.

nodes.name: Ramanujan is RH per rung, not for the ladder
nodes.statement: For p not dividing N the 11a rung is 1/P_1(p^{-s}) with P_1 the H^1 factor of Z(E_p,T) (Hasse = curve RH); for weight k > 2 the rung lies in H^{k-1} of the Kuga-Sato variety (Deligne). Provable ladder statements are conductor-driven and Euler-blind (weight-24 non-eigenform also certified).

nodes.name: GL(2) twin ladder: Ramanujan per rung, not for the ladder
nodes.statement: 11a: W >= 3.2528e-8 ||h||^2 at 2a <= log 16; Delta: 6.8856e-11 at log 7. The no-Euler-product twin Delta E4^3 (off-line zeros delta = 0.186 at gamma = 52.3) is certified positive to log 7. Rung unitarity = Hasse / Deligne; this does not give GRH for the ladder.

nodes.name: Weil symbol of a holomorphic newform
nodes.statement: For weight k, level N, trivial character: W(h) = (1/2 pi) int sigma |h^|^2, sigma(t) = log N - 2 log 2 pi + 2 Re psi(k/2 + it) - sum_{log n < 2a} 2 c(n) n^{-1/2} cos(t log n); no pole terms; N enters only as + log N ||h||^2.

nodes.name: Full-precision Glaisher constant needed past dps 30
nodes.statement: Ladders using a 17-digit Glaisher literal saturate near 4.7e6 terms at dps 36; with a consistent full-precision log A the fitted cap-scaling exponent gap 0.240 vs 0.215 reduces to jitter. Numerical check rule for any Glaisher-Kinkelin based ladder.

nodes.name: Discrete moment J_1 of |zeta'(rho)|^2
nodes.statement: J_1(T)=sum_{gamma<=T}|zeta'(rho)|^2 converging toward N(T)(log T)^3/12-type growth (Gonek-Hejhal); R_4 of zeros matches the GUE determinantal kernel.

nodes.name: Griffin-Ono-Rolen-Zagier Jensen hyperbolicity
nodes.statement: For each fixed degree d, the Jensen polynomial J^{d,n} is hyperbolic for all sufficiently large shifts n (all n for d <= 8); not all (d, n). Obstruction map P17.

nodes.name: Gram-law fractions 1e8 to 3e13
nodes.statement: Gram-law fraction / bad-Gram rate: 0.7292/0.1715 at 1e8 falling to 0.7007/0.2112 at 1.5e13-3e13 (451,291 Gram points); 18 Rosser violations. Violation density predicts neither binding floors nor barrier difficulty (|rho| <= 0.31): the binding floors are torus suprema with no height coordinate.

nodes.name: Graph compression of direct and dual ladders gives no cancellation
nodes.statement: For W_U v = 2^(-1/2)(v, Uv), W_U*(R_+ + R_-)W_U = (R_+ + U* R_- U)/2. Characteristic invariance forces U* R_- U = R_+ (no gain). Cancelling the anti-Hermitian part needs spec(A_+) symmetric about 0; one nonzero odd moment tr(A_+^k) excludes it.

nodes.name: GUE-conditional collision term dominates the Lambda bridge error
nodes.statement: Peak share sigma_max = 0.949 near N about 9.2e5. d sigma_max/d log E_trunc = -0.019 (tightening the unconditional floor raises the conditional share); d sigma_max/d log C_C = +0.048. Landmarks: sigma=0.25 at N about 3.26e10, sigma=0.01 at about 4.62e13, elasticity about -2.09 in E_trunc.

nodes.name: GUE Palm density at a coalesced pair
nodes.statement: GUE Palm density given a coalesced pair: rho(u) = 1 - S^2 - 3 S'^2/pi^2 (S the sine kernel), deficit integral exactly 2 (Parseval). Linearised zero-ODE mode rate (4/s^2)(pi theta/2 - theta^2/4). Mirror count 3.021 against required p_req = 4.3743.

nodes.name: Zero-spacing statistics against GUE near the 921860th zero
nodes.statement: Window of 100001 real zeros at height 5.57e5: max pdf residual 0.049, KL 0.00143, KS sup-distance 0.012591 (at unfolded spacing 0.6286). The crossover height 1.14e9 is about 1905 times beyond the in-repo 1e6-zero table.

nodes.name: Adjacent-box count correlation tends to -1/2 at rate 1/log
nodes.statement: For GUE the correlation of counts in adjacent boxes of length L is rho_exact = -1/2 + (log 2)/(2 log(2 pi L)) to leading order. At the Platt-Trudgian height (L=5.9148e6) rho_exact=-0.4817670. Decade ladder to 1e12: deviation falls only 0.0436 -> 0.0188.

nodes.name: H_desc-mirror and the Palm surplus 1.73
nodes.statement: H_desc-mirror(p) with Polymath15 (i),(ii) gives Lambda <= t0 + y0^2/2 (U = 0.145 at t0 = 0.1314, y0 = 0.165). Against the conditioned-on-a-zero baseline it needs a local zero surplus about 1.73x neutral around every off-line zero of H_t for all t in (0, t0].

nodes.name: Burgers flux coefficient kappa=2 along the collision flow
nodes.statement: kappa=(m_s-m_zz)/(m m_z)=2.000000000 at all 325 sampled (height,time,z) points of the attractive CM RK4 flow; viscosity fraction |m_zz|/|2 m m_z| falls 0.2266 -> 0.02433 -> 4.372e-4 as coarse-graining y*/d goes 2 -> 8.

nodes.name: H5: RH iff corrected Euler products bounded above on compacts in sigma > 1/2
nodes.statement: Equivalent: (a) RH; (b) for every compact K in {sigma > 1/2}, sup_{Y>=2} sup_{s in K} u_Y(s) < infinity; (c) for every real sigma in (1/2, 1), sup_Y [sum_{p<=Y} p^{-sigma} - int_2^Y u^{-sigma} du/log u] < infinity. One-sided real prime sums suffice.

device.evidence: direct attempts of 2026-11-01 (ROADMAP device table); rows P3, P7, G13, G17

nodes.name: H6: symbol = natural part + 4 pi sum of Poisson kernels of off-line zeros
nodes.statement: sigma_X(t) = S^nat_X(t) + 4 pi sum_{beta > 1/2} P(t; rho), with S^nat_X = P_X - 8/(1 + 4t^2) + 2 N[w_b]; on-line zeros give the singular part -pi sum delta_gamma. The compressions satisfy q >= q^nat with equality iff RH. Author-checked only.

nodes.name: Hagedorn boundary law at beta -> 1+
nodes.statement: With v=beta-1: U(beta)=-(log zeta)'(beta)=1/v-gamma+O(v); C_v v^2=1+2v+O(v^2). No equilibrium phase for beta<1; T=1 is a limiting temperature (Bost-Connes KMS symmetry breaking at beta=1). Sees only the pole.

nodes.name: Convexity of the bridge Hamiltonian at sigma=1/2 has no N -> infinity limit
nodes.statement: T_N(sigma,t)=sum_{p<=p_N}(1/2)log p(|H_p(s)|^2+|H_p(1-s)|^2) at t=14.134725: d^2T_N/dsigma^2 at sigma=1/2 is 19.2, 259.3, -77.2, -173.7, +1320.3, +2869.3 for N=10,100,400,800,1600,3200. Sign flips with growing amplitude; finite-stage convexity does not pass to the limit.

nodes.name: Off-diagonal endpoint-Hankel obstruction depends on s=aU only
nodes.statement: De-homogenized R_jk=H_jk/sqrt(D_jj D_kk): substituting tau=Ux cancels U, so R, its spectrum, ||R|| and the gap ||R||-max R_jj depend on s=aU alone. Raw-monomial gap grows about 0.9 per degree (1.79 at DEG=2 to 10.8 at DEG=12): a basis-conditioning artifact.

nodes.name: Fixed-distance anchor line for the harmonic floor is false
nodes.statement: Unconditionally at t = 0: H_g(1/2 + c) <= -(1/|c + i gamma_1| - o(1)) X^c/log X for infinitely many X, for every completion g (Landau-Ingham); sieve to 1e7 measures about -0.7 X^c/log X per decade. Minimum principle and Harnack only move a floor between lines.

nodes.name: Harmonic strip transport with positive kernels (Theorem H2)
nodes.statement: For zero-free completions g of the finite Euler product: H_g(1/2 + eta_1 + it) = int Q_{eta_1,eta_2}(t - u) H_g(1/2 + eta_2 + iu) du and sigma_g(t) = int k_eta(t - u) H_g(1/2 + eta + iu) du with Q, k > 0. The compressed form is a positive-kernel average of a harmonic potential.

nodes.name: Random multiplicative model results do not derandomise to zeta
nodes.statement: Harper 2017 statements for random multiplicative functions use independence across primes of random phases; no mechanism transfers them to the deterministic sequence p^{-it}.

nodes.name: Function-field RH numerics
nodes.statement: Hasse-Weil bound verified at 135 curve-prime pairs; Hasse-Weil zeta numerator P_1 (not P_1^{-1}); local factors at ramified primes checked for Dirichlet, elliptic-curve and Dedekind cases.

nodes.name: Determinant D=H_x^2-HH_xx has wrong-sign backward source
nodes.statement: (d_tau+d_x^2)D=2(H_xx^2-H_xH_xxx). Reversed time gives a negative source, not a forward maximum principle. Countermodel H=x^2-2(tau-c): real roots after c, collision at c, nonreal before. Strict log-concavity or positive kernels plus compact zero tails also fail.

nodes.name: Discriminant law for zeros under the heat flow
nodes.statement: For simple real zeros x_i(t) moving by dx_k/dt = 2 sum_{j != k} 1/(x_k - x_j) (or the reversed sign convention), d/dt log Disc = -8 sum_{i<j} 1/(x_i - x_j)^2 in the collision direction, so the discriminant is strictly monotone; exact two-particle solution.

nodes.name: Heat-evolved von Mangoldt coefficients stay nonnegative
nodes.statement: Lean: with G_t(n) = exp(t log^2 n/4) and D = multiplication by log n (Leibniz for Dirichlet convolution), beta(t) is the unique solution of beta * G_t = D G_t; beta(0) = Lambda; 4 d beta_n/dt = log^2(n) beta_n + 2 sum_{de=n} beta_d (log e) beta_e; hence beta_n(t) >= 0 and nondecreasing on t >= 0.

nodes.name: Rodgers-Tao heat family H_tau
nodes.statement: H_tau(z)=int_0^inf e^{tau u^2}Phi(u)cos(zu)du, Phi(u)=sum_n(2pi^2n^4e^{9u}-3pi n^2e^{5u})e^{-pi n^2e^{4u}}; H_0(z)=xi(1/2+iz/2)/8; d_tau H=-H_zz. Newman Lambda = threshold for all zeros real; RH iff Lambda<=0; Rodgers-Tao Lambda>=0; Platt-Trudgian Lambda<=0.2.

nodes.name: Minimal completion theorem (holomorphic ratio continuation)
nodes.statement: X entire even, a_n>a0 distinct, a_n->a0. If for every n a holomorphic r_n on all of Re w>0 equals X(w-a_n)/X(w+a_n) on some open set, then all zeros of X lie in |Re w|<=a0; converse holds. No norm bound, common set or uniformity in n is needed.

nodes.name: Hecke operators compressed to the Lax-Phillips space of the modular surface
nodes.statement: Lax-Phillips scattering for PSL(2,Z): the scattering matrix is xi(2s-1)/xi(2s) (classical), so the resonances of the compressed semigroup on K = H minus (D_- + D_+) are at rho/2. Proposed device: compress the Hecke operators T_p to K; a norm bound of the form p^theta + p^-theta with theta < 1/2 on resonance states would bound Re rho. It would use the commuting Hecke family at all primes (an operator-norm statement, so independent of height), and non-arithmetic groups, which have no Hecke family, are a structural control. Not established: no bound is proved; expected first obstacle: T_p does not preserve the incoming and outgoing subspaces D_-, D_+. Related nodes: bridge-scattering-factorisation, antihermitian-strip-bound. The Lax-Phillips rows already closed concern the scattering form of zeta(s-a)/zeta(s+a) with heat-fiber-completion-theorem, not a Hecke compression. Closed by lane c4-laxphillips-hecke-compression (refereed once): on the Eisenstein channel T_p = 2 cos(log p sqrt(-L)); the compression has norm at most 2 for every inner scattering function; only Re rho <= 1 follows.

nodes.name: Joint Hecke recurrence (finite correspondences at all primes) with entropy and measure rigidity on Eisenstein resonance states of the modular surface
nodes.statement: Device read by lane c8-hecke-entropy-resonance-rigidity (round 8; first referee: holds after withdrawal of Lemma G2 (i); second referee push/c9-repair-referee-debts-r8/c8-hecke-entropy-resonance-rigidity/REFEREE2.md: corrected statement holds). Reads one Gamma-invariant function on PSL_2(Z)\H: (a) invariance, (b) the eigen-relation tau(p) f(z) = p^(-1/2) sum over the p+1 Hecke points for all p together, (c) the Laplace equation, (d) moderate growth and the truncated mass. Corrected statement. (1) At a resonance w = 1 - rho/2 the truncated mass is exactly Y^(2 sigma-1)/(2 sigma-1) (Maass-Selberg, classical; checked numerically). (2) Recurrence inequality: (sum over p in Pr of abs(tau_w(p))^2) int_B abs(f)^2 <= 2 m norm(Lambda^Y f)^2 with Y = P e^r ht(z0) and m = max over points q of the number of triples (p, j, gamma), gamma in Gamma, with q in gamma g_{p,j} B (Gamma-multiplicity; with m = number of pairs (p, j) the inequality is false for balls high in the cusp: ratio 19.5 at ht = 2000, r = 1/2, p = 2). Its P-exponent is -1 for every sigma in (1/2, 1). (3) Control EIS-w: E(z, w') off resonance satisfies (a)-(d) and the inequality for every Re w' in (1/2, 1), so these inputs locate no abscissa. (4) m_sigma = int nu_y y^(2 sigma-2) dy is N-invariant, satisfies (a_s)_* m_sigma = e^(-(2 sigma-1) s) m_sigma under y -> e^s y (sign corrected), and is a joint Hecke eigen-measure with eigenvalue p^(2 sigma-1/2) + p^(1/2-2 sigma), for every sigma > 1/2: the hypotheses of measure rigidity (A-invariant probability measure) fail at every sigma != 1/2. (5) U, THIN and sign twists fail at Gamma-invariance (Lemma G1 with the added line: a Gamma-invariant g = a y^w + b y^(1-w) + f_eps forces a = b = 0). Withdrawn: Lemma G2 (i) and the Davenport-Heilbronn row (the complex characters mod 5 are odd, the weight-0 object is identically 0; DH not run). Uniqueness of the joint eigenfunction (section 6) holds for Im w != 0 with two scalars (even and odd parts). Not proved: that m_sigma is the limit of abs(E(z, sigma+it))^2 dmu (argued and measured). The device returns its input (the conformal exponent 2 sigma - 1). A device on the modular surface must read phi(w) = 0 by a route other than truncated mass or closed-horocycle periods (Zagier's criterion). No statement about zeros of zeta.

device.evidence: c8-hecke-entropy-resonance-rigidity (round 8; first referee holds after withdrawal of Lemma G2 (i); second referee c9-repair-referee-debts-r8 holds the corrected statement): control EIS-w (off-resonance Eisenstein series; curated/controls.json) satisfies every input the device reads; recurrence bound has P-exponent -1 for every sigma (m counted with Gamma-multiplicity); limit measures m_sigma are A-conformal, not A-invariant. DH row withdrawn (not run)

nodes.name: Hecke triangle groups: zeta detection and non-arithmetic statistics exclude each other
nodes.statement: Zeta enters a Selberg trace formula only through the Eisenstein scattering determinant of an arithmetic group; among Hecke triangle groups G_q only arithmetic ones (Takeuchi 1977) carry it, and those have arithmetic (non-GUE) spectral statistics. No 2-point bound at support >1 follows.

nodes.name: H4': Neron-Tate positivity bounds zeta-weighted Green energies from above
nodes.statement: The Gross-Zagier kernel is -4 pi times the positive resolvent (multiplier -4 pi/(s(s-1) + 1/4 + t^2), matched to 1.2e-16), so 2 pi int rho_zeta |P^ B_x|^2 kappa_N d mu = U(x_P) - h^(x_P) <= U(x_P), with rho_zeta = |zeta(1/2+it)|^2/|zeta(1+2it)|^2. Nyman-Beurling direction; slack = central derivatives.

nodes.name: Nyman-Beurling ratio over Heegner amplitudes
nodes.statement: RH would follow if inf_x e^{a_x} E_mu|A_x|^2/|A_x(1)|^2 = 1 over Heegner amplitudes. Unproved and not known under RH: DH-type brackets have off-line zeros (bracket zero pair 1.92574583 +- 7.35195194i forces floor 1.1066; measured ratio >= 2.0e3 for x = tau_{-7} - tau_{-8}).

nodes.name: Recomposed bridge Lambda in [0.099, 0.137] is a height-mismatch artifact
nodes.statement: The bound combined a collision estimate at one height with truncation at another; at matched height every independent estimator is vacuous. Verified zero height (3e12) is the binding input (truncation elasticity -0.4 in T_PT); map rows F3, F6.

nodes.name: Proposition H: a height-restricted zero-free region is the global one
nodes.statement: Given Platt-Trudgian (RH for gamma <= 3000175332800), 'beta <= theta for all gamma >= T_0' with T_0 below the PT height is equivalent to QRH(theta). The Raymond chain reads only q* = sup (2 beta - 1)^2 over gamma > 3000000092914; the 7/8 proof has no height parameter.

nodes.name: Verified-height-to-floor law
nodes.statement: H_required(E)=(prefactor/E)^{1/kappa*}: required verified height as a power of the target error floor in the PT-anchored surrogate. Reentry band lies beyond the verified frontier (data unreachable).

nodes.name: Discrepancy rigidity for completely multiplicative unimodular functions (Helson)
nodes.statement: Property D(theta) for a completely multiplicative unimodular chi: sum_{n <= x} chi(n) = c x + O(x^theta). It is not a tail property (finite modifications of chi = 1 have discrepancy of order log x; Klurman, recalled, source not opened) and it holds at chi = 1 with theta = 0: the one object found in round 3 that is both non-tail and tied to chi = 1. D(theta) gives the continuation of F(s) - c/(s-1) to Re s > theta, which is data to the left of Re s = 1. Proposed device: D(theta) forces a zero-free region Re s > f(theta) for F with f(0) < 1. Open alternative to be decided: the converse lemma (D(theta) forces the set of primes with chi(p) != 1 to be thin, so F/zeta is zero-free and pole-free on Re s > theta and the implication runs through zeta, circular) or a non-thin example. The proposed control THIN (thin twist) bounds what the implication can give: at best zero-free Re s > theta. Closed by lane c4-helson-discrepancy-zerofree (Theorem 1, two referee checks): right of the largest real zero of F the zeros of F are those of zeta with matching orders; the implication is relative to zeta and transfers to Beurling systems.
