nodes.name: Hermite-Poulain shift and (1 - c D^2) factor
nodes.statement: If p has only real roots then p + c p' has only real roots for real c (root interlacing with end roots at +-infinity); hence 1 - c D^2 = (1 - sqrt(c) D)(1 + sqrt(c) D), c >= 0, preserves real-rootedness and so do its iterates.

nodes.name: Hidden-square existence is equivalent to its conclusion
nodes.statement: A Hermitian kernel has a factorisation K_a = int Psi conj(Psi) dnu iff K_a >= 0 (Aronszajn / Kolmogorov). Conjectures 25.2/25.3 (hidden-square kernel) and 16.4 are therefore logically equivalent to K_a >= 0, not an independent lever.

nodes.name: Hidden-square kernel factorization (Conj 16.4)
nodes.statement: Find a Gram factorization of K_a built from the completed kernel Phi rather than from the zeros. Pointwise sine-cosine identities leave sign-indefinite cross terms, so any factorization must be non-local; none has been constructed. RH-equivalent.

nodes.name: Hidden-square proposal: diagonal has measure zero
nodes.statement: The set u=v has two-dimensional Lebesgue measure zero, so the positive one-dimensional comparison integral is not a channel of the original double integral. Repaired paired-coordinate and theta divisor-block identities give no global positivity.

nodes.name: Hidden-square chain: no-ghost = Volterra contraction
nodes.statement: A_a(z)=int Phi cosh(au)cos(zu)du, B_a(z)=int Phi sinh(au)sin(zu)du; shear density Phi(u)Phi(v)sinh(a(v-u)) on u<=v. Block [[I,V],[V*,I]]>=0 iff ||V_{a,Phi}||<=1. Seven-step forward and five-step reverse chains reduce the Section 15-27 conjectures to this norm bound.

nodes.name: High residual poles escape every fixed detector band
nodes.statement: U_a*QU_a-Q=P_{I conj(J) K_J}-P_{K_I}: residual poles are the positive model-space component, but their compression into any fixed band tends to zero as height escapes. Fixed-band detection is not height-uniform.

nodes.name: Horizon-front mismatch (M5) for certified non-collision
nodes.statement: The certified non-collision window T_- ~ g^2/8 shrinks like O(1/N^2) while the first-collision front t_c(N) stays O(1) (OLS t_c = 0.0066 + 4.91/N); horizon/front ratio falls about 100x per decade of N. Whole-trajectory g_min(t) > 0 stays open.

nodes.name: Conjugate closure of the H_t zero set at every real t
nodes.statement: Phi real, even, positive, decaying like exp(-pi e^{4u}) gives H_t real-even entire for every real t (t<0 included), so its zero multiset is closed under z->conj z and z->-z. Per-t structure, no RH input; holds equally on the backward-heat control.

nodes.name: H_t corridor certificates and finite-window census
nodes.statement: Eight interval-rigorous Rouche corridor certificates on H_{0.18}, each proving one real zero; exterior census upgrades to an exact zero count in the window. Two negative results close the corridor route to a Lambda record.

nodes.name: Hyperbolic prime spiral
nodes.statement: Primes in the Poincare disk at r(p)=log p/log p_max, theta(p)=phi_0 log p mod 2 pi; coherent rings at phi_0 near 2 pi/log p*; p mod 4 classes equidistribute in angle (Dirichlet). Zoom hierarchy: same embedding at [1e2,1e3], [1e4,1e5], [1e6,1e7].

nodes.name: Panel cap and modulus floor are one condition
nodes.statement: Per-panel cap L_panel * sup|f'/f| < pi and modulus floor |H_t| >= delta are coupled: delta equals the surplus |A_t + B_t| - |C_t| - (E_A + E_B + E_C0). Joint panel count is minimised at the boundary h* = 1/w, w = (1/2) log(T/2 pi) ~ 13.45 rad per unit height at 3e12.

nodes.name: Model-cusp modulus gives a point estimate, not a uniform floor
nodes.statement: The scale-free cusp modulus C_PS = pi/sqrt(2) ~ 2.2214 at h = meanGap/sqrt(2) is a point value; the certified boundary modulus floor remains delta = 0 without the interval cap check.

nodes.name: Arithmetic 18-mode Christoffel / von Neumann Q at seam points
nodes.statement: At 21 seam points of the 25-prime-node model Q < 1.4326672 (worst qPure = 0.90487, von Neumann qVN = 0.78939); the compression meets the contract threshold but structurally on the discrete node picture, not as a continuum bound.

nodes.name: Information floor at support ln 2
nodes.statement: For 2a <= ln 2 the prime side of the explicit formula is empty, so a twin and its Euler arm have the same Weil form and no quantity separates them. At conductor 1 there is no DH-type twin with zeta's bridge (Hamburger).

nodes.name: Ingham-route off-lattice Riesz floor for the sech seam Gram
nodes.statement: For delta-separated nodes: lambda_min >= sech(pi T)(2 pi/delta) cot(pi^2/(2 T delta)) for T > pi/delta, m-uniform and off-lattice.

nodes.name: Interferometer visibility is vacuous, false or a gauge choice
nodes.statement: Split Lambda_F = A(s) + A(1-s), V = 2|A(s)||A(1-s)|/(|A(s)|^2 + |A(1-s)|^2). Exact arms give V0 = sech(log|chi|), a function of the gamma factor alone. A -> A + O with O(1-s) = -O(s) changes V; the bound sup V < 1 is certified false (79 crossings for zeta, t <= 200).

nodes.name: Interval RK4 witness width equals the step, not the enclosure
nodes.statement: The single-scale interval RK4 witness (imp-362) reports bracket width / dt = 1 at every closed row, so width measures step resolution. An N-uniform enclosure [t_c_lo(N), t_c_hi(N)] is not supplied; seeded from a bundled 870-zero table.

nodes.name: Absolute-value mean of cotangent sums along the inverse line
nodes.statement: S(b)=Sum_{a=2,(a,b)=1}^{b-1} V(b,a) = Sum_a c_0(h_a/a), h_a = b^{-1} mod a. Open: A(b)=Sum_a |c_0(h_a/a)| <= c phi(b) b with explicit c<0.5705 (measured about 0.14). The only input is the frequency of small modular inverses b^{-1} mod a: a Kloosterman-type equidistribution statement.

nodes.name: Inverse spectral potentials consume the ordinates
nodes.statement: Wu-Sprung V(x) ~ pi^2 x^2/log^2 x from Abel inversion reproduces smooth points only (rms 0.387 / 0.333). Gauss-Newton potentials match 5000 zeros to 2e-11 discretely, 1-2% of a spacing in the continuum, interpolant-dependent. A 1D Schrodinger Hilbert-Polya operator would force RH and simplicity.

nodes.name: Inverse spectral potentials for the first 5000 zeros
nodes.statement: Gauss-Newton min-norm potentials from the Wu-Sprung V_WS reproduce the ordinates in a DVR operator to <= 2.3e-11 for N = 500..5000; they consume the zeros and regularity is not established. A 1D Schrodinger Hilbert-Polya operator would force simple zeros.

nodes.name: Exact isolation-ratio rate (Lemma R2-T) and c_glob
nodes.statement: d(g/d_1)/ds=((g-d_1)/d_1^2)[2/(g+d_1)+4(g+d_1)/(d_1 g)] for a single nearest neighbour. Half-lattice rate bound has unique root c_glob=0.8980208880762339 of 4+4r-4/r-4/(r+1)-2[psi(1+2/r)-psi(1+1/r)].

nodes.name: Jacobi smoothing is pole-faithful but exponentially unstable
nodes.statement: Symbol |h^(tau)| ~ (1+|tau|)^{13/8} e^{-pi|tau|/2} never vanishes, so no zeta pole is cancelled, but there is no tempered inverse. A smooth positive PNT density satisfies the averaged bound with unbounded pointwise triangular error.

nodes.name: Jensen step loses most of the mollified signal
nodes.statement: Finite-T kappa with / without the Jensen inequality: 0.4903 / 0.8578 at theta = 4/7, T = 1e6; 0.6587 / 0.9434 at theta = 1. Mollifier alone: mean |psi|^2 / diagonal in [0.992, 1.011].

nodes.name: All-order jets: boundary trace unbounded
nodes.statement: The all-order derivative hierarchy has a rank-two displacement structure, but the vector representing boundary data is unbounded in the putative positive jet norm. If D(it_0)=0 a Gaussian has no L^2 preimage under A; common boundary zeros differ from multiplier poles.

nodes.name: N-uniform two-sided bound on renormalised fold moduli
nodes.statement: With y_N=sqrt(2pi/N): show C_ren(N)=y_N^{3/2}|m'(z_0*)| and C_curv(N)=y_N^{5/2}|m''(z_0*)| stay in a fixed window [c,C] for all N. One coupled strip-height-uniformity statement discharges both H3 and H4; H0 (provenance) is separate.

nodes.name: G7: off-diagonal endpoint-Hankel positivity of R

nodes.statement: The head coefficient of prod_{p in {2,3,5}} (1 - lambda_p b_t(p) p^{-s}) is a convex combination of Lemma CG covers with weights prod lambda_p prod (1 - lambda_p); so 0 <= c_n(t_L) <= c_n(t) <= c_n(t_R) for lambda_p in [0,1]. lambda = 1 is already optimal.

nodes.name: Lemma MP3 (multi-point phase lemma)
nodes.statement: For omega_s >= 0, |z| = |u_s| = 1, eps = +-1, c_s >= c0 >= 0: sum omega_s c_s [1 - eps Re(z u_s)] >= c0 (sum omega_s - |sum omega_s u_s|), sharp in z. One pair without centre weight is Raymond's Lemma 3. Worth -7.86e-7 on Lambda.

nodes.name: Lemma W (wide-support diagonal pair correlation)
nodes.statement: Exist A>1, C, T0: sum_{0<gamma<=T} T^{2A|beta-1/2|} <= C T log T for T>=T0. Equivalent to zero density N(sigma,T)<=C T^{1-2A(sigma-1/2)} log^{O(1)} T with slope 2A>2. Implies a fixed strip |beta-1/2|<=delta*=(1+kappa)/(2A), kappa about 0.20, then Lambda<=2 delta*^2.

nodes.name: Levinson method as direct/dual weight balance
nodes.statement: Z = 2 Re[e^{i theta}(zeta + zeta'/(2 theta'))]; Q(x) + Q(1-x) = const is the direct/dual weight balance. Primorial Euler-product mollifiers score below the length-truncated Mobius reference in a fixed-Q main-term proxy (theta = 1/2, T = 1e6: 0.262 vs 0.453).

nodes.name: Li coefficients positive to n = 10^4; no all-n route
nodes.statement: lambda_n = n [z^n] log xi(1/(1-z)) > 0 certified for 1 <= n <= 10^4 (Arb); lambda_1 = 0.0230957, osc_1 = gamma_E exactly. Weaker than verified height implies. The 7/8 half-plane gives only |1 - 1/rho|^2 <= 1 + O(1/gamma^2): no all-n positivity.

nodes.name: Li coefficients lambda_n, n<=300, from 1e6 zeros
nodes.statement: lambda_n=sum_rho[1-(1-1/rho)^n] computed by the Bombieri-Lagarias zero sum over 1e6 Odlyzko ordinates; all positive. Positivity for n up to ~H^2 log H is a function of verified height H.

nodes.name: Reach law of the Li-Herglotz-CMV zero detector
nodes.statement: Truncation order N needed to detect a zero at height gamma: N_det = 0.364 gamma^1.272 (r^2=0.98); equivalently gamma_det about 2.21 N^0.786. Extrapolated N at the Platt-Trudgian height is of order 1e15. A finite detector restates verified height.

nodes.name: Li-Herglotz-CMV unitary truncation from Taylor data of xi
nodes.statement: At a = 20 the 400 x 400 CMV matrix built from Keiper-Li lambda_n alone reproduces 39 of the first 40 zeros to 1e-12 in angle; reach gamma_{N/10}, linear in N; at feasible orders reach is 1.75 decades below verified height. Completeness of the finite certificate is Weil positivity. Obstruction map P16.

nodes.name: Link A: Schur complement form of the Volterra bound
nodes.statement: The block operator [[I, V],[V*, I]] is positive semidefinite iff ||V|| <= 1; this is the surviving half of the refuted Section-27 two-way collapse.

nodes.name: Route K: moments see zeros only in integrated form
nodes.statement: I(T)=int_0^T log|zeta(1/2+it)|dt: I(500)=-0.134 (O(1)) while the Jensen-from-moments bound J_1=378.94 grows like T; loss ratio 141 at T=200, 2828 at T=500.

nodes.name: Worst-window zero-count excess follows Gaussian extreme-value scaling
nodes.statement: Worst single window sits 2.9-3.3 sigma from the envelope; window count M = 0.752 sqrt(T), tail scale a_M = sqrt(2 log M); tail is two-sided symmetric. Heuristic extrapolation to T = 3e12 only.

nodes.name: Every-window Levinson certificates are too long
nodes.statement: Window Littlewood-Levinson certificates certify a zero in 2-3 mean spacings (median) but need 16-48 in the worst window; analytic every-window tiers start at T^{1/6+eps} (positivity) and T^{27/82+eps} (positive proportion), 1.8-5.4 orders above the 8.6-spacing H_desc window.

nodes.name: Localized barrier sum A_{k,h}
nodes.statement: A_{k,h} = sum_n Lambda(n) K_k(n) e(hn/p), K_k a Fresnel-Airy packet centred at u_{k,h} = v/(k - h/p), v = T/(2 pi), of width H_{k,h} = u_{k,h}/sqrt(v). Summed over k it is the smoothed -(L'/L) of sum Lambda(n) e(hn/p) n^(-s) at s = sigma_B + iT, sigma_B = 0.59045.

nodes.name: Log-phase spiral of arg zeta(1/2+it)
nodes.statement: Polar plot r=log(t+e), angle arg zeta(1/2+it); zeros on the line appear as cusps with a pi phase jump. Companion: Hardy Z(t)=e^{i theta(t)}zeta(1/2+it), Riemann-Siegel main sum plus C_0, error O(t^{-1/4}); Gram-law violations by block.

nodes.name: LP feasibility of a signed coefficient field aligned with curvature at near-collisions
nodes.statement: With Z_w(x) = sum_{n<=N} w_n n^(-1/2) cos(theta(x) - x log n), the system Z_w(x*) Z''(x*) > 0 at 72 near-collisions up to gamma_200 is feasible for N in {1..32}; n = 1 alone gives margin 1.0. The uniform-in-T obstruction lies off the line.

nodes.name: m1plus cubic gauss prime sum uniform
nodes.statement: (M1+): cancellation in sums of normalised cubic Gauss sums over primes, uniform in the dual index, for the fixed coefficients of the 7/8 method. GRH-type below-level estimate; the single point where arithmetic of the coefficients enters lanes e2-below-level-mixed-moment, e2-ms-slot-capacity, e2-two-scale-detector-moment.

nodes.name: Bandwidth-1 wall for pair-correlation certificates
nodes.statement: Past bandwidth 1 the off-diagonal prime terms are individually of size T^lambda and cancel to o(T log^2 T) only via asymptotics for sum Lambda(n) Lambda(n+h) (Hardy-Littlewood, F(alpha) for alpha > 1); sieve upper bounds cannot capture the cancellation. Map row P27.

nodes.name: Asserted ceiling 0.68185 for bandwidth-one certificates
nodes.statement: Source paper Remark 1.1 asserts an extremal law capping configuration-by-configuration bandwidth-one certificates at 0.68185 (0.70/0.80/0.90 needing bandwidth 1.04/1.26/1.70); the workspace found no statement or proof in the sources. Proved ceilings: dimension cap <= lambda N, sharpness of the rank-trace lemma, optimality of Montgomery-Taylor for one non-negative window. Map row P27 records 0.6818287.

nodes.name: LP optimum of the positivity class
nodes.statement: For kernels r >= 0, r(0) = 1, r-hat <= 0 outside [-1,1]: (1/N) sum m m' r(gamma - gamma') <= C_in(r) = integral_{-1}^{1} r-hat(alpha)(delta(alpha) + |alpha|) d alpha. LP with Richardson extrapolation: C about 1.3212, proportion 0.6788 (published RH-conditional value 0.6792), against Montgomery-Taylor 1.3275.

nodes.name: Complex ordinates are conjugation-closed in every window
nodes.statement: For rho = 1/2 + beta + i gamma put gamma_rho = (rho - 1/2)/i = gamma - i beta. The functional equation pairs rho with 1 - conj rho (same gamma, conjugate gamma_rho), so the multiset {gamma_rho : Im rho in I} is closed under complex conjugation for every height window I.

nodes.name: Deep off-line pairs break signed-kernel certificates
nodes.statement: An off-line pair at depth beta pays 2m^2[r(0) + r(2i beta)], with r(2i beta) -> -infinity like -e^{8 pi beta E} when r-hat <= 0 at the edge. Under/over-payment ratio 2.8, 12.4, 59, 257 at beta = 0.8, 1.0, 1.25, 1.5 (E = 0.75). Neutralising needs N(sigma,T) << T^{1 - 4E(sigma - 1/2)}, beyond the density hypothesis.

nodes.name: Dimension cap for bandwidth-lambda families
nodes.statement: A bandwidth-lambda test family certifies at most lambda N on-line points (source Prop. 7.4). Unconditional higher moments tr W^k exist only for k lambda < 2, where the cap 2 - 1/lambda makes them useless; odd moments do not enter the two-sided Chebyshev-Markov bound.

nodes.name: An input discontinuous at beta = 0
nodes.statement: To break the shallow-pair degeneracy an input must quantify something discontinuous at depth beta = 0 or exclude shallow pairs by arithmetic. Zero-density bounds say nothing at |beta| << 1/log T; simple-zero counts do not help since shallow pairs are simple. No such unconditional input is known.

nodes.name: Edge lemma: even signed weights reduce to the Montgomery-Taylor class
nodes.statement: For real s supported in [-E,E], R_s(alpha) = integral s(u) s(u+alpha) du ~ s(-E) s(E)(2E - alpha) as alpha -> 2E. If s is even this is >= 0, so R_s <= 0 on |alpha| > 1 forces E <= 1/2. Three solvers confirm C_in >= 1.3275014 on the grid (proof sketch plus numerics).

nodes.name: Gabor fingerprint matrix W = P + Q
nodes.statement: Window phi >= 0 on [-1/2,1/2], w = phi^2, Phi = w-hat; tests f_k = phi e^{-i tau_k u} at critical spacing; v_rho(k) = phi-hat(gamma_rho - tau_k); W = sum m_rho v_rho v_rho^T. On-line points give rank-one PSD blocks; each off-line pair gives a signature (1,1) plane at any depth. Entries come from primes <= T without zero locations.

nodes.name: GUE spectrum of W matches the adversary through the third moment
nodes.statement: GUE prediction for W: eigenvalues fill about [0,2], variance 1/3, m_3 = 2, m_4 = 13/4. The adversary (2/3 at 1, 1/6 at 2) has the same first three moments. The fourth moment separates them and needs prime-pair correlations at bandwidth > 1/2; under a fourth-moment hypothesis the proportion would be 13/18.

nodes.name: Indefinite-metric version of the rank-trace lemma is false
nodes.statement: With J = I_A + (-I_B) on two Gabor families and signed weight, a pair at depth beta pays 2m^2[Psi(0)^2 + Psi(2i beta)^2] with Psi(2i beta) = integral w(u) cosh(4 pi beta u) du, which can vanish: the pair pays 2 instead of >= 4 and the certificate counts phantom on-line zeros. Violation measured at beta = 0.2 to 0.45.

nodes.name: Reproducing identity at critical density
nodes.statement: sum_k phi-hat(z - tau_k) phi-hat(z' - tau_k) = Phi(z - z') for complex z, z' (Poisson summation at critical spacing).

nodes.name: Proportion 0.67250 of zeros on the line (August 2026, Lean-verified per source)
nodes.statement: N_0(T,2T) >= (2 - C*) N with C* = 1/2 + 2^{-1/2} cot(2^{-1/2}) = 1.3274993 at w* = cos(sqrt2 s): proportion 0.6725007; distinct zeros (3 - C*)/2 = 0.83625. Box window gives 2/3. Uses no zero-density, zero-free region, mollifier or Lambda input. Map row P27.

nodes.name: Rank-trace lemma with indefinite off-line blocks
nodes.statement: rank P >= 2 tr P + 4 tr Q - 4 n_+(Q) - ||P + Q||_F^2. Proof: von Neumann trace inequality, then x^2 >= 2x - 1 per on-line direction and q^2 >= 4q - 4 on the positive directions of Q. Equality iff P, Q are multiples of orthogonal projections.

nodes.name: A certificate acting on |S_I(u)|^2 for real u
nodes.statement: Open: use the unconditional positivity integral h |S_I|^2 >= 0 without evaluating kernels at complex arguments, i.e. act on |S_I(u)|^2 directly for real u, where deep pairs contribute e^{4 pi beta |u|}-growing but positive terms. No candidate construction is recorded.

nodes.name: Shallow-pair adversary
nodes.statement: 2N/3 simple on-line zeros with orthogonal fingerprints plus N/3 zeros in off-line pairs of depth beta -> 0: each pair block tends to 2vv^T, spectrally a double on-line zero; tr = N, ||W||_F^2 = 4N/3. Any certificate continuous in the configuration cannot separate a shallow pair from a double zero.

nodes.name: Unconditional trace data of W
nodes.statement: tr W = N; ||W||_F^2 = C(w) N (1 + o(1)) with C(w) = (integral w^2 + double integral |s - s'| w(s) w(s') ds ds')/(integral w)^2; n_+(Q) <= number of off-line pairs. ||W||_F^2 is the pair sum with kernel Phi^2; off-diagonal prime terms vanish by the Montgomery-Vaughan Hilbert inequality only because all primes are <= T.

nodes.name: Positivity of zero pair sums for any non-negative h
nodes.statement: For h >= 0 of any support and any window I: sum_{rho,rho'} m m' h-hat(gamma_rho - gamma_rho') = integral h(u) |S_I(u)|^2 du >= 0, S_I(u) = sum m_rho e^{i u gamma_rho}. Uses only conjugation closure, not RH; deep pairs contribute e^{+-2 beta u} growth inside a modulus squared.

nodes.name: Off-line pairs force zeta-prime zeros near the line
nodes.statement: A pair at +-beta forces a zero of zeta' within O(beta^2 log T) of the line, and zeta'(1/2+it) = 0 implies zeta(1/2+it) = 0. Converting this to a count needs few zeta' zeros within eps/log T of the line, equivalent to fine-scale small-gap statistics of zeros.

nodes.name: Effective order 2 in the 7/8 architecture (h = r/2)
nodes.statement: For: it is the only input in the ledger whose scalar price reaches 1/2. Against: no candidate coherent set of exponent 1/2 exists, and sub-square-root correlation or prime marks with l - lx = 2 are heuristically circular (`r3-method-limit`). Status after rounds 5 and 6: each attack item has an obstruction. Re-expression of the probe (Lemma U, Z15b); abelian families (Z22); double covers through local data (Z23, narrowed); probes of higher degree in the target (Z15c); long marks at h = 3 (Z26); and the format itself stops at abscissa 2/3 for sextic rows because of the normaliser (Z24). Closed in round 7: h > 1 by uncompensated marks (the low input contains the squared signal; conditional on Lemma C, exact in F_q[T] at N <= 4); operator-norm estimates below 1 - 1/r (row Z27). Closed in round 8: the single-row bridge (Q26); (E-K) as an operator-norm or sieve statement, and row energy as a separator (Z30); (E-H) by termwise or norm bounds (Z31). Round 9: (E-K) in the window Z/P < X < Z P is closed for two named absolute-value techniques and its diagonal-level form fails in F_q[T] at N = 2 in the active classes (Z30; narrowed by the referees); (E-H) shows no target excess in the model at r <= 5 (Z31; measured, pre-asymptotic); the normaliser ladder stops in [4/7, 3/5] under hypotheses without source and at 2/3 with the sourced level (Z24b). State after round 9: effective order 2 is closed as an attack lead; bounded checks only (model excess against the Z[omega] screen; completed rows (6, 9, 2) at q = 7). Still untouched: global Whittaker constants of a genuine cusp form on the double cover of GL(3) (item 18). Any order-2 probe needs a normaliser without zeros in Re s > 1/2 (row Z24).

device.evidence: map section 6 item 1; narrowed after round 6 (lesson 1) to derivation items. Closed parts: re-expression of the same probe (Lemma U, two referees; row Z15b); abelian families (row Z22; abstract-family statement ARGUED); double covers through local data (row Z23, claim narrowed by its referee); probes of higher degree in the target (row Z15c); long marks at h = 3 as an input weaker than GRH (row Z26); the sextic probe as a route below abscissa 2/3 (normaliser H_eta, row Z24, two referees). Left open: (a) the uncompensated high side derived from manuscript (12.5)/(16.1) with the normaliser kept; (b) the compensated principal signal below Re s = 3/5; (c) whether any model vertex with 1 < h <= 3 exists. Requirement added: the normaliser of the probe has no zeros in Re s > 1/2. State set to closed by the strategy review after round 10 (STRATEGY v3, section 3.1 item 22): items (a) to (c) were derived in rounds 7 to 10 and each ends at an input of zero-free type for the twist family of the target or fails in the F_q[T] model ((E-K) row Z30, (E-H) row Z31, normaliser ladder rows Z24, Z24b, Hilbert-Schmidt cap, completed rows at (6, 9, 2)). Several closures are measured or argued, not theorems. Reopen only with one of: a relation among the reciprocals 1/L across rows that is not a norm bound; a method keeping the signs of the dual sum in the window Z/P < X < ZP; a probe whose normaliser has no zeros in Re s > 1/2; global Whittaker constants of a genuine cusp form on the double cover of GL(3)

nodes.name: Semidefinite coupling of finite-order positivity with the explicit formula in one window (not attempted in `stack-feasibility`); windowed Nehari problem and a uniform quantum q_* for clusters
nodes.statement: For: the LP used the constraints separately, and the Nehari distance is the one formulation with a gap. Against: the measured threshold is bandwidth L*(gamma) = (1/2) log(gamma/2 pi), i.e. a verification computation at height gamma, and the gap decays like 1/log T. Round 1 (`c1-window-sdp-scaling`, refereed once): in the window model with outside zeros fixed to zeta's, the real-node Pick LMI of order K <= 24 is linear in the zero measure and equals the explicit-formula LP on the five tabulated node families at 15 (T, K) cells (row S11). Not covered: node-uniform statement at (T, K) = (100, 24); LMIs whose on-line terms are not sign-definite (sector matrices P +- B); the windowed Nehari problem.

nodes.name: Sheared Hecke commutator at tau -> 0 and loading on X_0(4)(R) with Fricke w_4: closed (`c1-shear-hecke-fricke`, refereed once)
nodes.statement: [V_n, G_tau] = G_tau (exp(tau l (u + l)/4) - 1) V_n, l = log n (windowed L^2 norms; whole-line only for kappa-type kernels). The eigen-defect of 1 - lambda V_p has tau-order exactly 1 iff c(pm) = lambda c(m) for all m; zeta, zeta(s + a), completely multiplicative sign twists and unimodular twists all have order 1, so the statement is the identity "multiplicative at p", not an inequality. w_4 on the arc is u -> -u (evenness only). For tau < 0 the termwise prime expansion converges for a sign-twisted control as well; that it cannot be carried to tau = 0 is heuristic (Rodgers-Tao), not a theorem (row G22).

nodes.name: Two-sided or variation information on S(t) for Lambda certificates; certified t > 0 probe floors; larger verified height
nodes.statement: For: these leave the floor-only class whose ceiling is 0.0962. Against: they act on Lambda only, and there is no converse from Lambda to zeros. Shifted-partner part decided (`c1-missing-controls` Part D, refereed twice): for every fixed 0 < a <= 1/2, S(T) - (1/pi) arg zeta(1/2 + a + iT) exceeds M on a proportion of [T, 2T] tending to 1/2 and is below -M on a proportion tending to 1/2 (PROVED-rel Selberg's central limit theorem for S(t) and the Bohr-Jessen limit law; both statements checked against the classical ones, sources not opened); hence no fixed shifted pair is an interlacing partner of Xi. Open: shifts a(T) of order 1/log T; partners that are not shifts.

nodes.name: Hybrid target-row mean value (the coincidence chi_u = eta chi_u for the zeta target); higher-degree Q(d/dz)F inertia; multi-piece mollifiers; ideation angles 4-12; log-derivative defect along the flow
nodes.statement: For: listed as not run in `CRITIC_R1.md` or by referees. Against: each is of mean-value or FE-identity type as posed, so the walls of section 5 parts 1-2 apply unless a new input is added.

nodes.name: Controls not run: run in round 1 (`c1-missing-controls`, refereed once), same outcomes as inferred
nodes.statement: Sign twists in seven `h-*` lanes: the DH-failing coefficient step passes exactly in six and is not formulable in `h-klein-fricke`; the twists fail at the functional-equation step. Backward heat in `stack-feasibility` and (from Lemma A plus measured zeros, no Ritz run) in `sq-canonical-det`. DH theta kernel: Arb certificate (positive, strictly log-concave on u >= 0, u L'' - L' < 0 on u > 0). Remaining: Ritz run of K[t] for the heat family at tau = -2; a sign twist with a zero in 7/8 < Re s < 1 as a control for the 7/8 mechanism; controls SEL and the block-permuted Nyman-Beurling family (section 2 additions below). Round 5 (`c5-repair-engine-map-r4` section 4): the Ritz run of K[t] for the heat family has no object. Theta_{tau,omega} = F_tau(z - omega)/F_tau(z + omega) has poles of unbounded real part for every tau < 0 (escape law, `b-escape-law` Theorem A; non-cancellation measured on the 24 located poles at tau = -2, argued beyond), so it is analytic in no half-plane, Suzuki's causal kernel does not exist, and Lemma A of `sq-canonical-det` does not apply. With the kernel taken above the poles of height below Gamma only, norm(K_Gamma[T]) >= norm(R_Gamma[T]) - 1 with R_Gamma the finite-rank residue part (exact for the pole data): at tau = -2, omega = 0.1 the bound exceeds 1 from T = 2.43, 1.90, 1.63, 1.59, 1.40, 1.34 for Gamma = 70, 100, 130, 160, 190, 230. The first failure time depends on the truncation. Controls still not run in the stage lanes (P44, P45): HEAT, NR, PA, THW.

nodes.name: Approaches outside the source set
nodes.statement: No lane in this push treated: arithmetic statistics of zeros beyond pair level, operator-theoretic constructions with an adelic space beyond the GL(1) test vector, or an input from another 2026 result. They are not assessed here in either direction.

nodes.name: Pointwise bound for sum_k mu(k) r_b(x/k) for one fixed cofinal sawtooth remainder r_b
nodes.statement: (`e1-cofinal-legendre-dual`, source Step 7). For: it uses the integers and all primes jointly, is uniform in x, and fails for DH, Liouville and theta^3 at Lambda_a >= 0. Against: only a mean-square bound is argued (MV-CAP), and E_a is not separated at the level of exponents.

nodes.name: Restricted-level Legendre identity plus positivity (half-weight Chebyshev / Legendre LP below full level)
nodes.statement: For: the referee of `e1-forcing-free-bilinear-split` removed the claimed parity cap (2.32 sqrt X from six levels; exact S(X) at D = X^0.7 for X = 1e5), so this case is not closed. Against: the remaining polylog gap is a quantity of RH strength, and positivity enters linearly.

nodes.name: Genuine cusp forms on the double cover of GL(3), and Whittaker coefficients of cusp-induced Eisenstein series, as order-2 rows
nodes.statement: (`e1-gl3-theta-order2-rows`). For: not computed; item 1 stays open only here. Against: in every computed double-cover case the quadratic symbol enters Hecke relations as a Gauss sum, placing the reciprocal at shift 1/2 and cancelling the gain h/r = 1/2. Round 6 (`c6-gl3-cover-epsilon-cocycle`, row Z23; claim narrowed by its referee): in the local Gelfand-Tsetlin data of a double cover of any rank the quadratic symbol occurs only with q^(-1/2), and quadratic twist families of any GL(n) form carry no Jacobi-type epsilon value. Still open here: the global Whittaker constants of a genuine cusp form, the case chi(-1) = -1, and any global Euler-product statement.

nodes.name: Multivariate (polydisc, per-prime weights) Lee-Yang property as a one-sided bound on pole-renormalised Euler stages in the strip
nodes.statement: (`c1-leeyang-krein-limit`). For: local boundedness of these stages on {Re s > theta, s != 1} is equivalent to the zero-free statement, and the single-variable Lee-Yang inequality was the only bound tried. Against: the single-variable consequence has exponent of order P, weaker than the trivial bound. Closed in round 2 (row Q21, `c2-polydisc-leeyang-bound`, refereed once): polydisc stability gives exactly the trivial bound, and no rotation-invariant class gives less.

nodes.name: Below-level mixed moment sum_u abs(M_{r*} S_m)^2 << U^E with E < 1.1366-1.1452
nodes.statement: For: found independently by two referees and not excluded by any proved lemma; it lowers both the numerator exponent and the critical count. Against: it is a mean-value input inside [5/6, 7/8], so it moves the abscissa only within the method's floors.

device.evidence: rows Z15, Z16: floors 5/6 at r = 6; proved abscissa 7/8 (unrefereed manuscripts about 0.874887)

nodes.name: Window defect: commutator of the cutoff Q_c with Hecke operators
nodes.statement: (`c1-spinor-hecke-primitive` Lemma 5). For: it is the one place where a multiplicative mechanism acts on H_c non-trivially. Against: the formula is kernel-independent (holds for every control), so the function must enter through the test vector. Closed in round 2 (row G25, `c2-cutoff-hecke-defect`, refereed once): the form is the Weil form on a window; DH passes on every node set tried, the Liouville twist fails.

nodes.name: Discrepancy hypothesis for all additively twisted sums, sum_{n<=x} chi(n) e(an/q) = c delta_q x + O(q^A x^theta), uniformly in q
nodes.statement: (round-4 combination of P46 with control THIN; lane `c5-twisted-helson-arcs` running). For: it is the form not covered by the Landau argument of P46 or by Beurling, and periodicity in the conductor aspect is what the 7/8 mechanism uses. Against: for theta < 1/2 Parseval over the circle forces chi = 1 (identification, no inequality), and section 4 entry 49 shows that the residue classes mod p already force sum abs(1 - chi(p))^2 to be small in mean square. Closed (`c5-twisted-helson-arcs`, two referee passes; row P51): the strict form is an identification chi = n^(-i alpha) when limsup abs(S(x))/x > 0 and a restatement of the strip statement otherwise (P14); the general form is passed by THIN.

nodes.name: Which half of the 7/8 mechanism fails for THIN (Proposition D of `c4-thin-twist-control-78`): the low estimate (row reflection) or the high comparison
nodes.statement: (lane `c5-thin-propd-dichotomy` running). For: it decides where the periodicity input sits. Against: it is a statement about a control; it locates R3 for the 7/8 architecture and does not address the critical line. Also not covered from round 4: Hecke norms outside the weighted-L^2 family (G26); the non-locality step of P44 in its "any height" form. Rounds 5 and 6 (`c5-thin-propd-dichotomy`, `c6-probe61-thin-three-weights`; row Z25): not decided, and not decidable by enumeration (second sixth-power frequency at Z >= 2^36). It is now the paper question LIOU-HIGH.

nodes.name: Euler-shape rigidity without the pole clause for infinitely many modified primes
nodes.statement: (`c19-hq2-screen-fe-int-mult-pos-devices`; row X2). Is zeta the only Dirichlet series with zeta's functional equation (poles unrestricted) and an Euler product with geometric local factors, or with every local factor free of zeros and poles in Re s >= 1/2? For: the finite case is proved (Lemmas F, S, C; elementary, known type), and a positive answer would change the pre-filter for local-shape devices. Against: it is an identification and locates no zero; inside the finite class the local-shape read selects the twins the pole clause already rejects (referee E1). Round-20 lane `c20-euler-shape-rigidity-infinite-modified-primes` (kill test: a twin with geometric local factors and zeta's functional equation).

nodes.name: Slot capacity in MS Lemma 17.1 (r + 2z < 1 versus r + z < 1), and whether the K-loss is the true size of the marked row norm

nodes.name: Hecke defect on p-primitive tests for all p jointly: closed (`c1-spinor-hecke-primitive`, refereed twice)
nodes.statement: On smooth compactly supported one-sided tests, jointly S-primitive tests (finite S) are dense in norm and in Q_L simultaneously, and the all-prime class {W(1/2) = 0} likewise; the infimum of Q_L/norm^2 and the negative index are the same as on all tests (row P35). Not established: the same statement for DH (zeros right of Re s = 1) and for E_a with a >= 1/8; the identification of the bound with P10. Open remainder: size of sum over zeros of abs(zeta_S(1/2 + i gamma))^2 abs(W(i gamma))^2 against norm(Z_S w)^2 as S grows (largest-value type). Round 2: the open remainder is decided as a mean value (row P41, `c2-euler-at-zeros`, `c2-euler-at-zeros-scale`): the sum is the Landau-Gonek diagonal, shared by DH and by the Liouville twist at rho/2; no one-sided inequality separates zeta.

nodes.name: Multi-delay sections of the prime chain: closed in two forms (`c1-multidelay-bohr-section`, refereed twice); three forms open
nodes.statement: Closed: (a) additive, finite P: no positive-real function h = H((p^{-z})_{p in P}), Re H >= 0 on the polydisc, can be split off xi'/xi as a positive-real summand unless it is an imaginary constant (row Q12); (b) multiplicative: no bounded multi-delay factor divides S (trivial, gamma growth). Within the unipotent chain family the joint defect is rank one and additive and every twist is a torus translation. Open: a J-inner linear-fractional section in several delays with Theta(0) = M(c_0) U_0, c_0 > 0, not additive; infinite P (needs sum over P-smooth m of m^{-c} finite for some c < 1/2); the DH analogue (the diagonal term is not a point evaluation, no forced sign); boundary nodes of R_a for a >= 1/2 (not treated in round 1). Against, unchanged: the Fejer-tapered joint section is an explicit-formula identity equivalent to RH that uses no multiplicativity. Round 2 (`c2-jinner-multidelay-lft`; Theorem A' refereed twice): the J-inner linear-fractional form, infinite P and the DH analogue are closed (rows Q12, Q22); the first-moment no-go holds for DH. Remaining from this item: boundary nodes of R_a for a >= 1/2; sections on a Reinhardt shell or containing the gamma term.

nodes.name: Positive-definiteness of log F(sigma + iu) for 1/2 < sigma <= 1: closed as a restatement (`c1-pd-log-strip`, refereed once)
nodes.statement: The Fourier transform of the horizontal branch is the prime atoms minus the density (e^{(1-sigma)x} - 1)/x plus one term per zero right of sigma. Raw positive-definiteness fails on every line 1/2 < sigma < 1 (Omega-theorem argument). Positivity of the compensated transform CP(sigma) is equivalent to no zeros with Re s > sigma, and the implication towards zeros uses only the half-line x < 0, which contains no primes. Three sigma-transport mechanisms fail at the pole; a general no-transport theorem is not proved.

nodes.name: Quadratic or mean-value positivity with automorphic companions (beyond linear 3-4-1): closed for pointwise outputs (`c6-quadratic-companion-positivity`, refereed once; row P50)
nodes.statement: Log-level squares lie in the P25 cone; products need admissible linear factors; coefficient squares are positive for every sequence, twist-invariant and positive for DH; Landau on L(s, Pi x Pi~) reaches Re s = 1 only. The density (family) half was not run: MV-CAP (P29) and the even-moment row apply to it. Not covered: positivity of quadratic objects that are not Dirichlet series (periods, triple products, theta lifts), which are other rows (`ap-squares-rallis`, `e1-*` lanes).

nodes.statement: On E_P = span{e^(-p_k t)}: Blaschke reflection is an isometry of E_P and the two mean times sum to the Blaschke phase-speed average (PHASE-SPLIT). Every mean-time pencil eigenvalue is strictly decreasing in each rate, so mu_max(P) < x_max(L_K)/(2 min P) for distinct rates.

nodes.statement: The pseudo-Laplacian side has an unconditional provable half, but the bridge from zeros to eigenvalues is provably false: wide-support pair-correlation caps capture at about 94%. The overlap of provable and sufficient is empty for this route.

nodes.statement: R1 multiplicativity used essentially; R2 height-uniform, every window; R3 controls fail for a structural reason; R4 reaches the critical line. The 7/8 architecture scores 3 (lacks R4). Used with three referees on any lane scoring >= 3.

nodes.statement: Positivity across u = ln 2 is an exact cancellation of the archimedean term against the p=2 term; residual/P_2 = 7.5e-5 on the Slepian gap. CC theorem is near-sharp (7-18% past (ln 2)/2). The second adelic direction block-diagonalises into L(s,chi) Weil forms (a family statement).

nodes.statement: For at most N rates in [nu, R nu], depth d, x = nu d: sqrt(Lambda) <= e^{-x}[L_{N-1}(-2Rx) + 2 sum_{k<=N-2} L_k(-2Rx)]; no separation denominators. Two-sided at R=1: sqrt(Lambda_conf) = e^{-x}(2x)^{N-1}/(N-1)! (1+o(1)).

nodes.statement: Forward de Bruijn-Newman flow preserves reality of zeros, so t_c(N) lies at negative time; the credit -t_c in Lambda <= -t_c + E(N) is not available. Upper bounds run through barrier realness above verified height. Row P31.

nodes.statement: Co-centred signed sup R = 1/2 at every fixed depth; any signed bound R <= F(y_min) forces F >= 1/2. Exact rational witness N=2 refutes R <= e^{-y_min} for multi-rate signed families (factor 3/2). Certificates must be priced by count, weight, or modulus/phase.

nodes.name: sigma(a)=sup|Xi(z-ia)/Xi(z+ia)| takes values in {1, infinity}
nodes.statement: By Hadamard/Blaschke structure sigma(a) is 1 (no zeros in the strip) or infinite. The measured norm ||R|| about 1.33 is not a constant to push below 1; the gap is norm versus pole-freeness. Related obstruction row G2 (coupling norm).

nodes.name: Crossing elasticities sum to zero by degree-0 homogeneity
nodes.statement: E_N = E_trunc + E_flow + E_coll, sigma = E_coll/E_N: scaling all three amplitudes leaves sigma and the crossing N_L invariant, so E_CC + E_ET + E_CF = 0 and E_CF/E_ET = E_flow/E_trunc.

nodes.name: sigma_2 is sign-indefinite: no definite de Branges realisation
nodes.statement: w_1 has a negative dip on (6.945, 10.532), so sigma_2 is not a de Branges weight; two-window split bound crosses 0 at 2a = 0.6026 < ln 2. An indefinite Krein-Langer realisation relocates the gap to the same concentration inequality.

nodes.name: FE-compatible signed arm designs reconstruct Davenport-Heilbronn
nodes.statement: Functional-equation compatibility pins arm signs to root numbers; every design with at least 2 arms is a DH-type combination, and Voronin universality gives >> T off-line zeros. DH control.

nodes.name: SL0 dictionary E_a = Xi(z+ia)
nodes.statement: With A_a=8 int Phi cosh(2au)cos(2zu), B_a=8 int Phi sinh(2au)sin(2zu), Xi=8 int Phi cos(2 lambda u): E_a := A_a - i B_a = Xi(z+ia). Verified to 1e-30 on the trig core, 1e-15 in full. Canonical shift is a; imp-3382 channel numerics use shift a/2.

nodes.name: SL2 flow-blindness no-go
nodes.statement: Any hypothesis stable under Phi -> e^{-eps u^2} Phi cannot imply all zeros real: since Lambda >= 0, the backward-flowed function has a non-real zero for every eps>0. A proof must use arithmetic input. Obstruction rows F1, F2; HEAT control.

nodes.name: Connes-Consani W = S - E port stops at ln 2
nodes.statement: For any S containing a prime, E_S o Q is unbounded above along p=2 resonances for every 2a > ln 2 (measured 210 vs predicted 202); the CC condition E o Q <= c |ghat(0)|^2 fails and no finite-rank correction repairs it. Forced by Euler-factor covariance of F_S.

nodes.name: Stat-mech creative sweep: 8 routes reduce to Weil positivity
nodes.statement: Reflection positivity, arithmetic freeze-flow, signed interferometer, Peierls, Widom, Kramers-Wannier, log-gas RG, Connes-Consani scaling site: each worked to a verdict; all reduce to Weil positivity. Symmetry-forced properties of sigma=1/2 are RH-blind; no soft deformation confines zeros.

nodes.name: T3(a) iff E_a Hermite-Biehler iff zero-free strip
nodes.statement: Via the Hermite-Biehler reproducing kernel, twin-ladder T3(a) holds iff E_a is in the Hermite-Biehler class iff zeta has no zero with Re s > 1/2 + a. T3(a) for all a>0 is RH. T3 is a restatement of the strip statement, not a mechanism.

nodes.name: THEOREM AW: alias-grid octave weight diverges
nodes.statement: Alias grid = punctured lattice {n/p : n <= pD, p not dividing n}; width law mu(d) = d^{1/3}/c (beta = 1/3); octave weight (5/32)(pD)^{2/3} <= W(p,D) <= (28/3)(pD)^{2/3}. Bounded weight iff width exponent > 1. Exact identity x(D/2) = 1/Q.

nodes.name: Twin-ladder v52 conjectures 15.2, 15.4, 17.3, 18.4, 22.4 are RH restatements
nodes.statement: Shift contractivity (15.2), Re(xi'/xi) > 0 via paired Hadamard (15.4), ghost absence (17.3), Weil-Pontryagin (18.4), zero bridge thickness (22.4) are each equivalent to RH. Unaudited with nontrivial content: 15.3, 16.4, 16.6, 18.1, 18.2 (Hilbert brackets, canonical-system closures, KYP realisations).

nodes.name: Unaudited v52 constructive claims 15.3, 16.4, 16.6, 18.1, 18.2
nodes.statement: Constructive existence claims for Hilbert-space brackets, canonical-system closures and KYP (bounded-real) realisations in the twin-ladder paper; not yet classified as RH-equivalent, literature, or new. Later correction PRs 31-37 revised KYP and de Branges page statuses.

nodes.name: V7 discrepancy floor to zero-free region: p -> (1+p)/2
nodes.statement: If eps_0(lambda) >= -C (1 + log lambda)^m lambda^p then zeta is zero-free for Re s > (1+p)/2. Direct attempts stopped at the one-sided Landau/V7 floor with p = 0, i.e. the all-scale signed arithmetic estimate is the open item.

nodes.name: Varying-modulus Vasyunin cotangent mean: sum_a V(b,a)/(phi(b) b) -> -1/(4 pi)
nodes.statement: Measured to b = 30030: the coefficient converges to -0.079579 (gap 1.4e-6 from -1/(4 pi)), giving kappa_cot = 1/8. Weaker sufficient statement for kappa > 0: liminf kappa_cot > -0.5705 (boundedness below of the Bettin-Conrey cotangent mean value).

nodes.name: Verified zero height X binds every rigorous Lambda bound
nodes.statement: Three decompositions (Rouche corridor margin about 1.23; Polymath15 AFE tail margin 1.047, X-independent; constant audit: only E_trunc_pt ~ T_PT^{-kappa} gates) show barrier slack is non-binding at Lambda <= 0.2; Lambda <= 0.19 needs X = 2e13. Rows F3, F5, F6.

nodes.name: Volterra norm ||V_{a,Phi}|| <= 1
nodes.statement: True only for a <= a* (31.62 canonical kernel, 37.66 surrogate), false above; the section-27 identity (||V|| <= 1 iff K_a >= 0) is refuted in both directions; the 5000x margin is a homogeneity artifact (||V_{c Phi}|| = c^2 ||V_Phi||). Passive-norm target is RH-equivalent. Row P20.

nodes.name: Moment ladder of the pole-free Weil margin at (ln 3)/2
nodes.statement: Minimum of the Weil form at a=(ln 3)/2 under successive constraints: 9.5e-4 (pole-free) -> 0.0334 (hhat(0)=0) -> 0.414 (hhat'(0)=0) -> 0.799 -> 0.814 (saturates). Negativity of the unconstrained minimiser sits in the dip band [7.4,10.8): -0.263 vs well -0.009.

nodes.name: sigma=1/2 as fluctuation-susceptibility peak
nodes.statement: Parseval in 2 sigma halves the Hagedorn abscissa 1 -> 1/2, so sigma=1/2 is the susceptibility peak of the primon gas. The property is forced by symmetry and is RH-blind (equivalent to Bohr-Landau/Littlewood zero-density statements).

nodes.name: Winding monotonicity under the flow (de Bruijn Thm 13 + jet lemma)
nodes.statement: Even-multiplicity jets under dH/dt = -H_xx are scaled Hermite polynomials with all roots real forward in t (no lift-off); with de Bruijn's landing rate this is the architecture Lambda <= t_0 + Delta^2/2. Classical; gives no bound beyond verification height.

nodes.name: WOL-C weak outer lemma at P47
nodes.statement: sup(Phi - K0*) <= -0.0015629 on all 369 open P47 floors (two implementations, no violation); best proof methods give margins >= 0.0748 against a needed 0.0436 (0.0223 for WOL-C). Gap is proof looseness; needs a new label representation. Row F6.

nodes.name: Exceptional coset duality: xi^6 = 1
nodes.statement: The exceptional coset producing the P_a^{1/6} term exists exactly when xi^6 = 1, the same condition that produces the high-side signal; subtract, Holder and restrict all fail. PR 14 sixth-phase filter retains eigenvalue one for the same reason. Rows Z9, Z1.

nodes.name: Xu-Sang system ceiling B* = 49619/53814 - sqrt(715621)/17938
nodes.statement: B* about 0.87488665 is the optimum of the Xu-Sang estimate system (equals the PR 14 Mobius-energy value). Cubic R2 conductor a = 4 closes the cubic lever. Row Z10.

nodes.name: Zero-density estimates cannot move Lambda or certify N=0
nodes.statement: N(sigma,T) << T^{c(1-sigma)+eps} is a positive upper bound (>1 at relevant T); it never certifies N=0 in a strip. The full Density Hypothesis moves the rigorous Lambda by zero. Guth-Maynard and Tao-Trudgian-Yang are not Lambda levers. Row Z17.

nodes.name: Density floor from the uniform lattice
nodes.statement: For an equally spaced lattice of spacing d: sup_x Im M(x + iy) = (pi/d) coth(pi y/d) (Mittag-Leffler cotangent identity). With d = 2 pi/log(gamma/2 pi) this gives the measured V0/log(gamma/2 pi) = 0.48458, constant to machine precision over the height ladder.

nodes.name: Mesoscopic strip gives an N-uniform propagation constant
nodes.statement: Restricting the backward-flow Gronwall lemma (imp-2520) to Im z >= y* with sub-front horizon S < y*^2 E_vac/2 gives an N-uniform propagation constant L_prop = 2/y*^2; the accumulation constant L_field = 2N/y*^2 remains N-linear.

nodes.name: Running minimum gap exponent of zeros versus GUE N^{-1/3}
nodes.statement: g_min/y_N on a 14-rung ladder: fitted exponent -0.3953 against the GUE value -1/3; two-term model A N^{-1/3}(1+c/log N) tested; difference assessed as finite-N/plateau bias.

nodes.name: Min-gap field-Lipschitz surrogate L_gap ~ c_pair/g^2
nodes.statement: On the real axis at the collapsing-pair scale the field-Lipschitz surrogate is c_pair/g^2 with no factor N (L_strip/L_gap = 2N), but its accumulation integral log-diverges at the front: E_acc = (c_pair/8) log(g0^2/g_min^2). Obligation I3 collapses into the g_min > 0 certificate.

nodes.name: Minimal-gap sandwich for the collision time
nodes.statement: Gap ODE dr/ds = -4/r + 2 r B(s); u = r^2 gives du/ds = -8 + 4 B u. If |B| <= beta then (1/(4 beta)) log(1 + beta g^2/2) <= t_c <= -(1/(4 beta)) log(1 - beta g^2/2). Isolated pair: g0^2/8 <= t_c <= (g0^2/8)(1 + x), x = E0 g0^2/4 <= 1/2.

nodes.name: Uniform field bound beta g^2 < 0.909 for the minimal gap
nodes.statement: The sandwich upper bound on the gap ODE beats the free A1 trap iff beta g^2 < x* ~ 0.909 (existence gate beta g^2 < 2). The density model sits two orders inside; a uniform proof along the true backward flow is missing.

nodes.name: Minimum-phase identity on vertical lines
nodes.statement: For 1/2 <= sigma < 1, F_sigma = zeta(s)(s-1)/(s + 1 - 2 sigma): arg F_sigma(sigma + it) = H_sigma[log|zeta(sigma + i.)|](t) + arg B_sigma(sigma + it), B_sigma the Blaschke product over zeros with beta > sigma; exact Hilbert relation iff no zeros right of sigma (sigma = 1/2: RH).

nodes.name: Conditional flow-descent theorem B1 (mirror descent), residuals (a),(b)
nodes.statement: Proved modulo residuals. Lower edge transfers: the P15 barrier is a rectangle winding count constant in t. Hard half: localisation keeping topmost nonreal zeros at x>=X+1, i.e. a uniform-in-t, all-x lower bound M>=p_req=4.37426 on the mirror pull at y0=0.165 for t in (0,0.1314].

nodes.name: Mirror-descent hypothesis H_desc-mirror(p_req=4.3743) fails at seam height
nodes.statement: At the working row (t0=0.1314, y0=0.165) the neutral rigid-lattice Palm mirror count is 2.529 (2-slot) and 3.854 (1-slot); empirical zeta-block minima about 2.67. All are below p_req=4.3743. The 2-slot count grows with slope 0.395 in ln N and reaches p_req at ln N*=18.394.

nodes.name: t = 0 Euler-product descent rate for a topmost zero
nodes.statement: For a globally topmost zero dy/dt is bounded by a wide-Poisson term (eta >= sqrt(5) y); at t = 0 the Euler product gives a descent rate for a hypothetical topmost zero at one instant only. Extending to t > 0 needs pointwise input at sigma < 1 (NS-RIGID wall).

nodes.name: Mirror pair lemma for heat-flow descent
nodes.statement: A nonreal neighbour and its conjugate at horizontal offset Delta, no higher than z = x + iy, pull z down by at least f(2y) = 2y/(Delta^2 + 4y^2): the Poisson kernel at double width, against 2y/(Delta^2 + y^2) for a real zero; ratio in [1/4, 1).

nodes.name: Route I: {inf,2,3} lacunary relations force g(v)=C/v
nodes.statement: Composing g(v)=2g(2v) and g(v)=3g(3v) over the tail interior gives g(v)=2^a3^b g(2^a3^b v) for all (a,b) in Z^2; density of 2^a3^b forces the single profile g(v)=C/v (partial result toward no modulus-1 eigenvalue for the mixed prolate ladder).

nodes.name: Cubic tail sum of the mixed 2^a 3^b prolate ladder
nodes.statement: For the mixed 2^a 3^b ladder Sum_tail |lam|^3 = (C/8)(G2 G3 - 1) = 1.769529 at C=2, a convergent geometric double sum because 2^{-1/2} and 3^{-1/2} are below 1. The ladder tail supremum is s_2 = 0.353553, attained once at u=2; adding the prime 5 leaves it unchanged.

nodes.name: Mobius deaveraging has an exact fixed-power price
nodes.statement: M(x)=O(x^{7/8} log^K x) implies R_{1,1/4}(x)=O(x^{1/8} log^K x), which would prove the staged strip; it is stronger at boundary multiplicities and not known. Multiplier zeta(2s) cannot cancel an excluded right-half zero; sparse support is prime times square.

nodes.name: Centered Mobius sum: cutoff sign reversals
nodes.statement: At x=65536, U=V=64 the corrected jointly centered sum is J=-0.0504355617852 (50 digits), while uncorrected partial sums J_K are 0.00797 (K=2048), -0.45106 (4096), 0.48086 (8192). Tail omission is refuted; raising K cannot improve the corrected value (cutoff-transfer identity).

nodes.name: Mobius packet block-energy target
nodes.statement: S(L)=sum_d mu(d)d^{-1/2}F(L-log d)=sum_n Lambda(n)n^{-1/2}k(log n-L), F(y)=sum_{m>=2}(log m)m^{-1/2}k(log m-y). int_j^{j+1}|S|^2<=Ce^{0.7496j} for large j gives boundary B=0.8748. Open part: signed pairs with small common divisor and large separation.

nodes.name: Off-axis fold amplitude and its phase winding
nodes.statement: A(theta)=int |u|^{-1/2}/(w-u)^2 du with w=e^{i theta} equals (pi/2)(1-i)e^{-3i theta/2}; |A|=pi/sqrt(2), arg(-A)=3pi/4-3theta/2, real-positive only at theta=pi/2 on (0,pi). For exponent alpha the winding rate is d arg(-A)/d theta=-(1+alpha).

nodes.name: Model-cusp ratio rho(eps) = C_ren/C_curv expansion
nodes.statement: On the quadratic fold z0* = i eps, eps = sqrt(2 pi/N), the ratio rho -> 2/3 with next term coefficient K = 8 sqrt(2)/(9 pi) at order eps^(3/2) (not 2/5; difference about 1.4e-4). H3 curvature input suffices for the H4 strip-height derivative at the operative strip height on the ladder N = 1e3..1e7.

nodes.name: Modular-surface scattering matrix through the bridge
nodes.statement: phi(s) = Lambda(2s-1)/Lambda(2s) = c_inf(s) chi(2s-1) Z(s), c_inf = sqrt(pi) Gamma(s-1/2)/Gamma(s), chi the bridge, Z(s) = zeta(2-2s)/zeta(2s); equivalently phi = beta Z with beta = pi^{2s-1} Gamma(1-s)/Gamma(s), each unimodular on Re s = 1/2. Poles in 0 < Re s < 1/2 are exactly rho/2.

nodes.name: Modulus-last ordering (defect-packet telescope)
nodes.statement: sum_j D_j=E97 over 25 prime packets (p=97..2). At x=6.0000039e12 (N=690988): sum|D_j|=0.24375414 (modulus first) versus |E97|=0.18149721 (recombine first); both below R_ex=0.27969. Telescope verified to 2.55e-14. Taking moduli per prime discards the phases.

nodes.name: Mollified barrier certificate: min-modulus gain exactly 0
nodes.statement: min|Mf|/max|M| <= min|f|. A mollifier turns the phase-blind triangle bound from -0.155 to +0.206 at x0=2.83e13 but cannot beat the unmollified barrier. Longer mollifiers at fixed height have ceiling Lambda_ceil(X)=min(1, gamma ||A/B||); obstructed for y>=0.14 on the 0.145 line.

nodes.name: Mollified Weil form reduces to the plain Weil form
nodes.statement: With M(s) = sum_{n<=N} m_n n^{-s}, mu = sum m_n n^{-1/2} delta_{log n}, h = g*g~: sum_rho h^(gamma_rho) M(rho) M(1-rho) = W(G*G~), G = mu*g supported in [-a, a + log N]. So a*_mol >= a*_plain - (1/2) log N; DH passes whenever 2a + log N <= ln 11.

nodes.name: Holomorphy constraint on mollifier weights
nodes.statement: A weight with an explicit-formula representation equal to |M(1/2 + it)|^2 on the line weights off-line zeros by M(rho) M(1 - rho), not |M(rho)|^2. A finite-length weight Phi(rho) Phi*(1 - rho) with measure support L gives the plain form at A = a + L/2.

nodes.name: Mollifier-length ceiling in the l^1 certificate class
nodes.statement: In the Wiener-algebra certificate class the infimum over all mollifiers of the lane mass is min(1, gamma ||A/B||); this caps the length lever at Lambda about 0.154-0.156 and excludes coefficient-magnitude certificates below about 0.1455 at X = 6.0e12.

nodes.name: Mollifier reshaping of the pinned prefactor C_F is bounded by 1 + theta
nodes.statement: The admissible-mollifier reshaping of the pinned flow prefactor C_F (imp-398) is bounded by the mollified second-moment amplification 1+theta: at most about 1.571 for the longest rigorous mollifier (Conrey theta=4/7). A mollifier changes the flow term by an O(1) factor only.

nodes.name: Levinson-Conrey mollified moments cannot confine zeros to a strip
nodes.statement: Proportion records (1/3, 2/5, 0.4105, 0.4128, 5/12) count zeros on the line by a mean-value argument tied to the line by symmetry; confining a proportion to |sigma-1/2|<eps needs zero density. No Lambda bound follows.

nodes.name: Saddle ratio of A-weighted moments dips below 1
nodes.statement: Q_n = M_{n+2}/M_n follows tau*(n)^2 with n = 4 pi tau* e^{4 tau*}; correction eps_n changes sign near n = 149; exact-saddle ratio R_n crosses 1 at n* = 215.2, has a sub-unity well (min ~ -5.8e-4 near n ~ 500) and recovers from below up to n = 2200. Three independent quadratures agree.

nodes.name: Moments reach zeros only through Littlewood's lemma
nodes.statement: Measured |I(200)| = 0.92 against the Jensen bound 130.4 (loss 141x); the pointwise channel (negative moments) is RH-equivalent and runs through the mollifier lineage. Landscape pointwise wall.

nodes.name: MONO-N: the signed N-rate shift constant decreases in every rate
nodes.statement: Lambda(nu,d) is strictly decreasing in each rate nu_i, so at fixed x = nu_min d the supremum over configurations is the fully confluent span (COAL-DOM for N = 2, DOM-N for all N). Proof: Descartes rule for exponential sums, variation-diminishing Laplace kernel, Danskin envelope.

nodes.name: Envelope form of the collision-time monotonicity
nodes.statement: Pointwise per-N monotonicity (M) of the collision ladder fails at small N (12 certified violations) but the envelope restatement (M-env) is a theorem and suffices for the intercept conclusion; trajectory domination resolved positive.

nodes.name: Moving-reference Rouche gluing over analytic phase charts
nodes.statement: Cover the contour by overlapping charts with analytic winding-0 references Q_k and certify |F - Q_k| < |Q_k| on each. On a faithful toy model the cover is valid (min inf|Q_k| ~ 0.71 against residual ~ 0.22) but the residual equals the constant-centre value 0.2141255: no budget relaxation.

nodes.name: ms slot condition is reflected dual length
nodes.statement: Lemma 17.1 condition r+2z <= m equals T_d <= F on the reflected dual length of Lemma 14.3 (principal configuration, r+z >= 2m/3, r+3z >= m); the 2z_a comes from mark primes in the reflection conductor.

nodes.name: Diagonal measure fails to dominate the shear on 64% of tau; cosh completion covers it
nodes.statement: At the genuine Riemann Phi, mu_diag does not dominate the shear nu on about 64% of the tau range (degree-0 measure). Endpoint-bridge weight w(tau)=cosh(a tau) gives residual deficit exactly 0; B/D(s)=(sinh s-s)/(cosh s-s+arcsinh1-sqrt2), s=aU; one operator obstruction remains.

nodes.name: Multi-rung pole-free positivity margin law
nodes.statement: Symbol w_K = 2 theta' - sum_{n<=K} 2 Lambda(n) n^{-1/2} cos(t ln n). W >= c ||h||^2 with c = 8.55e-8 (ln 4), 2.25e-12 (ln 5), 6.25e-17 (ln 6), 5.62e-42 (ln 11, conditional); log10 c about -4.82 e^{2a} + 12.1. Obstruction map P19 / S7 (verified-height content).

nodes.name: Multi-rung Weil symbol w_K
nodes.statement: For support 2a <= ln(K+1) the pole-free Weil form is W(h) = (1/2 pi) int w_K |h^|^2 with w_K = 2 theta' - sum_{n<=K} beta_n cos(t ln n), beta_n = 2 Lambda(n)/sqrt n; rungs n > K drop out, so a certificate at ln(K+1) covers every smaller support.

nodes.name: Theorem B'_m: multi-band Lemma B with line walls
nodes.statement: Band argument split into m bands by certified line walls and local RH windows (width > 7252): 4 bands give 0.145620383931826, band 1 binds. Slab walls instead of line walls cost about c f^4/8 in Lambda. Unrefereed.

nodes.name: Theorem MT: completely multiplicative unimodular twin with a planted zero
nodes.statement: For 1/2 < beta_0 <= 7/8 almost every realisation f: N -> S^1 completely multiplicative has F_1 = sum f(n) n^{-s} holomorphic in Re s > 1/2 with exactly one simple zero at beta_0, all harmonics F_k (|k| >= 2) zero-free there, and the all-scale prime alignment. No functional equation.

nodes.name: No node set is both Muntz-complete and a Riesz sequence of Cauchy kernels
nodes.statement: For real nodes s_k > 1, completeness of the Cauchy kernels in H^2 of the half-plane and the Riesz-sequence property are opposite sides of the single Blaschke sum sum 1/s_k. Lacunary lattices carry certificates but not RH; complete sets reach RH but have no trace-class structure. Row P18.

nodes.name: Function-side MV-CAP
nodes.statement: Open after route 42: a counter-model surviving explicit sigma >= 1 L^2 inputs, or a proof that L^2 mean values at sigma > 1/2 force the local count. The 2026-11 campaign built cluster lifts F = zeta (p+q)/p with sup |F/zeta - 1| <= 8.7e-6 at sigma = 2 (relative to an unverified window hypothesis).

nodes.name: Function-side L^2 mean values exclude the MV-CAP counter-model
nodes.statement: At sigma = 2 a Montgomery-Vaughan short-interval mean value (Delta about 2.2e4 against error about 10) and |zeta(1+it)| <= (3/4) log t exclude the window-replacement model at c0 = 5e5 (measured). MV-CAP is therefore not a theorem for explicit function-side L^2 premises.

nodes.name: Function-side MV-CAP with explicit constants is not established
nodes.statement: For explicit-constant second-moment premises the obstruction depends on the hole size: a minimal one-pair modification changes the local integral of |zeta|^2 by -2.4 against error RMS 104, but holes of 7-17 mean spacings raise |zeta| on the line by factors 38 to 8e7. Whether explicit function-side moments can certify a window is open.

nodes.name: Window sensitivities of mean-value premises
nodes.statement: Under one window replacement: critical-zero and simple-zero counts change by <= 2 outside the window and <= 19.3 inside; density counts N(sigma,T) by <= 1; N(T) by <= 17.3; normalised pair-correlation sums by <= 9.3e-9 at T = 3.1e12. A certifying premise needs slack below about 20 zeros out of 1.3e13.

nodes.name: MV-CAP theorem: zero-side mean-value premises cannot certify every-window statements
nodes.statement: For every centre c in [3.1e12, 7.5e16] some zeta_W differing from zeta only in ordinates (c-50, c+50] violates H_desc(p) for all p > 3.0119 (lane needs 4.3743). Any premise set satisfied by zeta_W cannot derive the lane hypothesis. Proved for zero-side and O-form premises only.

nodes.name: MV-CAP: window-replacement counter-models (route 42)
nodes.statement: xi_W = kappa xi Q_{W'}/Q_W keeps the functional equation, order 1, residue 1, the zero-free region and explicit N(T) bounds while the every-window hypothesis H_desc fails (p_viol <= 3.0119 < 4.3743). Proved for zero-side and O-form premises; not established for explicit function-side L^2 mean values. Obstruction map P29.

nodes.name: MV-CAP theorem for zero-side premises
nodes.statement: Window replacement: for any centre c0 in [3.1e12, 7.50e16] a model zeta_W has a nonreal zero z* = 2c + 0.17i with mirror count <= 3.0119 < p_req = 4.3743, N(sigma,T) up by <= 1, new pair beta <= 0.585. A certifying zero-side premise needs slack < 19.3 zeros, relative precision <= 1.5e-12.

nodes.name: N-uniform fold-modulus back-conversion
nodes.statement: Upgrading rho -> 2/3 from a ladder observation to an N-uniform bound needs five uniform-in-eps inputs on the Riemann-von Mangoldt Holder-1/2 cusp jet (uniform H4 amplitude, curvature lower bound, remainder control, fold inversion, back-conversion).

nodes.name: Finite native-span Pick statements survive backward flow to eps = 1e5
nodes.statement: lambda_min of the Caratheodory-Pick matrix of xi'/xi at real node sets {1,2}, {1,2,4}, {1,2,4,8}, {0.55,1,3,10} stays positive for Phi e^{-eps u^2} up to eps = 1e5 (e.g. 8.75e-4 -> 4.57e-17). Mechanism: sign of the fourth cumulant kappa_4 < 0 (gamma_4 = -95.343). The all-node family has kappa = 0.

nodes.name: Nyman-Beurling/Baez-Duarte rate restates a zero-free half-plane (obstruction map P14)
nodes.statement: log d_N / log N -> -max(0, sigma_0 - Theta): a distance rate eta at sigma_0 is equivalent (up to eps) to zero-freeness for Re s > sigma_0 - eta. Route M Gram statistics feed this object and inherit the equivalence.

nodes.name: Near-Muntz-threshold Blaschke cones nu_k = k^p
nodes.statement: For non-separated Blaschke node sets nu_k = k^p, p = 1.1-1.25, the heuristic horizon T_p ~ (2.2 C_p)^{p/(p-1)} passes 3e12 near p = 1.13 while margins tend to 0. Whether such cones carry zero information above the verified height is open; reduction to the pointwise wall is an analogy.

nodes.name: Theorem NFT: torus phase vectors attain the off-line alignment
nodes.statement: For every delta_0 <= 3/8, gamma_0 > 3e12 and support, some torus phase vector reaches the alignment an off-line zero would force: with phases in {0, pi}, L~_a = 39.06 vs target 13.45 at 2a = 8.767 (ratio 2.90) and 466.8 vs 119.9 at 2a = 13.69.

nodes.name: No-modulus-1 theorem for A_S23 reduced to the single profile C/v
nodes.statement: On the ladder-tail interior the functional equations at p=2 and p=3 (g(v)=2g(2v) and its p=3 analogue) collapse the candidate modulus-1 eigenfunctions from ln2-periodic Zygmund modulations of 1/v to g(v)=C/v. Open: C=0. Indicated by the p=2 top eigenvalue 0.9999731<1, not enclosed.

nodes.name: No PSD partition of the positive core repairs both channels
nodes.statement: At a=1/4, z=(-1/2,0,1/2)+i/5: beta_R>1.027286016, beta_S>0.42200180358, sum>1.449>1. Radial and shear are symmetric and skew parts of one theta tensor; each integration slice is indefinite, so positivity must be theta-specific and appear only after integration.

nodes.name: Theorem 6.2: no Riemann-Roch datum exists on S_Q
nodes.statement: On the graph-class space S_Q, |N.A| = {N.A} and |K - N.A| is empty for large N, so no function h satisfies the Riemann-Roch axioms: h(N.A) + h(K - N.A) <= 1 while the Riemann-Roch quantity grows like N^2. Holds whether or not RH is true.

nodes.name: Nonlocal / arithmetic pole-term bridge past ln 2
nodes.statement: No local, finite-rank or fixed-measure pole-term bridge carries pole-free positivity to the full Weil form past 2a = ln 2. Nonlocal or arithmetic bridges are not excluded; soft nonlocal ones fall under flow-blindness.

nodes.name: Lemma NT norm-transfer closed form
nodes.statement: sup_x h(x,s)/sqrt(x) = c(s) = exp(1/2)(1 - 1/(2s))^s / sqrt(s - 1/2), attained at x = s - 1/2; c(11) = 0.30501088924617725. Converts kernel mass to legality mass in the ballast-witness argument.

nodes.name: Routes A-G converge on Weil positivity
nodes.statement: All seven stat-mech routes reduce to Caratheodory-Pick positivity of xi'/xi on Re s > 1/2. L1: symmetry-forced features of sigma = 1/2 are RH-blind. L2: no soft / RG / duality deformation confines zeros.

nodes.name: LEMMA PICK-ID / SGN-NP: Nevanlinna-Pick matrix = seam pencil
nodes.statement: The half-plane Nevanlinna-Pick matrix for data w_i = e^{-d nu_i} equals entrywise the seam pencil rho^2 G - D G D (Szego kernel at real nodes = Cauchy Gram); the signed shift constant Lambda is the squared minimal H^inf(C_+) interpolant norm exactly. Multiplier route terminal.

nodes.name: Theorem NS-RIGID (native-span softness dichotomy)
nodes.statement: P_S(eps)_ij=(phi_eps(s_i)+phi_eps(s_j))/(s_i+s_j-1), phi_0=xi'/xi, finite S in (1,inf). Either P_S(0)>0, then P_S(eps)>0 for small eps (flow-stable, useless), or P_S(0) not PD and RH is false. Only the full family over all finite S is flow-critical, and it equals RH.

nodes.name: Lacunary node sets do not reach RH (NS-RIGID A6)
nodes.statement: If sum 1/s_k<inf (e.g. geometric lattices nu_0 rho^k), the nodes form a Blaschke sequence and Pick positivity on them only gives some Caratheodory interpolant, not F=phi. Reaching RH needs sum 1/s_k=inf (Muntz-complete sets), where the trace-class structure is unavailable. Obstruction map row P18.

nodes.name: Loophole outside NS-RIGID: Dirichlet-coefficient inputs on the line
nodes.statement: Inputs that consume Dirichlet coefficients on the critical line (Levinson-Conrey mollifiers, Selberg proportion, near-line density) are flow-critical, non-circular, not RH-equivalent, and not covered by NS-RIGID. Whether any such input yields an every-window statement is open.

nodes.name: THEOREM NS-RIGID (native-span softness dichotomy)
nodes.statement: Every finite Caratheodory-Pick positivity statement P_S >= 0 on the flow native span is either flow-stable (survives past Rodgers-Tao) or already refutes RH; the only flow-critical member is the all-S family, which is RH. Matches obstruction map P3/P5 (finite Pick stages).

nodes.name: NS-RIGID: finite native-span positivity is flow-stable or refutes RH
nodes.statement: With P_S(eps)_ij = (phi_eps(s_i) + phi_eps(s_j))/(s_i + s_j - 1) for the backward heat flow H_{-eps}: P_S(eps) is real-analytic in eps; if P_S(0) > 0 it stays positive for small eps where zeros are off the line. The all-S family holds iff RH and fails for every eps > 0. Obstruction map rows F1, P3.

nodes.name: Flowed Pick pencil stays PSD ten orders past Lehmer collision
nodes.statement: lam_min(P_S(eps)) for nu={1,2,4}: 3.2421e-5 at eps=0, 2.900e-5 at eps=1, 3.02e-8 at eps=100; positive on eps in [1e-12,1e2], while Xi_eps has non-real zeros unconditionally for eps>1.15e-11.

nodes.name: Primes enter native-span forms through n scalars (PICK-WEIL A1)
nodes.statement: Every Hermitian form built from the explicit formula on the span E_V(S) is a function of P_S(0) and the Cauchy Gram; the primes enter only through the n numbers zeta'/zeta(s_i), s_i>1. Multiplicativity is not visible to any finite node set.

nodes.name: Null-symbol dual for fixed-support Weil positivity
nodes.statement: Every W(t)=sum_j c_j cos(a_j t) with a_j>2L has zero expectation against |f^|^2 for f supported in [-L,L]. Exact dual: inf_{|f|=1}Q_L[f]=sup_{finite W}inf_t(V_L+W). At L=11/20 a single lattice of period 64pi has strictly negative optimum; off-lattice correction does not close 128pi.

nodes.name: Envelope r_cap(T) from Selberg's variance of S(T)
nodes.statement: The saturated box number variance equals 2 Var S(T), growing like (1/(2 pi^2)) log log(T/2 pi) plus a constant; r_cap(3e12) ~ 0.260 (max anchor) or 0.223 (mean anchor). The finite-height offset C0 is fitted from six heights and is not shown monotone; leave-one-out fails as an upper bound at 3 of 6.

nodes.name: Number-variance offset anchor is a sample maximum
nodes.statement: The max offset anchor C0_max=0.333721 caps the number-variance excess at 11 measured heights over about 1.5 decades (6 fitted, 5 held out), and a 25-height grid to T=6.37e5. A -16% excursion at T=1.5e5 saturates it. It is a sample maximum, not a height-uniform cap.

nodes.name: Nyman-Beurling distance and reciprocal Mobius ladders
nodes.statement: d_X^2=inf_c ||1_(0,1](x)-sum_{n<=X} c_n rho(1/(nx))||^2 in L^2(0,inf); RH iff d_X->0. M_X(s)=sum_{n<=X} mu(n)n^{-s}. Finite reciprocal constructions are compact diagnostics with no global tail or uniform margin. Map row P14.

device.evidence: map section 5 part 1; rows P14, P15, P29

nodes.name: Nyman-Beurling and the Volterra chain share no transfer mechanism (compare P14)
nodes.statement: Baez-Duarte / BBLS quantitative forms are RH-equivalent without Lambda content; no derivable map carries a Nyman-Beurling distance margin to a Volterra contraction margin or back.

nodes.name: Route M: Vasyunin Gram with Bettin-Conrey reciprocity is not external input
nodes.statement: The modular ingredient is the zeta functional equation in Estermann form; the route reduces to the Mobius mollifier lineage and to Weil positivity. The N = 500 agreement of 0.2 percent is inside a 2 percent lower-order remainder (N = 1000, 2000). Obstruction map rows P14, P15.

nodes.name: Obstruction seam: provable and sufficient halves do not overlap
nodes.statement: 16 angles on C_H and Montgomery PCC each split into a provable-but-inert half (on-basin, mesoscopic, |alpha|<=1, upper bound, t=0, finite height) and a sufficient-but-RH-hard half (min-gap lower bound, |alpha|>1 pair correlation, all-t displacement). No overlap found.

nodes.name: Pick signature of odd powers; pole does not bound index
nodes.statement: For m(z)=z^{2k+1} the Pick kernel has signature (k+1,k): at most k negative eigenvalues on any finite set. A single unpaired pole 1/(8+2i-z) added to positive masses has unbounded negative index (diagonals Im m(z_j)/eps tend to -inf).

nodes.name: Odd-sector pole term of the Weil form
nodes.statement: For odd real test g the pole term becomes -2 (int g sinh(x/2))^2 <= 0 (even: +2 (int g cosh(x/2))^2), so the odd sector can fail first: D = -23 principal form goes negative at about 1.662 (odd) against (1.679, 1.689] (even).

nodes.name: Odd-sector cutoff inequality Delta_{c,-}<=0
nodes.statement: H_c commutes with reflection about c: H_pm(x,y)=H_0(x,y) pm H_0(x,-y). The majorant G_c vanishes on odd tests, so H_{c,-}=-Delta_{c,-}. Proved: H_0(x,y)>H_0(x,-y), giving the inequality on odd preimages with p>=0. Survives every real heat time.

nodes.name: Off-anchor heights sit below the on-line margin law
nodes.statement: Over 27 off-anchor heights, 23 lie below the seven-anchor reciprocal-log line (mean -0.0305, worst -0.0608 at T=4506.31). A uniform off-line version of the LP is a statement of Weil-positivity strength; no coefficient set has a universal confining sign on complex pairs.

nodes.name: Visibility law for one off-line pair (Lemma 2)
nodes.statement: Over f in L^2[-a,a], Q(f) = Omega ||f||^2 + g^(H - i delta) + g^(H + i delta) takes a negative value iff sinh(2 a delta)/delta - 2a > Omega; the minimising direction is e^{-iHu} sinh(delta u). Gives visibility length N_vis about (2 delta log gamma)^{1/delta}.

nodes.name: Hilbert-transform wall: |xi| on the line fixes xi only up to off-line flips
nodes.statement: G entire of order <= 1 with |G| = |xi| on Re s = 1/2 implies G = e^{i alpha + lambda(s - 1/2)} xi prod_{rho in S} B~_rho(s)/B~_rho(1/2), S any multiset of off-line zeros; each off-line quadruple has 9 configurations with identical modulus on the line.

nodes.name: One point suffices iff every jet order is controlled
nodes.statement: Fixed a: J_a^(d)(z*)>=0 for all d>=0 iff K_a>=0 globally; for a_n->0 the family over all n,d is RH. A de Branges toy kernel has positive jets to any prescribed finite order yet is globally negative: no universal finite cutoff. Compare map rows P3, S9.

nodes.name: One-sided Euler harmonic criterion: cutoff exponent above 26/63
nodes.statement: A clipped harmonic average of a one-sided fixed-coefficient prime sum on a finite rectangle suffices, but with m=533/31500 the interpolation needs log Q/log T above 10309/24948 (b=7/8, r=100), limit 26/63. Polylogarithmic cutoffs cannot close it; cancellation cannot remove the clipping penalty.

nodes.name: One-sided excess Q(x)-4 sqrt x with exponent below 3/8
nodes.statement: Bound the one-sided excess Q(x)-4 sqrt(x) directly, preserving sign, with exponent beta<3/8 uniformly in x; the input must distinguish primes from the comparison set S. An absolute PNT envelope loses the saving.

nodes.name: On-line signed-force margin flattens to a positive floor
nodes.statement: rho(32,T) fits c + d/ln T with c=0.143, d=2.50 (R^2=0.991) over heights to gamma_200, with decelerating slope; leave-one-out floors stay in [0.121,0.212]. Extensions to gamma_8000 lower the fitted intercept (0.160 -> 0.111 -> 0.071 -> 0.037): the floor is not established.

nodes.name: Pointwise bound on the large-prime symbol is false
nodes.statement: The step bounding the large-prime part of sigma_X pointwise for |t| <= e^{O(sqrt X)} cannot hold: by the moment method the large-prime polynomial has excursions of order X^{c/2}(log X)^{1/2} at heights e^{X^c}, with or without RH (argued; Gaussian premise checked at X = 1e4 to 3.2%). A proof must keep t coupled to all primes.

nodes.name: Orbit-pair kernel strict inequality uniform in degree
nodes.statement: A_N=sum_{n,m}int_0^inf(qp)'phi_n phi_m; antisymmetric score-gap covariances vanish, so strict orbit MLR cannot pay. Galerkin density kernel kappa_{n,m}=-((sigma_n-sigma_m)^2+sigma_n'+sigma_m')/2, positive on the diagonal, negative off it. Open: strict inequality with all cross-orbit terms, uniformly in degree.

nodes.name: order2 row three conditions
nodes.statement: An order-2 row attack needs jointly: Moebius produced by the row, shift 0, coherent set of relative size 1/2. Waldspurger product-index rows give none; square classes give two at shift 1/2.

nodes.name: Lee-Yang stages and a Krein-space limit
nodes.statement: Rank Gamma_- is lower semicontinuous under bounded weak-* convergence, but in the self-dual conductor normalisation every stage symbol tends to the constant -1 on Re z > 0 for zeta and every unimodular twist, so the chain carries no information. With gamma factor and pole renormalisation the stage has one right-half-plane pole per stage zero (measured), liminf rank infinite. In the strip topology the limit step is Hurwitz plus local boundedness of pole-renormalised Euler stages, which is equivalent to the zero-free statement (von Koch). The Lee-Yang inequality gives a stage bound weaker than t
nodes.lesson: The Lee-Yang stage's index 0 is the inequality Re D_M'/D_M > -(log M)/2, which becomes empty as M grows; the conductor factor that makes stages self-dual erases the limit (symbol -> -1). Any limit step from zero-free product stages is Hurwitz plus local boundedness of pole-renormalised stages, which is RH restated as the PNT error term. r1 holds only at stage level (zero-free stages need the Euler product); the U control fails at the open step, not at a proved one. Primes up to 47 cannot show the convergence mode: the pole factor is within 15 percent of 1 there.

nodes.name: Joint multi-delay (Bohr torus) inner sections of the prime chain
nodes.statement: Within the unipotent chain family a block of prime sections has rank-one additive J-defect, so joint contractivity is the scalar inequality Re U_P <= Re G and twists are torus translations. For finite P no positive-real function of several prime delays can be split off xi'/xi (Theorem B). The sharp section fails at fixed sigma < 1 for large Q (pole term). The Fejer-tapered section is an explicit-formula identity equivalent to RH that uses no multiplicativity. Open: infinite P, general J-inner linear-fractional sections, DH analogue.
nodes.lesson: Sections of the prime chain commute and have rank-one additive defect, so grouping primes adds no freedom: joint contractivity is the largest-value inequality itself. What separates zeta's phases from twists is one-sidedness of the prime sum coming from the zero measure via the functional equation (visible with Fejer weights), not Kronecker structure of finitely many primes; that is a restatement of RH. Multiplicativity entered only in a no-go (point evaluation of H at p^-1/2).

nodes.name: Positive-definiteness of log zeta(sigma+iu) left of Re s = 1
nodes.statement: The compensated positivity CP(sigma) is equivalent to 'no zeros with Re s > sigma'; the direction CP => zero-free uses only the prime-free half-line x < 0. Raw positive-definiteness fails for every sigma < 1. The PD kernel ends at the pole on the diagonal, so there is no transport in sigma (three named mechanisms fail; no general no-transport theorem).
nodes.lesson: Left of the pole, positivity of the compensated transform splits into a support (causality) condition on the prime-free half-line, which is the zero-free statement itself, and a sign condition on the atoms, which is automatic. Sign-positive twists, Beurling and E_a (sigma > 1/2+a, measured) pass, so the property separates zeta from them only through their zeros. Fixed-order minors hold under zero-freeness but do not exclude a single zero (reasoning only).

nodes.name: Sheared Hecke commutator at tau -> 0 with Fricke involution
nodes.statement: [V_n, G_tau] = G_tau(exp(tau l(u+l)/4) - 1)V_n; the eigen-defect order in tau is 1 iff coefficients are completely multiplicative at p, else 0, and no higher order exists. The statement is an identity (multiplicativity at p), not an inequality. w_4 on the X_0(4)(R) arc is u -> -u (evenness only). The sheared prime expansion converges on the critical line only for tau < 0, where the conclusion is false (carry to tau = 0 is heuristic, Rodgers-Tao).
