nodes.name: Theorem OS: one-sided Type-II bound at exponent alpha iff ZF(1/2 + alpha)
nodes.statement: With U = V = X^{1/4}: T(X) - MT_II(X) <= C X^alpha (log X)^m for all large X implies ZF(1/2 + alpha); conversely ZF(1/2 + alpha) gives |T - MT_II| << X^{alpha + eps}. Cauchy-Schwarz is capped at X^{3/8} (psi error X^{7/8}). The contraction claim (K) is false.

nodes.name: Theorem U: sieve-algebra universality
nodes.statement: Every freeze-calculus word in {Pi_p, T_p, scalars, sums, products} followed by exact transforms or isometries equals L(diag(m)c) for a unique m in the 2^25-dimensional sieve algebra over primes <= 97: configurations change what is provable, not what is true.

nodes.name: Certified central positivity of H_tau
nodes.statement: M_k(tau)=int u^k e^{tau u^2}Phi du; d/dtau(M_2/M_0)=Var_tau(u^2)>=0; H_tau(x)>=M_0(1-x^2M_2/(2M_0)). Arb: M_2(1/2)/M_0(1/2)<2/169, so H_tau(x)>0 for real |x|<=13, 0<=tau<=1/2 (only |Im s|<=6.5 at time zero).

nodes.name: Theorem P-POS: positivity of the theta exit density
nodes.statement: p(t)>0 on (0,inf) with explicit two-sided enclosures, via the modular dual identity derived by Poisson summation on x e^{-pi^2 t x^2}e^{i pi x} and strict monotonicity; replaces a Brownian exit-time citation. BigInt-verified.

nodes.name: P-POS: positivity of the theta density with two-sided enclosures
nodes.statement: The theta density p(t) arising as the mixing density of sech is strictly positive on (0, inf), with explicit enclosures from alternating-series bracketing in two regimes glued by a Poisson-summation (Jacobi) identity. Self-contained; verified by exact-rational high precision.

nodes.name: Theta-dual m-series is a twisted stripped sextic Kubota series (target-blind)
nodes.statement: On squarefree m the theta-dual m-series of MS (5.3) is an alpha^(-2)-twisted stripped sextic Kubota series in the modulus m at index 4^5 s mu^3. The identity contains no factor depending on the target function: it is the same for every eta and for DH (lane e2-theta-dual-mseries-fe).

nodes.name: Theta-Fisher parity blocks positive through degree 9
nodes.statement: Both actual 5x5 parity blocks are positive on 0<=a<=1/2, 0<=H_cut<=1/8 (Schur bounds >658509314218 even degree 8, >82637820677424 odd degree 9); at H_cut=0, degree<=9 positivity for every a>0. N=1 modular payment: (s_2-kappa_1 Q_-)/a>44929/57800 for 0<a<=1/4.

nodes.name: Csordas concavity of log kappa(sqrt t)
nodes.statement: t -> log kappa(sqrt t) is strictly concave for t>0 (Csordas Thm 4.2(b), kappa(u)=Phi(u/4)). The property persists for kappa_tau(u)=e^{tau u^2/16}kappa(u) at every real tau, since the heat factor adds an affine term -tau t/16.

nodes.name: Closed polynomial system for the theta kernel on the modular axis
nodes.statement: With t=e^u, H=e^{u/4}theta_3(it), X=theta_2^4, Y=theta_4^4, E=E_2(it): a=H'/H, c=pi t(Y-X), v=pi^2t^2XY satisfy a'=2a^2+(v-1)/8, c'=4ac+2v, v'=v(8a-c), and kappa/H=3a^2+v/8-3/16; a(0)=c(0)=0.

nodes.name: Phase ratio theta is trivial on the positive cone
nodes.statement: On the fixed-amplitude positive-cone family theta = 1 exactly; a variable-modulus family or other modulus normalisation does not change this. Departure theta < 1 is governed only by the sign orthant of the coefficient vector, so the only lever is transcribed per-window sign data.

nodes.name: Anchor-free covariance comparison for canceled Green inverses
nodes.statement: V=-log kappa, f=tV', W=4kappa''/kappa, h=C/kappa. Given f'>0, h'<0, the certified signs W'>0, W''f'-W'f''>0, h''f'-h'f''>0 give both ratio signs for every anchor: the Green inverse is a covariance with (Y-y)_+, Y=tanh(as/2).

nodes.name: Reverse regularity of the theta Hankel kernel stops at order four
nodes.statement: Sra (10 Oct 2026 preprint, Thm 1.1, not replayed): Hankel kernel s(x+y), s(t)=Phi(sqrt t), has strict reverse regularity through order four; the fifth condition fails at t=1e-2. It concerns a different kernel from P_L; no implication to Pick positivity is proved.

nodes.name: Theta-trap contraction constant is N-uniform
nodes.statement: C_Theta <= 24 + 16 Theta <= 28 from one termwise inequality valid for every N and every adjacent pair; realised constant ~4.35, flat in N. The resulting rigorous bound on t_c has the wrong sign for Lambda (Lambda <= -t_c + E(N) needs a lower bound on t_c).

nodes.name: Theta trap: sharp invariant Theta <= 1/4 for Calogero-Moser-type zero flow
nodes.statement: For an ordered CM flow with minimal gap pair and environment energy, the ratio Theta obeys ThetaDot <= rate(Theta) and the band Theta <= 1/4 is flow-invariant (theoremA); collision time t_c <= g^2/6; sharpness by a symmetric triplet. No claim Theta* < 1 for zeta.

nodes.name: Theta-trap theorems A/B/C for the attractive CM flow
nodes.statement: Flow dx_k/ds=-2 sum_{j!=k}1/(x_k-x_j). Trap holds at Theta<=1/4 unconditionally (A) and at Theta<=Theta_b=(sqrt73-5)/8=0.443000 under minimal gap (B, sharp: boundary Q(Theta)=r(2r^2+7r-3), r=2Theta-1/2); isolation g<=0.72 d_1 traps every level<=1 (C). Configurations in (0.443,0.5073) cross upward.

nodes.name: Signed thin Hankel norm certificates
nodes.statement: (H_{a,L}f)(x)=int_0^L h_a(xy)f(y)dy. ||H_{1/4,L}||<=49999/50000 for 1<L<=3/2 and <=1999999/2000000 for 1<L<=8/5. The absolute-kernel norm exceeds one at the first window and diverges; unconditional bound min(L,M sqrt L) is unbounded.

nodes.name: All-window Hankel boundedness = Schur property with cancellation
nodes.statement: For the xi quotient at fixed a, all-window boundedness is equivalent to cancellation-aware holomorphy and the Schur property. At a=1/4 each zero sigma+i gamma, sigma>3/4, needs a same-ordinate zero 3/2-sigma+i gamma of at least its multiplicity. Widths tending to zero give RH.

nodes.name: Three closure attempts: prime Gram kernel audit
nodes.statement: K(s,s')=sum_p F_p(s) conj(F_p(s')) is PSD as a Gram kernel, but no theorem identifies zeta zeros with its poles; generic KYP does not make each local prime contribution positive. Needed: an RH-equivalent completed kernel with archimedean term and exact zero-to-pole divisor map.

nodes.name: Proposition PD: reach of multi-height 3-4-1 positivity (row P25)
nodes.statement: The multi-height positivity class (non-negative cosine polynomials over heights k gamma_0) excludes an off-line zero at depth 3/8 only for log10 gamma_0 < 6.667; mollifier zero detection (T4) misses by a factor 45-829.

nodes.name: TILT-DET: exponential-tilt Cauchy-determinant majorant
nodes.statement: Lambda(P,d) <= e^(-2 s d) prod_{i,j} (p_i + p_j)/(p_i + p_j - 2s): closed form, no separation denominators, valid at exact rate collision, m-uniform and off-lattice. TILT-EIG divides by a floor e^(s/(2 Sp)) on sub-leading eigenvalues (using 1^T G^(-1) 1 = 2 Sp), a depth credit d -> d + (K-1)/(4 Sp).

nodes.name: Kronecker flow on T^inf has spectrum unrelated to zeta zeros
nodes.statement: The generator d/dt of the flow on T^inf=prod_p S^1_{log p} is self-adjoint with eigenvalues 2pi sum n_k/log p_k, dense in R (Kronecker-Weyl); they do not match zeta zeros. Under integer indexing of Fourier modes the regularised spectral zeta is sum m^{-s}=zeta(s).

nodes.name: Pole-free Weil positivity as the Toeplitz form T_a[sigma_2]
nodes.statement: Pole-free Weil positivity on support 2a equals T_a[sigma_2]>=0 on L^2(-a,a), with sigma_2(t)=(t^2+1/4)^2 w_1(t), w_1(t)=2 theta'(t) - sqrt2 ln2 cos(t ln2). T_a[sigma_2] has compact resolvent; a uniform-in-N Galerkin gap is exactly lambda_1(a)>0. Interval-certified for 2a<=0.96.

nodes.name: Spectral / trace-formula family gives no single-zeta bypass
nodes.statement: SL(2,Z) Selberg trace, Hecke triangle groups, Connes-Bost adelic trace, Berry-Keating xp (Sierra-Townsend matches smooth density only), Bender-Brody-Mueller: none realises the zeros as a constructed spectrum. Phillips-Sarnak: cuspidal density would need to exceed Weyl by (log T)^{1/2}.

nodes.name: Three-point correlation of 1e6 zeros matches the sine-kernel determinant
nodes.statement: Empirical R_3(x,y) on 1e6 Odlyzko zeros agrees with the GUE determinantal prediction (Pearson below 0.995 after bin integration); insensitive to the bridge perturbation parameter. Unrestricted-support 3-point input is not available: regularisation penalty is N-independent.

nodes.name: tro6 dual term lambda c correlation
nodes.statement: Non-polar remainder times conj gamma_1(c) correlates with theta estimators at index lambda*c: excess R^2 about 0.25 over permutation null, flat in Q (3750..10607). Origin (theta coefficients vs shared Gauss-sum table) not separated.

nodes.name: tro6 lemma s squarefull twist
nodes.statement: chi_c(u m1 m2^2 ... t^6) = chi_c(u m1) xi_k(c), xi_k of bounded conductor; row sum stays sextic.

nodes.name: Conjecture TRO6-natural(eta): theta-row orthogonality for complete sextic theta coefficients
nodes.statement: Power saving Z^{-eta b/12} over Cauchy-Schwarz for sum_m rho^nat_sigma(-e_0 m) B^J_{m,sigma}(Z), rho^nat the complete sextic Kubota theta coefficient. Open for every eta > 0. With (H_sigma0) it gives Re s > max(7/8 - eta/96, 7/8 - 2.2815e-4).

device.evidence: rows Z15, Z16: floors 5/6 at r = 6; proved abscissa 7/8 (unrefereed manuscripts about 0.874887)

nodes.name: Certified true-dynamic model of the iterate collapse
nodes.statement: A collapse map beyond the single-rate log law, with certified rates and a floor mechanism, is needed for the true-dynamic residues R2/R3 of the reentry band; nearest object is the two-rate law (imp-34862). E_trunc fails as an intrinsic floor (11.1 decades coarser than machine epsilon).

nodes.name: Perturbed Euler product (log p -> log p + eps_p)
nodes.statement: log|prod_{p<=P_N}(1-p^{-s})^{-1}| on s=1/2+it has near-zeros near zeta zeros; shifting each log p by a small eps_p smears them. Comparable to the Beurling control: positivity and size of the prime side kept, integer lattice of logs destroyed.

nodes.name: Prime-truncated kinetic term at sigma=1/2
nodes.statement: T_P(1)=sum_{p<=P}(log p)^2 p^{-1}/(1-p^{-1})^2 grows as (log P)^2/2+offset(P), offset(1e7)=-0.18389, drifting toward about -c0=-0.18755. The finite-prime Hamiltonian is finite at sigma=1/2 only through truncation.

nodes.name: Achieved rung gives RH only up to T*(N)
nodes.statement: T*(N) = effectiveHeightForN(N) at the achieved rung N = 1e6 is about 6e5, far below the verified height 3e12; T* reaches 3e12 only at N ~ 1.236e13. Closed steps 3-4 of the Lambda chain are finite-height statements.

nodes.name: Turan partial sums S_N(s) have off-line zeros (Montgomery 1983)
nodes.statement: S_50(s)=sum_{n<=50} n^{-s} has 33 near-zeros (|S|<0.3) with sigma in [0.5,0.9], t in [10,50]; Montgomery: S_N has zeros with sigma>1-c/log N for some N. Finite Dirichlet truncations cannot prove RH without the functional equation.

nodes.name: Explicit de Branges / Jacobi chain for the twin-ladder m-function
nodes.statement: Under RH m(z) = sum_n 1/(t_n - z) is Nevanlinna N_0 and is realised numerically as a trace-normed canonical system dy/dx = z J H(x) y built from indivisible intervals. Off-line zeros are admissible only in a Pontryagin space Pi_kappa. A Phi-built (not zero-built) H is not known.

nodes.name: Twin ladder (direct + dual ladders, bridge chi)
nodes.statement: Two-sided cascade: a direct prime-resonator ladder encoding zeta(s), a dual ladder encoding zeta(1-s), coupled by chi(s) = pi^{s-1/2} Gamma((1-s)/2)/Gamma(s/2); |chi(1/2+it)| = 1, so the bridge is lossless exactly on the critical line.

nodes.name: Twin-ladder tomography P(sigma,t)=|zeta(sigma+it)||zeta(1-sigma+it)|
nodes.statement: On sigma=1/2 the two factors are conjugate partners and P=|zeta(1/2+it)|^2, with exact zeros at every gamma_n; the line appears as an interference trough. Heatmap over [0.05,0.95]x[0,T].

nodes.name: Twin-pair seam Gram as a 2x2 block Toeplitz operator
nodes.statement: For period L = delta + D and motif {0, delta}, the Hermitian symbol has equal diagonals d(theta) and off-diagonal off(theta); eigenvalue branches lambda_pm = d(theta) +- |off(theta)|, both extremes at theta = 0, giving a two-sided finite-section envelope for all delta, rho, n.

nodes.name: Twin-pair block symbol does not port off-lattice
nodes.statement: The lattice twin-pair Toeplitz block symbol has no off-lattice m-uniform port; the onset gap SPLIT-OPT - SPLIT-RZ = 4.611560 is a floor of the single-scale delta-separated class. Any class-uniform block constant obeys F(delta) <= A_opt(delta).

nodes.name: Twin prime-ladder synchronization model
nodes.statement: On l^2 prime-power rungs with Omega_{p,k}=k log p: for d=(u-v)/sqrt2, dE_d/dt=-2<d,Kd>; K>=kappa I gives E_d(t)<=e^{-4kappa t}E_d(0); K=0 conserves E_d. sum_p sum_k p^{-k}=sum_p 1/(p-1)=inf: the raw critical-line amplitude vector is not finite-energy. No zeta realization of the dissipative generator.

nodes.name: Twist-modulus reciprocity of twisted second moments as a crossing device (RS-1)
nodes.statement: Device under test in lane c11-rs1-twist-modulus-reciprocity (campaign round 11). Lane report of 2026-11-19, author check only: stage A stops; T-NR, E_a with real a and the window translate pass every step; the Moebius variable becomes the modulus under the reciprocity and the wall of the spectral-window lead returns (Moebius weights on the moduli, characters of conductor at least the length). Not yet refereed; node status unchanged until the learn step. Read set RS-1 of STRATEGY v3 section 4.0: the functional equation of the target used in the same inequality as periodicity of twists in the conductor aspect. The device is the reciprocity of twisted second moments that exchanges the twist variable with the modulus (Conrey, Young, Bettin; the cotangent-sum period relation of Bettin-Conrey). Origin: map row P52 closes the spectral-window lead for reciprocities acting on (n, c) and names a reciprocity acting on the Moebius variable l as the only reopening input. Stage A of the lane: one displayed inequality, the step using multiplicativity and the step using the functional equation marked, and a table of eleven controls (DEL, THIN, U, DH, E_a, T-NR, EIS-w, window translate, interpolation twin, backward heat, sign twist) naming the first failing step for each. No statement about zeros of zeta.

nodes.name: wol-pd L2: log-positivity of b_n under completely multiplicative twisting
nodes.statement: For completely multiplicative chi, f -> chi f is a ring automorphism of arithmetic functions commuting with the log-derivation D; the coefficients b_n defined by b * G = D G are nonnegative and monotone in t, with b at t = 0 equal to von Mangoldt. Lean-checked.

nodes.name: Route M off-diagonal twisted second moment M2w=Rw*Mbar
nodes.statement: Exact factorisation with Mbar=sum_a E_h[c_0(h/a)^2]/a^2-type Bettin-Conrey-bounded surrogate and one open oversampling scalar Rw~1.2; target M2w<0.32546; OVR plateaus on the inverse-line ladder to b=64001. Resonance main-term evaluation refuted.

nodes.name: Twistor space, dual and intertwiner (auxiliary layer)
nodes.statement: Projective twistor space PT (Robinson congruence), its dual PT* and the incidence correspondence, with zeta mapped onto the fibration; an auxiliary O-status layer of the paper. Campaign row G19: the flow cocycle is a coboundary; functional equation is a separate input.

nodes.name: Twistor heat compatibility on range F_+
nodes.statement: From R A_+ = A_- R, I_K F_+ = F_- R and hat-A_pm F_pm = F_pm A_pm it follows that I_K hat-A_+ = hat-A_- I_K on range F_+ (Lemma 6.1 of the twistor framework paper), over any commutative ring.

nodes.name: Twistor heat-compatibility lemma 6.1
nodes.statement: If R A = A R, I_K F_+ = F_- R and Ahat_pm F_pm = F_pm A, then I_K Ahat_+ = Ahat_- I_K on ran(F_+). Five-step diagram chase using each hypothesis once. Conditional lemma; obstruction map row G19 records the twistor cocycle as a coboundary.

nodes.name: Two-line zero detector D(w) (Poisson-Jensen)
nodes.statement: For F = zeta(s)(s-1)/s: D(w) = log|F(w)| - P_w[log|F(1/2 + i.)|] = sum_{beta > 1/2} log|B_rho(w)| <= 0 on Re w > 1/2. Evaluated on Re w = sigma1 >= 1 it determines all zeros with beta > 1/2; found 8 DH off-line zeros below 400 (sigma1 > 1.39514 for DH).

nodes.name: Two-feature and far-translated positivity of H_c
nodes.statement: H_c(u,v)^2<H_c(u,u)H_c(v,v) for u!=v, from convexity of -log kappa(sqrt t). Every fixed finite configuration translated far into either end is positive, with limiting Gram kernel sech((u-v)/2); separated sech Gram matrices have an explicit lower bound.

nodes.name: Two positive tents remove each other's blind multiplier zeros
nodes.statement: c=124/123, m=61,62: multiplier polynomials have exact gcd (z-1)(z-c). Their eventual prime signs together are RH-equivalent although one generic positive tent may hide an off-critical mode. Concave positive annular kernels are weighted averages of single-tent ratios.

nodes.name: Closed device type (round 18, one referee per lane): one-sided completion bound in the band 1/2 < theta <= 1
nodes.statement: Proposed, untested device type. Question: is there a one-sided bound N(theta) for the band operator T_Z (the Weil form on tests supported on an interval of length u = theta log(t/2 pi)), 1/2 < theta <= 1, with a completion term taken from the reflected half of the approximate functional equation or from the pole term, that zeta satisfies and every control fails at a named step. Background (window information law, one referee): band devices are forms of one operator; between P = sqrt(t/2 pi) and P = t/2 pi the missing input is this bound; the truncated Euler product identity holds for every completely multiplicative chain and is not that input; sign chains fail the bound at theta >= 1 only in measurements. Carriers named by the planner: bridge and antibridge Hankel blocks, pole-term Schur complement. No inequality is on file. Not a statement about zeros. Outcome, round 18 (map row P58; one referee per lane): closed. N(theta) below the Nyquist band is, by an exact truncation identity valid for every Dirichlet series with a_1 = 1, a statement about the zeros of the partial sum D_P; no step uses multiplicativity; the reflected half is not seen by the band; ZQ passes for theta' < 1 in the lattice model; at theta' = 1 the statement is the target in a window. Measured on 96 modes at heights 1e6 to 1e12: the linear reflected completion is not a positive extension (zeta fails it in 600 of 600 cells); ZQ, E_0.1, DH and multiplicative sign chains pass N(theta) in parts of the band, with a dependence on the number of modes.

nodes.name: Fixed-degree arithmetic filter fails by discrete universality
nodes.statement: For d=1/4, any offset c_*, degree m, eps>0: a positive lower density of k has R_m(1/4,c_*+k/8)<eps while zeta is zero-free on the translated disk |w|<=1/4 (Reich discrete universality with a target equal to one at nodes and e^{-A} at the centre).

nodes.name: V7 floor: operator floor exponent p gives half-plane (1+p)/2
nodes.statement: If the lowest eigenvalue of the compressed Weil operator satisfies eps_0(lambda) >= -C (1 + log lambda)^m lambda^p for all large lambda (0 <= p < 1), then zeta(s) != 0 for Re s > (1+p)/2; p = 0 is RH. Proof via the box vector and Landau. Converse direction: floor exponent equals 2 Theta - 1.

nodes.name: Vanishing-moment sub-family keeps D_S<=L_S past the pole-free crossing
nodes.statement: Past the crossing 2a*=1.1316 (= ln3+0.033) the inequality D_S<=L_S fails on general pole-free h, but a sub-family with k>=2 vanishing moments keeps mu_max below 1 (margin 0.392 at 2a=1.16, 0.291 at 2a=1.20). The sub-family certifies nothing about the full cone.

nodes.name: Var S(T) additive constant b=M+P2+K
nodes.statement: Mertens constant M and prime-power double sum P2 are known to 1e-12; the boundary/cutoff constant K (about 1.06 empirically) is unresolved at about 100x the 0.01 tolerance needed to collapse the crossing-height range.

nodes.name: Additive constant of Var S(T) and the integral I_F
nodes.statement: b = I_F + M + P2 with Mertens M = 0.2614972128, P2 = sum_{k>=2} sum_p 1/(k^2 p^k) = 0.1394706 and I_F = int_1^inf F(alpha)/alpha^2 d alpha. Under RH only I_F in (2/3 - eps, 2) is known; Montgomery's conjecture gives 1 (a_0 = -0.176248).

nodes.name: Sum over reduced residues of V(a,b) vanishes
nodes.statement: V(b-a,b) = -V(a,b), hence Sum_{a in R_b} V(a,b) = 0 for every b>=2 and Sum_{a=2,(a,b)=1}^{b-1} V(a,b) = -V(1,b), where V(1,b)=Sum_{m=1}^{b-1}(m/b)cot(pi m/b) = -(b/pi) log b + (2C/pi) b - 1/pi + lower order, which is o(phi(b) b).

nodes.name: Vasyunin Gram matrix of the Nyman-Beurling problem
nodes.statement: G_{hk} = gcd(h,k) I(h/g, k/g)/(hk), g=gcd(h,k), with I(a,b) the Vasyunin integral given by cotangent sums V(a,b)=Sum_m (m/b) cot(pi m a/b) plus logarithmic terms. Exact SPD Gram of the dilates rho(1/(hx)); d_N^2 is its Schur complement against chi.

nodes.name: Nyman-Beurling Gram via Vasyunin sums: Burnol floor
nodes.statement: d_N^2 = 1 - b^T G^{-1} b with exact Vasyunin Gram: d_N^2 log N / sum |rho|^{-2} = 0.998 at N = 500; lambda_min enclosures on 12 rungs N = 250..10000 by verified Cholesky. Every Euclid-depth truncation leaves G indefinite. Obstruction map P14/P15.

nodes.name: lam_max(G_N) <= I(1,1) H_N
nodes.statement: By SPD trace domination lam_max(G_N) <= I(1,1) H_N = 1.2607 log N + O(1), with I(1,1) = log(2 pi) - gamma = 1.2606614. Measured growth is logarithmic with slope 0.3526, entirely an off-diagonal-mass effect. The campaign later proved lam_max(G_N)<=18 (obstruction map P15).

nodes.name: lam_min of the Vasyunin Gram decays like N^{-1.918}
nodes.statement: lam_min(G_N) follows a power law with p=1.918 (R^2=0.99998; blind N=1e4 prediction within 0.12%). Verified Cholesky certifies lam_min per rung to N about 1.08e5 in double precision; double-double extends this.

nodes.name: Two-sided bound for the smallest eigenvalue of the Nyman-Beurling Gram matrix
nodes.statement: 1/(64*2^Omega_N*N^2) <= lam_min(G_N) <= (3+log N)/(N-1)^2; exponent exactly 2 up to N^o(1); p = 2 open. Same law for DH and periodic non-multiplicative sequences; carries no zero information.

nodes.name: N-uniform lower bound lam_min(G_N) >= A N^{-p}
nodes.statement: Settled as a matrix statement (proved, unrefereed): 1/(64*2^Omega_N*N^2) <= lam_min(G_N) <= (3+log N)/(N-1)^2, Omega_N = max_{n<=N} omega(n), so lam_min(G_N) = N^(-2+o(1)); the lemma lam_min(G_N) >= A N^-p holds for every p > 2, p = 2 open. The same N^-2 law is measured for Davenport-Heilbronn, four Dirichlet characters and two periodic sequences without Euler product, so the bound is a mean-value quantity fixed by the 1/|s|^2 weight; it bounds the size of the optimal coefficients, not the distance d_N, and carries no information on zeros. Earlier text (imp-96613): no analytic N-uniform lower bound was available.

nodes.name: Two-scale spectrum of the Vasyunin Gram
nodes.statement: Rank-r power-iteration log-slopes of lam_max follow a logistic in r (half-saturation r0=2.94, width k=0.863, R^2=0.996). The logistic is the exact form of the top-eigenpair weight share w1 lam1^r/Sum w_i lam_i^r in a top-plus-bulk-edge spectrum, width 1/ln(lam1/lam2). The top-eigenvector overlap w1 drifts down over N=1000..6000.

nodes.name: Vaughan X^(1/4) forcing is a normalisation removable by two linear mollifier conditions
nodes.statement: The X^{1/4} Vaughan forcing equals -(4+2gamma) sqrt X M'(1) - zeta'(1/2) M'(1/2) and is removed by two linear conditions on the mollifier; residual |Xi'| <= (U + 32 sqrt U + 25)(6 + log X)/sqrt X.

nodes.name: Vaughan forcing law: Xi(X) is of size X^{1/4}
nodes.statement: Xi(U^4) evaluated for all U <= 1e8 (X to 1e32): max |Xi| = 3.07e7; decade maxima of |Xi|/X^{1/4} are 0.34-0.41; log-mean of Xi/X^{1/4} is 0.058-0.062 per decade. Conditional on RH, simple zeros and J_{-1}(T) << T: log-mean = 4 sum_{gamma>0} Re(1/zeta'(rho))/|rho - 1|^2 = 0.0596.

nodes.name: Square-root Type-I lemma and renewal identity
nodes.statement: In Vaughan's identity with U = V = floor(X^{1/4}) the Type-I pieces are exact up to |E_1| + |E_2| <= X^{-1/4}(2 + log X) + 1.04 (measured <= 0.022 for 1e6 <= X <= 1e10). R(X) = S(X) - 2 sqrt X satisfies R = Xi + K_X[R] + O(1).

nodes.name: Design for extending verified zero height toward 1e14
nodes.statement: Engineering study (no zeros computed) of GPU-accelerated verification beyond Platt-Trudgian 3e12; feasible with amortised Odlyzko-Schonhage, two engineering risks named. No peer-reviewed successor to 3e12 found at audit time. Finite certificates restate verified height.

nodes.name: Zero data needed to extend the unconditional floor to the landmarks
nodes.statement: Extending the unconditional leading-order floor from the 1e6-zero assembly (T0 ~ 6.0e5) to the halving landmark N ~ 3.27e9 (T0 ~ 1.14e9) needs about 3.51 further decades of zero index; both landmarks lie below the verified height.

nodes.name: In-repo verified ordinate ceiling
nodes.statement: The highest verified ordinate available in the repository is gamma_1e6 = 6.003e5 (10^6 Odlyzko ordinates). A direct windowed variance measurement at the E_coll = E_trunc crossover height would need about 3.3e9 to 4.3e9 verified ordinates; no in-repo source narrows the gap.

nodes.name: Virtual rungs: positive-extension freedom outside |u| < 2a
nodes.statement: Adding cosines with frequencies |u_j| >= 2a (u = ln r, r rational, r >= K+1 or r <= 1/(K+1)) leaves W unchanged on support 2a; with the floor lemma w_K + f >= 2 theta'(T) - F for F >= sup_torus(P - f). Best floor is lambda_max of the rung operator (Krein extension).

nodes.name: Interferometer visibility is vacuous, false or a gauge
nodes.statement: V0 = 2|chi|/(1+|chi|^2) = sech(log|chi|) depends on the gamma factor alone. On the theta split Lambda = A(s) + A(1-s), sup V < 1 would suffice, but Arb certifies V = 1 fringes on every tested line to t = 200 for zeta and DH. Obstruction map G1/G8.

nodes.name: Vinogradov-Korobov region overtakes the classical one only at log t~10242
nodes.statement: With Ford-type VK constants the VK zero-free width exceeds the classical (MTY R=5.558691) width from log t=10242.24; the working window top is log t=37.48. The classical region is the operative unconditional one at every reachable height.

nodes.name: Two-way collapse of the section 15-27 programme
nodes.statement: Claimed chain: ||V_{a,Phi}|| <= 1 for all a>0 <=> block [[I,V],[V*,I]] >= 0 <=> K_a >= 0 <=> E_a(z)=X(a-iz) Hermite-Biehler <=> Phi-built canonical system (CDB-Exist) <=> RH. Later downgraded to conditional; the norm statement is false for large a (obstruction map P20).

nodes.name: Volterra norm is blind to zero location (heat-flow and Beurling controls)
nodes.statement: Under H_t deformation ||V_{a,Phi_t}|| tracks the exp(t u^2) L^2 scale only; after normalising ||Phi_t||_2 = 1 no residual zero-location signal. A generic Beurling system has no self-dual Phi so V cannot be assembled. The statistic stays below 1 on both sides of Lambda.

nodes.name: det(I - V) carries no zero information
nodes.statement: V_{a,Phi} is trace class with tr V = 0 and is quasinilpotent, so det(I - V) = 1 identically; ||V||_1 ~ 2.57e-4 at a=0.5. A Fredholm-determinant -> Hadamard-product route to the zeros is empty.

nodes.name: Volterra-Hankel operator V_{a,Phi}
nodes.statement: (V f)(t) = int_0^t Phi(t) Phi(s) sinh(a(t-s)) f(s) ds on L^2([0,inf)), Phi the de Bruijn-Newman kernel of xi. Causal (lower-triangular), trace class, quasinilpotent, built from Phi only, no reference to zeros.

nodes.name: Volterra norm is degree-2 homogeneous in Phi
nodes.statement: V_{a,cPhi} = c^2 V_{a,Phi}, so ||V_{a,cPhi}|| = c^2 ||V_{a,Phi}|| and K_a is degree-2 homogeneous. No scalar normalisation N(c) can equate the scale-invariant cone {K_a >= 0} with the sublevel set {||V|| <= 1}; the 5000x margin is a scale artifact.

nodes.name: Hilbert-Schmidt closed-form bound sqrt(I_0 J_a)
nodes.statement: ||V_{a,Phi}||_op <= ||V||_HS <= sqrt(I_0 J_a), monotone in a (d/da sinh^2(au) >= 0), rigorously < 1 on a in (0, 34.98]; at a <= 0.5 the bound is 2.94e-4. Interval-certified (Krawczyk) on a 30-cell (U,a) grid, max 1.900e-4.

nodes.name: V_{a,Phi} is not a multiplicative convolution
nodes.statement: Kernel Phi(t)Phi(s) sinh(a(t-s)) 1_{s<t} is not a function of t/s (two separate Phi factors), so Mellin transform does not diagonalise V; no symbol calculus on (0,inf) applies.

nodes.name: Volterra bound ||V_{a,Phi}||<=1 (collapse of paper sections 15-27)
nodes.statement: Block positivity [[I,V],[V#,I]]>=0 iff ||V||<=1 (Schur complement); seven paper conjectures reduce to it. HS bound sqrt(I_0 J_a) holds for zeta, Dirichlet L mod 3,5,7,11 (margins 1.72-2.59) and five imaginary quadratic Dedekind zetas (1.52-1.55). No Euler-product input; DH kernel also passes.

nodes.name: Volterra norm bound uses no Euler product (obstruction map P20)
nodes.statement: ||V_{a,Phi}|| <= 1 holds exactly for a <= a* in (31.6213, 31.6214) and fails above; b_a >= 0 is classical for a >= 1 and RH-equivalent over all a > 0; the positive even Davenport-Heilbronn kernel satisfies the bound.

nodes.name: Conjecture 27.2 fails above a* (map row P20)
nodes.statement: Galerkin ||V_{a,Phi}|| = 0.954 at a=37.5, 1.989 at a=40, 53.2 at a=50, 2.8e11 at a=100; crossing a* ~ 37.66 coincides with the Hilbert-Schmidt threshold. The Wiener-Hopf bound ||V|| <= ||Phi||_inf^2/a was retracted: causal sinh-convolution is not Toeplitz.

nodes.name: Volterra norm bound: true only up to a*
nodes.statement: Campaign result (map row P20): ||V_{a,Phi}||<=1 holds exactly for a<=a* in (31.6213,31.6214) and is false above. Earlier in-repo record: HS bound sqrt(I_0 J_a) exceeds 1 near a=2.3 (J_a ~ e^{4a}); HS within 2.02% of op norm; kernel Phi(x)Phi(y)sinh(a(x-y)) is near rank one.

nodes.name: Volterra norm bound is not a reduction
nodes.statement: At the Riemann Phi, I - VV* crosses zero under scaling while K_a stays PSD: no scalar normalization equates the scale-bounded sublevel set with the scale-invariant cone. Rigorous ||V|| <= sqrt(I0 J_a) about 2.94e-4 bounds an RH-equivalent object. Obstruction map P20.

nodes.name: Volterra/HS framework extends to Selberg-class L-functions
nodes.statement: Phi_L decays super-exponentially for every degree n; HS bound sqrt(I_0^L J_a^L) holds numerically for Delta, weight-16 form, a Maass form (R = 9.5337), Dirichlet chi_q (q = 3,5,7,11), five imaginary quadratic Dedekind zetas; Cauchy-Schwarz slack 1.7-2.6. Rankin-Selberg margin exceeds 2 at large weight gap.

nodes.name: Truncation transfer L^2([0,U]) -> L^2([0,inf))
nodes.statement: Tail bound T_a(U) <= I_0 (pi^3/8) e^{(4+2a)U} exp(-2 pi e^{4U}): at U=4 below 10^{-24,247,990}. The finite-window norm of V_{a,Phi} equals the half-line norm to that accuracy for a <= 0.5.

nodes.name: Von Mangoldt weighted per-window sign image
nodes.statement: theta_phys(p,k) = sum_{m,l} G_ml <cos>_w(h_m - h_l) / S with <cos>_w(D) = sum_n w(n) cos(2 pi D n/p) / sum_n w(n), w(n) = Lambda(n) K_k(n). A convex average since G_ml > 0. Strictly below 1 conditional on a sign hypothesis for the Fresnel-Airy kernel K_k.

nodes.name: Voronin universality
nodes.statement: For nonvanishing analytic f on compact K in 1/2<Re s<1 and eps>0 there are arbitrarily large tau with sup_K|zeta(s+i tau)-f(s)|<eps. Used as a control: any argument using only local value distribution inside the strip must fail: zeta approximates functions with arbitrary non-zero behaviour there.

nodes.name: Vortex-trapping blocker reduces to RH / Newman bounds
nodes.statement: For G=H_t+i d_x H_t: RH iff G has no zero on (0,1/2]xR iff every Jordan box with G!=0 on its boundary has winding 0. For 0<t1<=1/2: G!=0 on [t1,1/2]xR iff Lambda<t1 (Csordas-Smith-Varga).

nodes.name: Summation precision does not bind the A + B - C sum at 3e12
nodes.statement: For the 488602-term oscillatory sum (N = floor(sqrt(T_PT/4 pi))) compensated summation stays near 1.9e-20 normalised error under worst orderings and pairing trees; the deterministic a-priori bound sits about 3.3 orders above achieved error. Remaining work is the interval implementation.

nodes.name: Certified winding count on the transition rectangle
nodes.statement: Argument-principle count on the boundary of [T_PT, T_PT + Delta] x [-h, h] needs: interval extension of H_t (I1), per-panel cap |Delta arg| < pi (I2), modulus floor (I3), integer closure (I4), corner composition (I5). All five are not built; the repo holds only point-sampled phase unwrapping.

nodes.name: W3 tail lemma |A_t + B_t| > |C_t| for all x >= T_PT + Delta
nodes.statement: Polymath15 mollified triangle-inequality lower bound on |A_t + B_t| against the error cap E_A + E_B + E_C0, uniformly above the barrier. Margin is monotone in t, hardest at t = 0; re-anchoring 6e10 -> 3e12 raises the term count floor(sqrt(x/4 pi)) from 6.9e4 to 4.89e5. No finite mesh covers it.
nodes.underusedWhy: the one non-finite item in porting the Polymath15 barrier; height-uniform by form

nodes.name: Exponential-sum wall (Vinogradov-Korobov 2/3)
nodes.statement: Classical zero-free regions rest on exponential-sum bounds for zeta near Re s = 1; the exponent 2/3 is unchanged since 1958 and such regions stay below every fixed line sigma = 1 - delta.

nodes.name: Mollifier length wall theta = 4/7
nodes.statement: The Levinson-Conrey proportion depends on mollifier length theta; 4/7 is the Kloosterman-sum limit; Farmer: arbitrarily long mollifiers would give 100%.

nodes.name: Pair-correlation support barrier
nodes.statement: The form factor is known only on Fourier support |alpha| <= 1 (unconditionally: Aryan; BGST); extending past 1 is equivalent to twin-prime-type correlation input. Caps simplicity / proportion bounds from pair correlation below 100%.

nodes.name: Parity (sieve) barrier
nodes.statement: Sieve weights cannot distinguish integers with an even or odd number of prime factors, blocking sieve routes to square-root cancellation in M(x).

nodes.name: Lemma B.2/B.3: walled local RH window under the heat flow
nodes.statement: B.3: if H_t has no zero on the boundary of a walled cell [a,b] x strip for t in [t_0,t_1], real zeros in the cell stay real. B.2: local strip contraction (Im z)^2 decreasing at rate 2 inside a walled or half-infinite cell. Gives a two-band comparison.

nodes.name: Route J: Weil-Deligne template over Z
nodes.statement: Engine (ii) is de la Vallee Poussin (Fejer floor R >= 5.8284, still c/log t); the k = 2 form is pair correlation; engines (i), (iii) need the self-product Spec Z x_{F1} Spec Z. Obstruction map T2/T3, P25.

nodes.name: Numerical Weil explicit-formula test harness
nodes.statement: Independent cross-check of the repo's Weil explicit-formula evaluator; shipped as partial. A separate information-theory module was falsified by spot checks at 3 primes, t = 0.

nodes.name: Weil Gram margin on bump bases sinks to the conditioning floor
nodes.statement: Diagonal-normalised lambda_min of the Riemann-Weil Gram form: no negative eigenvalue for even dimension K=6..16, support 2.1..4.9, odd K=6..12; odd-block margin falls 7e-10 to 2e-12 with K, at the basis conditioning floor.

nodes.name: Finite Weil-Li Gram matrix M_N is nearly rank one and blind to off-line zeros
nodes.statement: M_N built from v_gamma=(2 sin(k theta/2))_k, theta=atan2(gamma,gamma^2-1/4)~1/gamma: PSD for N<=100, max eigenvalue ~N^2.72, effective rank 1..4. Injecting 200 off-line zeros at beta=0.9 leaves M_30 PSD. Content of RH lives only as N->infinity.

nodes.name: Lower bounds on |zeta|^2 loosen the Weil prime side
nodes.statement: In the section 18.3 Weil/Pontryagin explicit-formula attack, a lower bound on |zeta|^2 gives a lower bound in absolute value on the prime side, which is the wrong direction for tightening.

nodes.name: Weil-negativity onset follows the first off-line zero
nodes.statement: Fitted over 240 twins: a* = -0.748 + 0.387 log gamma - 0.278 log(beta - 1/2) + 0.278 log q (rms 0.139, R^2 0.883; predicts DH 1.746). Onset is set mainly by root-number phase; conductor slope 0.2-0.37 per log q against slope 1 for Epstein principal forms. Euler arms never negative.

nodes.name: Certified Weil positivity: four outcomes
nodes.statement: Every certified Weil-positivity result of routes 11-15, 19, 26, 44 is inside the verified height, blind above a finite horizon, Euler-blind (passes a same-gamma-factor twin with off-line zeros), or equivalent to (G)RH at full support.

nodes.name: Even/odd sector split of the Weil form
nodes.statement: For real g = g_e + g_o the cross-correlations cancel in G(x) = int g(y) g(y+x) dy, so W(g) = W(g_e) + W(g_o) for every linear functional of G. A real zero beta in (1/2,1) contributes -(int g sinh((beta-1/2)x))^2 in the odd sector and +(int g cosh)^2 in the even.

nodes.name: Weil positivity at small support in Lean (Yoshida range)
nodes.statement: The prime side vanishes for test functions supported in |x| <= b < log 2 (sharp at log 2); for even Schwartz f supported in |x| <= 13/150 with the archimedean symbol >= 26/25 outside |xi| <= 57/20 and deficit integral <= 6, the zero side of f * f-tilde is >= 0.

nodes.name: Weil positivity at fixed support: lower-bound ladder for kappa
nodes.statement: kappa(W_T >= 0 and critical strip) >= kappa_low(T): 0.4142 (T = 0.5), 0.3090 (1), 0.0926 (1.941, the RES-T support at 3e12), 0.0140 (5), 0.00349 (10), with T^2 kappa_low(T) -> 0.349. Upper bound and continuity in T are open; all T gives kappa = 0 (Weil).

nodes.name: Weld [B_v, Pi_p]: alias decomposition and l2 collapse
nodes.statement: Using 1_{p not| n} = 1 - 1/p - (1/p) sum_{h=1}^{p-1} e(hn/p), the noncommuting weld [B_v, Pi_p] splits into alias packets; the five-shell correlated alias coupling collapses to single-shell packet masses times one overlap constant K, controlled quadratically by sum_{h!=0} w(h)^2 lambda(h)^(-2/3).

nodes.name: Whitham composition constant equals the G6a modulus
nodes.statement: The constant C_W in |t_c(m_N) - t_c(m_inf)| <= C_W sqrt(D(N)) is the same Holder-1/2 modulus required by the open shock-Lipschitz sub-gap; only a symbolic placeholder C_W = 1.0 exists.

nodes.name: Even-sector supported Weil coercivity to sqrt(33/2)
nodes.statement: q_lambda[f]>=c_*|f|^2 for every even f supported in [-log lambda,log lambda] with finite log Fourier moment, 1<lambda<=sqrt(33/2) (earlier sqrt(16.001), sqrt(16.1)); infinite tail included; c_* existential. No odd-sector, cofinal or RH statement.

nodes.name: sigma = 1/2 as Widom line is FE-forced
nodes.statement: sigma = 1/2 maximises Var_t log|zeta| and (log xi)'', but both are Parseval/FE-forced and RH-blind; the concentration statement is Bohr-Landau via Littlewood's lemma, with rate function the zero-density exponent.

nodes.name: Fixed-thickness frontier is one Wiener-Hopf phase condition
nodes.statement: Fixed a: A_a>=0 iff X(w-a)/X(w+a) is Schur on Re w>0 iff m(lambda)<=m(lambda-2a) for every zero with Re lambda>a. A_{a_n}>=0 for infinitely many a_n->0+ iff RH. a>=1/2 holds unconditionally; B(w)=xi(w)/xi(w+1) is inner. R_{2a}(w)=R_a(w-a)R_a(w+a).

nodes.name: Certified argument-principle winding barrier on R=[T_PT,T_PT+Delta]x[-h,h]
nodes.statement: Reading the off-line contribution above T_PT=3e12 as exactly zero needs a finite winding count of H_t on a rectangle, a lower bound on inf|H_t'| on long edges and directed-rounding sums; mesh cost and working digits tabulated. Equivalent to more verified height.

nodes.name: Finite winding barrier cost is linear
nodes.statement: Cost = k * rho * Delta interval evaluations of A + B - C, rho = (1/2 pi) log(T_PT/2 pi) ~ 4.28 zeros per unit height at 3e12; roundoff alone reaches the pi budget only at about 4.5e15 panels.

nodes.name: Quantised winding re-derives only Lambda >= 0
nodes.statement: The quantised winding of the supercritical-fluid picture is one topological invariant under both read-outs; in the faithful regime its conservation is equivalent to the classical de Bruijn monotonicity and gives Lambda >= 0, with no upper-bound content.

nodes.name: Winding of arg H_tau is non-increasing in tau
nodes.statement: winding = (sign changes of H_tau on the line)/2 is monotone non-increasing along the de Bruijn-Newman flow; flat at 6.5 on tau in [0,0.2] for the tested window (zeros stay real). Monotonicity is classical (de Bruijn); later work identified the proxy as the exact flow at negative time.

nodes.name: Winding monotonicity under the de Bruijn flow (classical orientation)
nodes.statement: H_t(x)=int e^{tu^2}Phi(u)cos(xu)du satisfies dH/dt=-d^2H/dx^2; the Gaussian convolution proxy is the exact flow at negative time. Winding count is monotone by de Bruijn Thm 13 plus a jet lemma. Ceiling: the Polymath15 0.2 architecture.

nodes.name: Winding of arg H_tau is monotone in heat time (de Bruijn Thm 13 with jet lemma)
nodes.statement: The count of real zeros of H_tau in a window is non-decreasing forward in tau; the Gaussian-convolution proxy used earlier equals the exact de Bruijn flow at negative time t=-4 tau. Classical; thread ceiling does not beat Lambda<=0.2.

nodes.name: Winding/topological route re-derives the 0.2 architecture only
nodes.statement: Lower side: Lambda>0 iff RH false, and a window collision at t=-c certifies only Lambda>-c. Upper side: monotone winding plus landing rate is the existing Lambda<=t0+Delta^2/2 method; no improvement without more verified height or barrier input. Obstruction map rows G7, F3.

nodes.name: Widening the window adds boundary in-flux under backward flow
nodes.statement: Extending the window beyond x=104 lets a zero enter from x>112 as early as t about -3.6, before most merges, which stops order-continuation of the collision sequence; the base window [20,104] has no boundary event in the tested t-range.

nodes.name: Proposition R: open zero-side-sound window certificates certify RH and simplicity together
nodes.statement: Any open, zero-side-sound window certificate certifies RH and the simple-zeros conjecture, never RH alone. Over F_q the inertia statement fails when Frobenius eigenvalues repeat (Proposition S): Hodge index gives positivity, not inertia.

nodes.name: Depth control next to every window
nodes.statement: Exact window certification needs |beta - 1/2| <= delta_allowed(T) = O(log log T/log T) for zeros adjacent to the window: 0.26 at T = 3e12, 0.042 at T = 1e100 (B = 2). Half-plane inputs give 3/8; adversarial edge term exceeds lambda_N by factors 44-306 at T = 2e4 to 5e5.

nodes.name: Window-replacement model xi_W
nodes.statement: xi_W = kappa xi Q_{W'}/Q_W replaces the zeros in one window by a configuration with an off-line pair, keeping order 1, functional equation, reality and xi_W(1) = xi(1). The unshifted model fails O-form function-side premises (mean square moves by |kappa^2 - 1| T log T); the kappa = 1 shifted variant satisfies them.

nodes.name: Window replacement counter-model zeta_W
nodes.statement: For a finite zero multiset W of xi closed under rho -> 1 - conj(rho) and W' of equal size, xi_W = kappa xi Q_{W'}/Q_W is entire of order 1 with the functional equation, reality, xi_W(1) = 1/2; zeta_W has the pole, residue and trivial zeros of zeta and zeros (Z(xi) minus W) union W'. No Euler product.

nodes.name: Window winding number is monotone along the flow
nodes.statement: W(t)=(1/2)#{sign changes of H_t on [a,b]} is non-decreasing in t absent boundary flux, jumping +1 per conjugate-pair landing. Classical consequence of the jet lemma and Theorem 13; time-reversed it is the 'winding Lyapunov' of imp-2696.

nodes.name: Window-1 certification cannot move to envelope-scale subdivision
nodes.statement: Every modulus-triangle envelope separating the broadband pieces has sup > R_ex at sampled points (73/24576 per chart); the pilot passes only through the joint phase-resolved sum. Full-window phase-resolving cost about 378 CPU-days.

nodes.name: X=16.5 inverse-comparison deficit
nodes.statement: At support X=16.5 the sufficient inverse comparison fails by 0.04361 (previous 7th-to-8th power gain at 16.1 was 0.014520). Break-even needs a certified reduction above 5.117333% of the near band 2049..4096 directional charge 7.69897369184e-76.

nodes.name: Arm split of the completed zeta function at the self-dual point
nodes.statement: Lambda(s) = A(s) + A(1-s), A(s) = -1/s + sum_n (pi n^2)^{-s/2} Gamma(s/2, pi n^2). A(s) = -theta3(e^{-pi})/s + 4 psi'(1)/(s(s+2)) + O(t^{-3}), theta3(e^{-pi}) = pi^{1/4}/Gamma(3/4): each arm is ~1/t while Lambda ~ e^{-pi t/4}.

nodes.name: Centered xi function X(w)
nodes.statement: xi(s)=(1/2)s(s-1)pi^{-s/2}Gamma(s/2)zeta(s), X(w)=xi(1/2+w)=F(w); even entire, order one maximal type; F(z)=int kappa(u)e^{zu/2}du with kappa(u)=(d_u^2-1/16)[e^{u/4}theta(e^u)], theta(t)=sum_n e^{-pi n^2 t}.

nodes.name: Xi exponential family and KL identities
nodes.statement: d mu_a=e^{ax-K(a)}d mu_0, K(a)=log X(a)/X(0), K''(a)=Var_{mu_a}(x)>0; KL(mu_a|mu_0)=aK'(a)-K(a), d/da KL=aK''(a). Central member minimizes KL. Real-axis statement only; no control of complex cancellation (Nakamura family).

nodes.name: Regularised xp models reproduce only the smooth N(T)
nodes.statement: First 1e5 zeros: Berry-Keating fit constant 0.875007 +- 5.3e-5 (= 7/8); Gamma-phase spectrum theta(E_n) = pi(n - 3/2) is displaced from the zeros by exactly -S (corr 0.9999999994). Fluctuations return only with the prime-orbit sum.

nodes.name: y-thaw package value 0.17759432 obligations O1-O6
nodes.statement: Candidate 0.17759432 = 129/800 + 0.1808^2/2 at thawed floor y = 0.1808. Closed: O3 (E_max budget), O5 (site coverage). Open: O1 sharp-mass y-monotonicity, O2 barrier/winding slab, O4 analytic tail majorants, O6 criterion assembly. A package value, not a bound.

nodes.name: z0 charge is lemma 14 2 term l
nodes.statement: The '+z_0' charge in the 7/8 manuscript enters through term L of Lemma 14.2 at short dual length, not a triangle-inequality loss (corrects r3-critical-count 5.1).

nodes.name: Zero-blind low-side floor 13/15 and oracle floor 5/6
nodes.statement: In the 7/8 architecture sigma_low = max(5/6 + M/12 - l/6, 23/24 - M/6 + 5l/24) >= 13/15 on M + l <= 1 (vertex (2/5, 0, 1/5)) for every density profile, GRH rows included. With oracle removal of both zero-blind obstructions a uniform saving s gives B = 13/15 - 4s/(5(5 - 6s)), floor 5/6.

nodes.name: Zero-channel disk certificates under heat flow
nodes.statement: Exactly one simple zero in the disk centre 1/2+14.134725141734693i, radius 0.35, for every -0.05<=tau<=0.05 (|xi(c)|<=2e-18, |xi'(c)|>=0.0013827, sup|xi''|<=0.0021). Exact quartet control P_u(z)=z^4+(12u-5)z^2+12u^2-10u+4, u=-tau: four channels for -0.13<=tau<=0.

nodes.name: Zero-complete rational tents shrink the support ratio
nodes.statement: For Q_a(s)=(a^s-1)(a^s-a) all multiplier zeros lie on Re s=0 or 1 and the prime kernel is nonnegative; RH margin positive from a=1.882453339. a=17/9: RH iff 17 sum_{81N<p<=153N}(p-81N)log p+9 sum_{153N<p<=289N}(289N-p)log p<=127296N^2 eventually. Certified supports 529/225, 1024/441; floor b*=3.4513363850.

nodes.name: Zero-density estimates are Lambda-inert
nodes.statement: Zero-density bounds give a positive upper bound on the number of off-line zeros and never certify zero off-line zeros up to X, so they cannot tighten the barrier bound. Obstruction map Z17 / landscape pointwise wall.

nodes.name: Explicit zero-density constants: the (log T)^A factor
nodes.statement: Ingham at sigma = 3/4 gives truncation term 3.06e-5 at T = 3e12 (interval-certified). Bui-Soundararajan and Guth-Maynard exponents substitute formally (factor 2.04e6 and 2.13) but unspecified (log T)^A / o(1) factors block rigour: at A = 6 the net effect is a 275-fold loss. Needs a log-free large-values lemma (map Z12, Z17).

nodes.name: Heat-flow zero dynamics as a weighted graph Laplacian
nodes.statement: For polynomial heat flows d_t f = -f'': dz/dt = L(z) conj(z), L the Laplacian of the zero graph with weights w_kj = 2/|z_k - z_j|^2; dx/dt = +Lx, dy/dt = -Ly. Conserved: sum z_k, sum x_k y_k; sum z_k^2 = sum z_k(0)^2 + 2n(n-1)t.

nodes.name: Majorization theorems for the zero flow are flow-blind
nodes.statement: Theorem A: y(t2) is majorized by y(t1) for t1 < t2. Theorem A': sum F(x_k,y_k) is nonincreasing along every heat flow iff F_xx <= 0 <= F_yy. Theorem B: sum psi(|Im z_k|) nonincreasing when y psi'(y) is nondecreasing. All hold for polynomials with non-real zeros: forward-only soft inequalities.

nodes.name: Operative unconditional zero-free region across T in [3e12, 1.9e16]
nodes.statement: log t in [28.73, 37.48]; classical width 1 - beta = 6.262e-3 (bottom) to 4.799e-3 (top) with Mossinghoff-Trudgian-Yang R = 5.558691. Vinogradov-Korobov (Ford 57.54; Bellotti 55.241) overtakes only at log t ~ 1.0242e4, about 4432 orders of magnitude in T above the window.

nodes.name: Zero ODE of H_t in unfolded units
nodes.statement: Convention d_t H = -H_zz, zeros at z = 2 gamma: dz_k/dt = 2 sum' [1/(z_k - z_j) + 1/(z_k + z_j)] + 1/z_k for simple zeros; with tau = t/Dz^2, Dz = 4 pi/log(gamma/2 pi), dx_k/d tau = 2 sum' 1/(x_k - x_j) up to density-gradient corrections.

nodes.name: Zero-packet shift identity
nodes.statement: For Q(w)=(w-i gamma)^2-delta^2: |Q(w+a)|^2-|Q(w-a)|^2=8a Re(w)((Re w)^2+(Im w-gamma)^2+a^2-delta^2). Negative only inside the disk of radius sqrt(delta^2-a^2) about i gamma; explains the strict threshold a>=delta.

nodes.name: Reflected-pair contribution to Re F'/F
nodes.statement: A(x,t)=Re F'/F=sum m(x-b)/((x-b)^2+(t-gamma)^2) without extra constant. A reflected pair b,-b at ordinate gamma contributes P=2mx(q-b^2)/((q+b^2)^2-4x^2b^2), q=x^2+(t-gamma)^2: negative only inside q<b^2.

nodes.name: Explicit bound |zeta(1/2+it)|<=6 sqrt(1+|t|)
nodes.statement: |zeta(1/2+it)|<=6 sqrt(1+|t|) for all real t (Euler summation). Gives tail bound int_{|t-c|>V}K_d(t-c)|zeta D-1|^2<=[72B^2(1+|c|)+2]J_0+72B^2J_1, B=sum|a_n|n^{-1/2}, J_0=32d^5/(5pi V^5), J_1=8d^5/(pi V^4).

nodes.name: Proposition D: a zeta-only version of the 7/8 argument is not easier (row Z13)
nodes.statement: Within the 7/8 architecture theta_zeta >= theta_family: the target enters only through its signal exponent. Zeta nonvanishing is derived only through the all-Hecke-character statement; no zeta-specific project input (fixed-support Weil positivity, density, proportion) can enter.

nodes.name: Inputs defined relative to zeta reproduce zeta's zeros
nodes.statement: Theorem PCR (class collapses through g = 1), RIG (the dual carries only zeta's zeros) and Theorem C (symbol 1 - zeta M_U equals 1 at every zero) state one fact: an input defined relative to zeta holds wherever its zeros are; every step before the failing one holds with an off-line zero.

nodes.name: Empirical lag-1 box anticorrelation of zeta zeros
nodes.statement: On Riemann zeros at T=1.5e5 (290 boxes, unfolded edge-to-edge tiling) the adjacent-box correlation of the sd(C-E) statistic is r1=-0.5126; r1 stays in [-0.526,-0.433] for 100 to 1000 zeros per box. GUE proxy: -0.46398. rho_emp is biased toward the rigidity limit relative to GUE.

nodes.name: Divergence law of the kinetic term at sigma -> 1/2+
nodes.statement: With u=2 sigma-1: T_zpo=1/u^2-c0+c1 u+O(u^2), c0=gamma^2+2 gamma_1=0.18754623, c1=3 gamma_2+6 gamma gamma_1+2 gamma^3=0.10337726. The divergence at sigma=1/2 is the pole of zeta at s=1 pulled back through beta=2 sigma; it carries Stieltjes constants and no zero data.
nodes.underusedWhy: only multiplicativity-using node of its chunk; filter example of a finite-stage property with no limit

nodes.name: Kinetic curvature term equals (log zeta)''(2 sigma)
nodes.statement: T_zpo(sigma)=sum_p (log p)^2 p^{-2 sigma}/(1-p^{-2 sigma})^2 = (log zeta)''(2 sigma), the primon-gas specific-heat kernel at beta=2 sigma: C_v(beta)=beta^2 (log zeta)''(beta). Termwise differentiation of the Euler product, Re s>1.

nodes.name: Pair correlation of first 1e4 unfolded zeros versus sine kernel
nodes.statement: R_2(x) versus 1-(sin pi x/pi x)^2 on x in [0.1,3]: L-inf deviation 0.0640 at x=0.43, L2 0.0281, localised on the flank of the repulsion dip.

nodes.name: ZPO operator spectrum versus sine kernel
nodes.statement: The project's Hilbert-Polya style zero-point-oscillator construction has real-space pair correlation close to the GUE sine kernel at finite N. The construction takes zeros as input; no independent operator is produced.

nodes.name: (ZR) zero-repulsion hypothesis
nodes.statement: Single named hypothesis in the kernel-verified L2 detection-modulus theorem (Aristotle wave 5, no nonstandard axioms). Discharging it promotes frozen-rung <=> Platt-Trudgian to a full theorem; it promotes a theorem, not a Lambda value.

nodes.name: Field symmetries and boundary conditions on the reflection annulus
nodes.statement: For F with F(1-s) = F(s), F(conj s) = conj F(s) and pullback f = U + iV: f o D = f, f o R = f o A = conj f. On regular annulus boundaries V = 0 and d_n U = 0. Raw zeta without its functional-equation multiplier does not satisfy these.

nodes.name: Dirichlet-to-Neumann reference operator on the annulus
nodes.statement: Flat strip of length l = 4K, width b = K'. At frequency kappa = 2 pi |n|/l the DtN matrix on the two boundary traces is kappa [[coth(kappa b), -csch(kappa b)],[-csch(kappa b), coth(kappa b)]], eigenvalues kappa tanh(kappa b/2), kappa coth(kappa b/2); zero mode eigenvalues 0, 2/b. Positive semidefinite.

nodes.name: Axis limit of W/x
nodes.statement: With h(t) = F(1/2+it) real on the line, lim_{x->0} W(1/2+x+it)/x = h'(t)^2 - h(t) h''(t). Contains the square V_x^2 and the signed curvature term U U_xx. Obstruction map G8: an explicit symmetric control with an off-line quartet keeps the axis witness L_1 >= 0.

nodes.name: Two-channel spinor and Bloch vector of the shifted pair
nodes.statement: psi = (U,V)/sqrt(|U|^2+|V|^2), U = G(s+a), V = G(s-a); n = (2 Re(conj U V), 2 Im(conj U V), |U|^2 - |V|^2). n_3 is the bridge balance; (n_3, n_2)/(2a) -> (Re G'/G, -Im G'/G). SU(2) rotation gives sign change at 2 pi. The pair (xi(s), xi(1-s)) is degenerate.

nodes.name: Strip boundary kernel P_a
nodes.statement: U_a(t) = F(1/2+a+it); P_a(r1,r2) = Im(conj U_a(r1) U_a(r2)) / (a (r2 - r1)), diagonal P_a(t,t) = Re(F' conj F)(1/2+a+it)/a. Source: Math Explorer PR 43 strip-Poisson reconstruction.

nodes.name: Bridge Gram kernel and ratio-Pick kernel share inertia
nodes.statement: With U = F(1/2+u+a), V = F(1/2+u-a), R = V/U: K^b_ij = (U_i conj U_j - V_i conj V_j)/(2 pi (u_i + conj u_j)) and K^P_ij = (1 - R_i conj R_j)/(u_i + conj u_j) are diagonally congruent when U_i != 0. Finite orders are Euler-blind (map rows P3, P5).

nodes.name: Finite bridge versus logarithmic derivative near a zero
nodes.statement: Simple-zero model: Re(F_s/F) = 1/x, B_a/(2a) = x/(x^2+a^2). At tau = -0.2, x = 0.05: Re(F_s/F) = 20.003375; B_.02/.04 = 17.243 (13.8% low), B_.25/.50 = 0.772 (96.1% low). The bridge shift must be small relative to the distance from the zero.

nodes.name: Comparison of the theta bridge operator with a positive reference form
nodes.statement: Missing step named in the renderer notes: an exact identity or comparison connecting the full theta bridge operator to a positive reference form (e.g. the annulus DtN operator), with a global bound on the remaining signed coupling B and all infinity/tail terms. Any such bound over all tests is RH-strength (map rows G1, G2).

nodes.name: Symmetric entire control Q_{a,T} with an off-line quartet
nodes.statement: Q_{a,T}(s) = cosh(u)[u^2 - (a+iT)^2][u^2 - (a-iT)^2], u = s - 1/2, 0 < a < 1/2. Satisfies Q(1-s) = Q(s), reality, is positive on the real axis, has an essential singularity at infinity and the same Klein/annulus rules as xi, with zeros 1/2 +- a +- iT off the line plus 1/2 + i pi(n+1/2).

nodes.name: Modulus and phase gradients of an analytic field
nodes.statement: For U = log|F|, q = F'/F = a + ib: grad U = (a,-b), grad arg F = (b,a) = J grad U. A pure phase tracer conserves U and stays on modulus level sets; near a zero of order m its tangential speed is beta m/r. Tracer motion is not zero motion.

nodes.name: Exact cubic through a multiple zero
nodes.statement: P_tau(z) = z(z^2 + b^2 - 6 tau), zeros 0 and +-sqrt(6 tau - b^2), tau_c = b^2/6. Crosses a triple zero without dividing by a singular zero velocity.

nodes.name: Dirichlet energy under the folds, and its divergence at the puncture
nodes.statement: On matched truncations E_{E_r}(f) = 2 E_K(f) = 2 E_annulus(f) in the flat metric |dz|^2 = (4K)^2 du^2 + (2K')^2 dv^2. For Laurent f = sum a_n q^n the annulus energy is 2 pi sum n^2 |a_n|^2 integral r^{2n-1} dr, divergent at the puncture for every negative-power coefficient.

nodes.name: Divisor cosine sum factorises over prime powers
nodes.statement: D_N(xi) = sum_{d|N} cos((xi/2) log(d/sqrt N)) = prod_{p^k || N} sum_{j=0..k} cos((xi log p / 2)(j - k/2)). Exact finite identity used as the arithmetic block in the theta-layer diagnostic.

nodes.name: Dual conormal CP^1 of the elliptic curve in CP^3
nodes.statement: Curve: Q1 = X1^2 - X0 X2 = 0, Q2 = X3^2 - X0^2 - c X1^2 - X2^2 = 0, c = r^2 + r^{-2}. N1 = (-Z2, 2Z1, -Z0, 0), N2 = (-2Z0, -2cZ1, -2Z2, 2Z3). Tangent hyperplanes [W] = [lambda N1 + mu N2] satisfy W.Z = 0, W.T = 0. Regular at the spectral punctures.

nodes.name: Finite interacting-zero trap model in reverse heat time
nodes.statement: ds_j/du = (1/2) sum_{k != j} 1/(s_j - s_k) - kappa(t_j)(sigma_j - 1/2) + (i eps/2) cos(k_0 g_j - omega u), g_j = 2(t_j - t_0), six unfolded initial zeros. The confinement term kappa is imposed; this is a display model, not the xi zero evolution.

nodes.name: Elliptic double cover E_r with spectral lens L
nodes.statement: E_r: eta^2 = (w^2 + r^2)(w^2 + r^{-2}), r > 1; s = 1/2 + L(1/(1-w) - 1/2), L > 0 a display lens. w -> 1/conj w corresponds to s -> 1 - conj s; |w| < 1 is Re s > 1/2. Spectral punctures p_+- = (1, +-(r + 1/r)); anti-bridge points q_+- = (-1, +-(r + 1/r)).

nodes.name: xi has an essential singularity at the spectral puncture
nodes.statement: f(q) = xi(L/q + (1-L)/2) has infinitely many negative Laurent powers at q = 0 (xi is entire, non-polynomial). No coordinate change, dual, or smooth Klein drawing removes it; the unweighted Dirichlet energy near the puncture is infinite. Compact-surface arguments must carry the rim data.

nodes.name: Even/odd boundary energy decomposition
nodes.statement: omega_{a,h}(r) = pi r sin(pi h/a) sinh(pi r/a) / (a h [cosh(pi r/a) + cos(pi h/a)]^2) is a probability density on r >= 0. With D_+- = P_a(t+-r,t+-r), C = P_a(t-r,t+r), e_+- = (D_- + D_+ +- 2C)/4, E_+- = integral omega e_+-: E_+ - E_- = W(1/2+h+it)/h. At h=a the measure is delta_0 and E_- = 0.

nodes.name: Finite bridge balance B_a
nodes.statement: B_a(s) = (|F(s+a)|^2 - |F(s-a)|^2)/(|F(s+a)|^2 + |F(s-a)|^2) = tanh(log|F(s+a)| - log|F(s-a)|). Away from zeros B_a/(2a) -> Re(F'/F) as a -> 0. A common zero of both shifts has no bridge value.

nodes.name: Arb certificate: first xi zero stays on the line for |tau| <= 0.05
nodes.statement: Disk centre 1/2 + 14.134725141734693 i, radius 7/20. Arb: |xi(c)| <= 2e-18, |xi'(c)| >= 0.0013827, sup|xi''| <= 0.0021, floor m = 0.00035532; perturbation P <= 0.00029 for |tau| <= 1/20; margin m - P = 6.532e-5. Exactly one simple zero, on the line, for every such tau. Map row G7.

nodes.name: Gaussian-weighted xi extends smoothly and flat across the punctures
nodes.statement: h_S(s) = exp(-|s - 1/2|^2/S^2). log^+|xi(s)| = O(R log(R+2)) on |s| <= R (theta integral, unconditional), so h_S xi and all derivatives tend to zero at q = 0. Zeros, orders and phase are unchanged; d-bar(h_S F) = -((s - 1/2)/S^2) h_S F, so the weighted field is not holomorphic.

nodes.name: Synthetic symmetric quartet multiplier
nodes.statement: Multiply F by [(w - i gamma)^2 - delta^2][(w + i gamma)^2 - delta^2], w = s - 1/2. Inserts a chosen off-line quartet while keeping F(1-s) = F(s) and reality; used to test which displayed features detect zero location.

nodes.name: Zero velocity under the theta heat family
nodes.statement: F_tau(s) = 8 H_tau(-2i(s-1/2)) = 8 integral_0^inf e^{tau u^2} Phi(u) cosh(2u(s-1/2)) du; d_tau F = (1/4) F_ss; F_tau(1 - conj s) = conj F_tau(s). At a simple zero rho' = -F_ss/(4 F_s); for polynomials rho_i' = -(1/2) sum_{j != i} 1/(rho_i - rho_j). The infinite sum needs Polymath Prop. 3.1 symmetric pairing.

nodes.name: Hessian of log modulus
nodes.statement: With q = G'/G and q' = G''/G - q^2, the Hessian of log|G| has eigenvalues +|q'| and -|q'| away from zeros and poles.

nodes.name: Local coordinate at spectral infinity and the exact Klein seam
nodes.statement: q = 1 - w = L/(u_s + L/2), u_s = s - 1/2 = L(1/q - 1/2). Klein involution: q_A = -conj q/(1 - conj q), u_s(Ap) = -conj u_s(p). The seam is the angular reflection theta -> pi - theta only asymptotically. The point w = infinity is the finite spectral point s = 1/2 - L/2.

nodes.name: Jacobi chart and the three involutions in (u,v)
nodes.statement: m = r^{-4}, z = 4Ku + 2iK'(v - 1/2), w = (i/r) sn(z|m), eta = cn dn. Modulo 1: R(u,v) = (u, 1/2 - v), D(u,v) = (1/2 - u, 1 - v), A = DR: (u,v) -> (1/2 - u, 1/2 + v). Fundamental annulus 1/4 <= v <= 3/4, interior = Re s > 1/2.

nodes.name: Klein bottle quotient K = E_r/A
nodes.statement: A(w,eta) = (1/conj w, -conj eta/conj w^2) is a free antiholomorphic involution; in P^3, A[X0:X1:X2:X3] = [conj X2 : conj X1 : conj X0 : -conj X3]. K is a Klein bottle; the critical loop does not separate it. Seam topology has two invariants and is blind to off-line pairs (map row G13).

nodes.name: Real-node logarithmic-derivative Pick kernel
nodes.statement: X(z) = xi(1/2+z), L = X'/X, K_ij = (L(x_i)+L(x_j))/(x_i+x_j) for distinct positive real nodes. PR 55 reports six-node positivity; all-order positivity is RH-equivalent and each finite order follows from verified height (map rows P1, P3). Weakest mode shown as h(u) = sum b_i e^{-x_i u}, V(z) = sum b_i/(z+x_i).

nodes.name: Exact quadratic modal collision F_eps(w) = w^2 + 2 eps
nodes.statement: W = 2x(x^2+y^2+2 eps), L_1(y) = 4y^2 + 8 eps. For eps < 0 the negative right-shear region is the open half-disk x>0, x^2+y^2 < -2 eps. At a=1: E_+ - E_- = 2(y^2+h^2+2 eps); boundary PSD only when 1+2 eps >= 0. Zero count stays two through the collision. Map row G8.

nodes.name: Continuous Newton flow preserves phase
nodes.statement: ds/dl = -F(s)/F_s(s) gives F(s(l)) = e^{-l} F(s(0)): curves keep arg F and lead probes to existing simple zeros, off-line zeros included. Multiplying by a non-vanishing analytic factor reshapes the phase field without moving zeros; covers and projective coordinates add no zero-location constraint.

nodes.name: Event order in the quartic: count changes before the collision
nodes.statement: Fixed circle centre 1/2 + i/2, radius 7/20: second zero reaches the contour at tau = -0.0817542508; the two zeros collide at tau = -0.1340695840; departure off the line follows. min|P_0| = 2.0979, max|P_u - P_0| = (617/25)u + 12u^2 on the circle. A disk can hold a two-zero cluster without forcing either zero onto the line.

nodes.name: Positive-kernel bounds on heat perturbation and derivatives
nodes.statement: Because each Phi summand is positive: for |tau| <= delta and |Re s - 1/2| <= r, |F_tau - F_0| <= 8 integral Phi(u)(e^{delta u^2} - 1) cosh(2ru) du; |xi^{(k)}(s)| <= 2^{k+3} integral u^k Phi(u) cosh(2ru) du (L_3 = 0.0077419528 at r = 0.35). Explicit tails: Phi_n(u) <= 2 pi^2 n^4 exp(9u - pi n^2 e^{4u}).

nodes.name: Exact coefficient formula for polynomial heat
nodes.statement: P_tau = exp(-tau d_z^2) P_0 has coefficients c_k(tau) = sum_{j>=0} ((-tau)^j / j!) ((k+2j)!/k!) a_{k+2j}; the sum is finite. Presets: six real, Lehmer-like (-3,-1.2,-0.18,0.18,1.2,3), eight real, quartet.

nodes.name: Signed prime-power oscillator rows
nodes.statement: A_{p,m}(gamma) = log(p) p^{-m/2} cos(gamma m log p); carrier rows A_{p,m}(gamma) cos(gamma u - m log(p) T), u = log x. Signed coefficients, not energies; no convergence of the Euler-product logarithmic derivative on the critical line is assumed.

nodes.name: Pulse multiplier S = (F - alpha F')/(F + alpha F') on the critical line
nodes.statement: S(omega) = (F - alpha F')/(F + alpha F') at 1/2 + i omega is unimodular on the line by symmetry. Causality of S (bounded analytic in the right half-plane) is RH-equivalent and holds as an identity for any even order-one F (map row G6). The renderer shows a finite periodic right-tail fraction only.

nodes.name: Exact rational certificate: four moving quartet channels
nodes.statement: For the quartic calibration, four moving disks of radius 0.01 in the s-plane each contain exactly one zero for every -0.13 <= tau <= 0; 130 time cells, affine centres, Bernstein-coefficient enclosures in exact rational arithmetic.

nodes.name: Exact quartic heat collision
nodes.statement: P_u(z) = e^{u d_z^2}[(z^2-1)(z^2-4)] = z^4 + (12u-5) z^2 + 12u^2 - 10u + 4. First collision u* = (10 - sqrt 46)/24 = 0.134069584; at u = 1/4 roots are +-sqrt5/2 +- i/2. F_tau(s) = P_{-tau}(-2i(s-1/2)) has both symmetries and F_tau(1/2) >= 23/12 > 0, yet zeros leave the line.

nodes.name: Frozen-block Schur complement and negative-index additivity
nodes.statement: For Hermitian Q = [[A,B],[B*,C]] with C invertible: Q_eff = A - B C^{-1} B*, ind_-(Q) = ind_-(C) + ind_-(Q_eff). A symmetry reduction may set the coupling B to zero only after proving the actual kernel and domain respect the symmetry.

nodes.name: Parity of W under the critical reflection
nodes.statement: W(1 - conj s) = -W(s); W/(sigma - 1/2) is invariant under s -> 1 - conj s away from the axis; the boundary kernel satisfies P_{-a} = P_a. Bridge forms keep their values under the Klein/annulus fold; they are not halved.

nodes.name: Additive shifted-field pencil G = xi(s+a) - c e^{i phi} xi(s-a)
nodes.statement: G(s,u) = xi(s+a) - c exp(i(phi + omega u)) xi(s-a). Its zeros move with the phase; at c = 1 they are the level set R_a(s) = e^{-i phi}. They are zeros of G, not of xi. Related pencil route: map row P32.

nodes.name: Shifted ratio R_a and its zero/pole bookkeeping
nodes.statement: R_a(s) = F(s-a)/F(s+a). A zero of F at lambda gives a zero of R_a at lambda+a and a pole at lambda-a of order [m(lambda) - m(lambda-2a)]_+. Schur property of R_a on the right half-plane restates a zero-free strip (map rows G2, G20).

nodes.name: Signed shear W and modulus monotonicity
nodes.statement: W(s) = Re(F'(s) conj F(s)) = (1/2) d/dsigma |F|^2 and W/|F|^2 = Re(F'/F). For completed xi at heat time zero, W > 0 throughout Re s > 1/2 (horizontal modulus monotonicity) is a reformulation of RH (Sondow-Dumitrescu).

nodes.name: Arithmetic coupling for intrinsic spinor/Dirac/twistor structures
nodes.statement: Renderer roadmap: intrinsic surface spinors, Dirac operators and full twistors on the elliptic model require additional specified geometry and an arithmetic coupling; the present constructions transform a displayed channel state and impose no constraint on zeros. No candidate coupling is specified.

nodes.name: Fixed-strip end charts retaining the transverse offset
nodes.statement: Charts rho = log|t| and y = 1/t with x = sigma - 1/2 kept as an independent coordinate; s = 1/2 + x + i eps e^rho. Klein reflection sends (x, rho, eps) to (-x, rho, eps) and does not exchange the two ends. A direction in the q-plane alone cannot separate fixed values of x.

nodes.name: One-zero reflection-symmetric disk forces the zero onto the line
nodes.statement: If a disk invariant under s -> 1 - conj s contains exactly one zero (with multiplicity) of a family with that symmetry, the zero is on Re s = 1/2. Count preserved while sup_boundary |F_tau - F_0| < inf_boundary |F_0| (Rouche). Local; at scale it restates verified height (map row G7).

nodes.name: Taylor-Rouche one-zero disk criterion
nodes.statement: For a disk centre c, radius r with |F(c)| <= E, |F_s(c)| >= A > 0, sup_disk |F_ss| <= B: E + (1/2) B r^2 < A r implies exactly one (simple) zero in the disk and boundary floor A r - E - B r^2/2. The centre need not be an exact root.

nodes.name: Theta kernel Phi and its cosine transform
nodes.statement: Phi(u) = sum_{n>=1} (2 pi^2 n^4 e^{9u} - 3 pi n^2 e^{5u}) exp(-pi n^2 e^{4u}), u >= 0; integral_0^inf Phi(u) cos(xi u) du = xi(1/2 + i xi/2)/8. Every summand is positive on u >= 0 since 2 pi n^2 e^{4u} > 3. Evenness of the full kernel comes from the modular identity.

nodes.name: Negative theta layer with positive integrated direction
nodes.statement: kappa(v) = Phi(v/4), b_j = 0.15 j, c = (-2,9,-19,24,-19,9,-2), Q(a) = sum c_j c_k kappa(a+b_j-b_k) kappa(a-b_j+b_k). Floating point: Q(1/20) = -0.000908036036923, while integral_0^4 2a sinh(xa) Q(a) da at x = 0.25 is +0.001619366968247. PR 43 has an interval certificate for the full-kernel layer.

nodes.name: Drift of the first three zeros under the theta heat flow
Transverse distance derivative D' = -M/2
nodes.statement: At a simple zero with x = Re rho - 1/2, D = x^2, M = x Re(F_ss/F_s): D'_tau = -M/2. A moving tube |x| <= d(tau) is inward-invariant if M >= -4 d d' on its boundary. No sign theorem for M; D' = 0 on the line does not exclude a later collision.

nodes.name: Chosen Euclidean twistor map CP^3 -> S^4 on the elliptic quartet
nodes.statement: Z = [1:w:w^2:eta], (q1,q2) = (Z0 + j Z1, Z2 + j Z3); x = (2 q1 conj q2, |q1|^2 - |q2|^2) in S^4. J Z = (-conj Z1, conj Z0, -conj Z3, conj Z2), J^2 = -I; fibre [alpha Z + beta JZ]. The real structure is a choice; no positivity follows (map row G19).

nodes.name: Top semilocal prolate eigenfunction is Zygmund-class, so no analytic-continuation argument
nodes.statement: The shortcut band-limited => entire => equal to C/v on a tail interval => pole at 0 forbidden => C=0 fails: the top state of the semilocal prolate operator is fractal (Zygmund), not entire. The residual sits in the cutoff octave (1/2,1), which carries exactly half the cusp.
